title: Category-Leading Amazon Operations Manager
description:
# Amazon Operations Manager to Own the Channel End to End - PPC, Profit and Growth for a Category-Leading Health Brand



We're a US Amazon brand selling health products - #1 in our category, with $5M+ a year in sales. Amazon is our main channel. Our team works remotely: a full-time creative designer, a freelance listing designer, a supply chain lead, an assistant, and an external PPC agency.



We're looking for an experienced Amazon Operations Manager to run our Amazon channel day to day and own its profit - PPC, pricing, listings, supply and weekly performance. You'll lead our creative designer and our supply chain lead, and report directly to our founder. Our PPC agency stays until the end of the year, then PPC comes in-house - and you run it. **This isn't an assistant or VA role** - you own the results. And you don't start from zero: our scorecard, playbooks, inventory forecasting, pricing tests and AI agents are already built. Your job is to run them well and make them better.



## 💼 What You'll Do



**Channel Performance**



- Own Amazon revenue, net margin and market share

- Run our weekly scorecard and the playbooks it triggers

- Deliver a clear weekly update to the founder with insights and next steps



**Profit**



- Grow net margin through every lever - PPC, product costs, returns, fees and pricing



**PPC**



- Run a $50K+/month PPC budget hands-on from January - campaign structure, bids, keywords, negatives, budgets

- Work with our PPC agency until then, and lead the handover



**Pricing**



- Run structured price tests with our pricing system

- Read the results and d
 the next move



**Listings & Creative**



- Direct our creative designer on main images, listing tests, video, titles and bullets

- Judge creative by results - CTR and conversion



**Supply & Team**



- Lead our supply chain lead and creative designer

- Plan stock and reorders weekly so ads and pricing match what's on hand



## 🧠 What You Bring



- You've personally managed $50K+ a month in Amazon PPC spend in one account, hands-on

- 4-6 years hands-on Amazon experience - brand or agency side - with results you can show

- You've managed at least one person day to day

- You've managed FBA stock and restock decisions with a supply person

- You like working with clear systems and playbooks - and you improve them

- You use AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT) every day to work faster

- Comfortable with Helium 10, DataDive, Keepa, Sellerboard and Google Sheets

- You make decisions from data, not guesses

- Clear, proactive written English - you share updates before anyone has to ask



## 🎯 Bonus if you:



- Have health, medical or personal care category experience

- Have moved PPC from an agency to in-house

- Use Scale Insights or a similar PPC tool

- Have run price tests on Amazon

- Have directed a designer or creative team

- Have negotiated product costs with suppliers



## 💸 What We Offer



- $1,800-3,000/month, full-time contractor, fully remote

- Available 4:00-7:00 PM Philippine time, Monday to Friday

- Work directly with the founder - no layers of management

- A category leader - you're protecting and growing a #1 position

- Systems already built: scorecard, playbooks, forecasting, pricing tests, AI agents on Claude

- A small team to lead: a creative designer and a supply chain lead

- Long-term role with real growth opportunity

Click the link below to fill out our short questionnaire (20 min) and submit your resume. Only candidates who complete the questionnaire move to the next stage: a paid skill test, then an interview.

title: Website UI/UX Designer – Homepage Redesign First – START IMMEDIATELY
description:
We are looking for a talented website UI/UX designer who can start immediately and create a modern, visually impressive, easy-to-use design for InfoAlanya.



Website: 



InfoAlanya is a travel and local-services platform covering airport transfers, tours and activities, restaurants, places to visit, events, articles, properties, and practical local information.



YOUR FIRST TASK



Redesign our homepage for desktop and mobile, including:

- Clear navigation and organisation of our existing features.

- Strong visual design, typography, imagery, and layout.

- Clear entry points to our services, bookings, and enquiries.

- A thoughtful user journey that helps visitors find what they need.



Excellent design and clear user flows are our main priorities. We need someone who can make strong design decisions independently, explain their choices, and work closely with our frontend developer.



Deliverables should include editable Figma designs, reusable components, and a clickable prototype showing the main navigation and interactions.



FURTHER WORK



The homepage is your first paid assignment within the role. If the collaboration works well, you will continue with the remaining website pages and other projects.



We are initially looking for someone for 2–3 months full-time. This is the employment period, not the deadline for completing the homepage.



VUE 3 SKILLS ARE A PLUS



If you can also implement your designs in Vue 3, that is a plus, but not a requirement. Implementation would form part of your responsibilities within the agreed salary and working hours.



SALARY & AVAILABILITY



- USD 300–500 per month, depending on skills and experience.

- 40 hours per week.

- Start immediately.



HOW TO APPLY



Please review 
 before applying and include:



1. Portfolio: Links to your 2–3 strongest website designs and your role in each.

2. Your ideas: What would you improve on our homepage?

3. Homepage timeline: How many working days would you need to complete the desktop and mobile homepage designs?

4. Full website estimate: Approximately how long would you need to redesign the remaining website and its main user flows?

5. Expected salary: Your monthly salary requirement within the USD 300–500 range.

6. Availability: Your earliest start date and confirmation that you can work 40 hours per week.

7. Coding skills: Whether you can also work in Vue 3. Please clarify whether your time estimates cover design only or design and implementation.



Please send a tailored application with clear time estimates and relevant portfolio examples. We are ready to start immediately with the right designer.

title: Customer support
description:
Read this entire post before applying. If you skim it, you will fail the application in the first five seconds and we will both have wasted our time. That is not a threat — it's a favor. This job is not for most people, and I'd rather you find that out now.





WHAT THIS JOB ACTUALLY IS

We are a Swedish e-commerce company running several brands. Every brand gets customer
s every day, and every one of them needs a correct answer the same day. Forever.



Your job: clear the support inboxes every day. Different brands, different languages, the same questions over and over:



"Where is my delivery?"

Order not received.

Product not as expected.

Returns and exchanges.

General questions about the brand.



The
s are boring. The job is not. Here is what a normal day actually looks like:



Open the inboxes. Look each order up in Shopify. Find the tracking. Reply in the customer's language using DeepL, following our reply guide.

When tracking has been dead for a week, you do not tell the customer "please wait." You message our shipping agents in China, get an answer, and then tell the customer what is actually happening and when.

When a customer opens a dispute with their bank, you collect the evidence — order, tracking, delivery proof, your
 thread — and submit it to the payment provider. Before the deadline. Without being reminded.

When the same problem shows up three times in one week, you write it down and tell us. Once, with numbers.



The tools: Shopify admin,
, DeepL, the carriers' tracking pages, the payment provider's dispute portal, and a chat with our China agents. We teach you our setup in week one. Shopify admin you must already know: previous hands-on experience in Shopify admin is required.





THE ONE THING THIS JOB IS REALLY ABOUT

We are in Sweden and we spend our days running ads. We are not going to sit next to you. If you message us "what should I do?" three times a day, this job has failed — for both of us.



The rule is simple. Before anything reaches us, you have already tried to solve it. When it still has to reach us, it arrives like this — four lines, nothing else:



The problem: Order 4471, tracking dead for 11 days, customer threatening a chargeback.

What I already did: Checked the carrier page, asked the China agent on Monday and again on Wednesday, no reply.

What I propose: Offer a replacement now, refund only if there is no scan by Friday.

What I need from you: A yes or a no.



That is the whole job in four lines. Anyone can answer "where is my order" when the tracking works. I am hiring the person who knows what to do when it doesn't — and who d
 first and asks second.



Quick question, and I mean it: a customer writes in Danish, and DeepL is down for the whole day. What do you do? Make your answer the very last thing you say in your application video. You'll see why below.





WHAT WE ACTUALLY CARE ABOUT, IN THIS EXACT ORDER

1. You show up. Every single day, Saturday and Sunday included. Not "most days." Not "I had internet problems." Every day.

2. The inbox is cleared inside your window, every day. Nothing sits for more than 24 hours without a reply.

3. You d
 first and ask second. Every time something reaches us, it comes with your proposed solution.

4. You stay. We are building a team, not renting an assistant for two months.

5. Your English and your tone are good enough — and get better.



Notice that skill is fifth on this list. That is not a mistake. The one skill you must bring is Shopify admin. Everything else we can teach you: our brands, our reply guide, our shipping, our tone — we have a whole system for it, and the person who reads this carefully and types "kanelbulle" as the first word of the subject line when applying is already showing me the exact trait I'm hiring for. It is not mentioned in the subject line structure below, but it is supposed to be the first word, then the structure. What we cannot teach is a person who opens the inbox every single day for the next two years, weekends included, and who would rather make a decision than wait for one.





HOURS — READ THIS PART HONESTLY

This is work on demand. There is no fixed shift. The rule is simple: the inbox is cleared every day, 7 days a week, inside 10:00–17:00 Swedish time. If you are in the Philippines, that window is 17:00–00:00 right now (16:00–23:00 in summer). You d
 when inside it. The workload has grown fast: right now the job takes several hours every day, and it keeps growing as we add brands and tasks. Weekends are never optional.



You log the hours you actually work, and you are paid for them. More hours come with more brands and more tasks.



If you cannot open the inbox every single day, including weekends, do not apply. That is the entire job.





PAY — READ THIS PART SLOWLY

Hourly rate, paid twice a month, on time, every time. We have never missed a payment and we never will.



The rate ladder, in writing:



Start: $2.50 USD per hour.

After 1 month: $3.00 USD per hour.

After 3 months: $3.50 USD per hour.

After 6 months: $4.00 USD per hour.



Every step is automatic if you are still clearing the inbox every day. It goes into your agreement on day one. You will never have to ask me for a raise, and I will never "forget." The first raise comes after ONE month. Not six. Not "we'll see." One month.



On top of that:



$20 USD consistency bonus every month you open the inbox on every single day with zero missed days. This is the easiest money in the job, and it is entirely within your control.

$3 USD per Trustpilot review. Every 4- or 5-star review from a real customer that mentions you by name. Uncapped, and this is the real upside. A customer who was angry on Monday and names you in a 5-star review on Thursday is exactly the job, and you get paid for it every time it happens. Each review is matched to a real order before it is paid.



One line on that, because it matters: you never ask a customer for a rating, you never offer a customer anything for a review, and you never write one yourself. One fake, bought or nudged review and the seat is gone the same day. The reviews you get paid for are the ones you earned by fixing the problem so well that the customer wanted to say your name.



You are paid for the hours you actually work, not for counting
s. Some days are calmer. Some days are a full inbox and a dispute deadline. Either way, the day is cleared.





WHAT COUNTS AS DONE

Every customer
 that arrived before 17:00 Swedish time is answered the same day, in the customer's language, following the reply guide, with the order looked up in Shopify. Every dispute is answered before its deadline. Anything that reaches us comes in the four-line format above. Not a taste judgment. If I send something back, I tell you exactly why in one sentence, and it counts once you fix it.





WHO SHOULD NOT APPLY

Please save us both the time. Do not apply if:



You cannot open the inbox every single day, Saturday and Sunday included.

Your internet is unreliable and you have no backup connection.

You have no plan for brownouts or power cuts.

You need someone to tell you what to do for each
.

You take angry customers personally, or argue with them.

You have never worked in Shopify admin for a real store. Not "seen it" — worked in it.

You are not comfortable recording a short video of yourself with your camera on.

You want to negotiate the rate upward before you've proven a single month.

You are looking for a placeholder while you search for something better.

You want the "future tasks" at the bottom of this post to be the job now. They come after months of a cleared inbox, not before.



I'm not being harsh for fun. I'd rather describe the job exactly than lose a good person who wanted a different one.





HOW TO APPLY — THIS IS THE FIRST TEST

Ninety percent of applicants will get this wrong. That's the point.



1. Subject line, formatted EXACTLY like this:

| [most customer
s you have ever answered in ONE day] | [years using Shopify admin] | [hours/day you can work] | [days/week you can work] | [your download speed from speedtest.net]



Example: XXXXXX | 45 | 2 | 2 | 7 | 40mbps



Wrong format or a missing field — deleted unread. If the Shopify field says 0, deleted unread. No exceptions, no second chances.



2. Your message contains ONE thing: a link to a Loom video. Nothing else. No written answers, no cover letter, no CV.



It must be Loom (
). Not YouTube, not Google Drive, not a file. The free Loom plan is enough. Set the link so anyone with it can watch. Maximum 5 minutes. In English. Camera on, your face visible the whole time.



In the video, cover these six things, in this order:



1. Who you are, and the most customer
s you have ever answered in one day. For which store, and what kind of tickets.

2. Your Shopify experience. Which stores, for how long, and what you actually did in Shopify admin. Then: the first thing you open in Shopify admin when a customer says the package hasn't arrived, and what you look at there.

3. Your setup. Computer, internet provider, backup internet, and what you do when the power goes out. Open speedtest.net on your screen and run it while you record. The number must match your subject line.

4. Longevity. The longest you have ever stayed in one role or with one client, how long, and why it ended. A short history with an honest reason beats an inflated one.

5. What would make you quit this job. Everyone has a breaking point. Tell me yours. I trust the person who names it far more than the person who says "nothing."

6. The last thing you say in the video: the answer to the question I asked you earlier in this post. If it isn't there, you didn't read the post. If it is, I already know two things about you.



Never show a client's Shopify admin, customer names or orders on your screen. Protecting customer data is part of this job, so it is part of the test.



3. If I message you, reply within 24 hours. If you don't, I move on to the next applicant. Answering fast is part of the job, so it is part of the test.





THE THREE STAGES

Stage 1 — The application above. A Loom of up to 5 minutes. Most people won't do it.



Stage 2 — The inbox test. Unpaid. If your video is sharp, I send you five real customer
s (names removed) in three languages, our reply guide, and access to DeepL. You return five written replies within 24 hours. One of the five has no answer in the guide. I am watching what you do with that one: guess, ask a smart question, or find it. Anything that has to reach me comes in the four-line format. I am not grading style. I am grading: did you follow the guide exactly, did you deliver on time, and did you d
 before you asked. This is a real preview of the daily job.



Stage 3 — Paid trial week on one brand's live inbox. Real customers, real China agents, real feedback. This is where the seat is won.





WHAT YOU GET IF YOU WIN IT

One company, several brands, the same people every day. You choose when you work inside the window. Pay on time, twice a month, without ever having to ask. A rate that grows on a schedule you can see, and hours that grow with the work. Someone who tells you exactly what's wrong in one sentence so you can fix it and get better fast.



And a real path. Once the inbox has been cleared every day for months, the next tasks are real: finding products, searching for ad videos, writing ad copy, product descriptions, talking to UGC creators and influencers. We train you for them. But that comes after, not instead.



And the upside has no ceiling: every customer who names you in a 4- or 5-star review is $3 in your pocket, forever, on top of everything above.



If you're the kind of person who is tired of clients who never answer, and who just wants a seat, a standard to hit, and to be paid reliably for hitting it — this is that.



Show me you can follow instructions, and show me you can d
. That's the whole first test.

title: Client Relationship Manager
description:
About NLM

Norwest Logistic Management (NLM) is an Australian-based freight brokerage that gives Australian businesses access to bulk-negotiated shipping rates through one easy-to-use platform. Established in 2002 and rebuilt as a technology company, NLM connects businesses of every size to Australia's major carriers — including TNT, Allied Express, CouriersPlease, Northline, CRL Express and Hunter Express, plus FedEx for international.



Instead of juggling multiple delivery accounts, our customers book, track and manage all their freight in one place, at rates they could not get on their own. We are a small, fast-moving team, and every customer relationship matters to us.



About the role

You will be the go-to person for our business customers. Your job is to stay consistently in touch with them by phone and
, understand what they need, and make sure they feel heard and looked after.

You will learn the ins and outs of NLM — our platform, our carriers and the benefits we offer — so you can help customers get the most out of their account. This is a relationship role first: you will reach out proactively, ask how we can help, and resolve anything that comes up.



Key responsibilities

• Stay in regular contact with your portfolio of business customers by mobile and

• Proactively check in and ask whether there is anything we can do to help or make shipping easier for them

• Act as the main point of contact for all account management needs

• Assist customers with enquiries and requests, from account questions to using the NLM platform

• Understand each customer's delivery needs and share feedback and opportunities with the NLM team

• Help customers understand NLM's system and benefits so they use their account to its full potential

• Handle basic customer service questions, such as tracking consignments and delivery updates

• Help manage customer disputes and follow them through to a resolution

• Keep accurate notes of customer conversations and follow-ups in our CRM



What you need

• Extremely proficient English, spoken and written, to an excellent level — this is essential

• Proven account management experience

• A warm, confident phone manner and clear, professional
 writing

• Genuine care for customers and the patience to really listen

• Ability to work Sydney business hours, 3 days per week and potential for full time

• Reliable internet, a quiet workspace and a working compute

• Organised, proactive and comfortable working independently



Nice to have

• Experience in freight, logistics, courier or e-commerce

• Experience working with Australian businesses

• Familiarity with CRM tools (e.g. Zoho) and helpdesk software

• Experience handling customer disputes or claims



How to apply

Applications without a video will not be considered. Please send your resume along with a short video (1–2 minutes) simply answering:

1. Your name

2. Why you think you fit this role

3. What experience you have

No editing or production needed — we just want to hear you speak and get a sense of who you are.

title: Customer Support VA — Fashion Dropshipping (Shopify + Re:amaze, US store)
description:
About the role



We are a US women’s clothing brand. Our vision is to grow into one of the top names in our space, with a clear target of reaching one million dollars in monthly revenue, and we are building the team to get there. We are specifically looking for someone with a background in fashion dropshipping and hands on experience with Re:amaze, to join us as a Customer Support VA for the long term.



Please read before applying



This role is specifically for someone with real experience in fashion dropshipping and with Re:amaze. If you do not have experience in fashion dropshipping, or you have never worked with Re:amaze, we kindly ask that you do not apply for this particular role, so we can give our full attention to candidates who match these requirements. We truly appreciate your understanding.



What you will do



Answer customer support
s in clear, professional US English through Re:amaze.

Handle returns, exchanges and store-credit requests following our set playbook.

Look up orders in Shopify and check live parcel locations on tracking sites.

Contact our supplier when a parcel is delayed or missing, and follow up until it is resolved.

Maintain a calm, courteous and professional tone at all times, including with difficult customers.

Flag anything unusual (lost parcels, chargebacks, escalations) directly to the owner.



We provide full training on our process, templates and tone.



Growth



This is a long-term position with real room to grow. As the company scales, there are opportunities to take on more responsibility and move into higher roles. We want to build a stable, committed team and promote from within.



Requirements



Experience in fashion dropshipping. You should understand how dropshipping stores operate, including longer shipping times, supplier coordination and the kind of customer questions that come with it.

Hands on experience with Re:amaze.

Excellent written English with a professional, customer-friendly tone.

Reliable, organized and genuinely detail-oriented (as a quick note, please begin your reply with the word “Sunrise”).

Experience with Shopify and customer support.

Able to follow instructions and templates accurately.

Comfortable working independently and asking when unsure.



If this fits you, we would like to hear from you. Tell us briefly about your experience in fashion dropshipping, your experience with Re:amaze, and why you are interested.

title: Social Media Posting Assistant (TikTok & Instagram)
description:
About the Role



I'm looking for a reliable, detail-oriented Social Media Posting Assistant to help manage multiple TikTok and Instagram accounts for an affiliate marketing business.



This is more than simply reposting videos. You'll be responsible for publishing content correctly, following specific instructions, adding required calls to action (CTAs), monitoring post performance, and sharing analytics so we can identify what's working and improve our results.



I'm looking for someone who can follow instructions carefully, communicate consistently, and adapt as our content strategy develops.



Responsibilities



1. TikTok Posting



Manage 8 TikTok accounts.



Publish at least 2 videos per account per day, for a minimum of 16 TikTok posts daily.



Follow the posting schedule and instructions provided.



Add the required CTAs and other requested elements before publishing.



Check that every video has uploaded successfully and appears as intended.



2. Instagram Posting



Manage at least 4 Instagram accounts.



Publish content according to the agreed posting schedule.



Adapt posts to the specific instructions and requirements for each account.



Check that posts have published correctly.



3. Affiliate Marketing Requirements



Follow instructions for affiliate content, including required CTAs, product references, captions, and other elements when requested.



Ensure the correct content and CTA are used for each account.



Pay attention to detail, as small mistakes can affect campaign performance.



Ask questions whenever instructions are unclear rather than making assumptions.



4. Analytics and Reporting



Track and share available post-performance analytics, such as views, likes, comments, shares, saves, and other relevant metrics.



Maintain a simple, organised record of published content and its performance.



Provide regular updates so we can identify which videos, products, accounts, and approaches are performing best.



Flag unusual results, posting issues, or useful patterns you notice.



Help us use performance data to improve our content strategy over time.



You won't be expected to develop the entire marketing strategy independently, but I do want someone who pays attention to results and helps us learn from them.



5. Communication and Reliability

.

title: YouTube Thumbnail Designer - Thumbnails for Viral Story and Commentary Channels
description:
We're hiring a thumbnail designer for our YouTube channels. Our first channel covers viral public i
: the "Karen" confrontations from TikTok and Instagram, told as 10–15 minute stories about who the person was and what it cost them. We'll add channels in other niches over time, so you'll design for different audiences. We're looking for someone to work with us on an ongoing basis.



A thumbnail has one job: make the right viewer click. For each video you'll get the title, a short summary of the story and the footage, and turn them into a thumbnail that reads in under a second on a phone.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



- Find the strongest frame in the footage: the face mid-yell, the moment of the shove, the reaction.



- Clean up stills from low-quality phone video: upscale, sharpen, fix the colour and light, and cut people out when the design needs it.



- Add short, bold text, usually 1–3 words, that adds to the title instead of repeating it.



- Deliver 2–3 versions of each thumbnail so we can test them against each other with YouTube's Test & Compare.



- Check every thumbnail at phone size before you send it.



- Save the layered source file (PSD or similar) next to each export in our shared Google Drive.



- Follow each channel's style guide, and suggest changes when a thumbnail underperforms.



THE STYLE FOR OUR FIRST CHANNEL



- One real frame from the clip, with the person's face large and mid-expression.



- The image enhanced so it looks sharp and bright, without looking fake.



- 1–3 words in a heavy font, bright yellow with a black outline, such as "FIRED!" or "WHAT HAPPENED?", sometimes with a smaller "*UPDATE*" underneath.



- Text on one side and the face on the other. No emojis, borders or clutter: the face does the work.



Every thumbnail must show what really happened in the footage and follow YouTube's thumbnail policies: no blood or graphic injuries, no made-up quotes, and children's faces blurred.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



- A portfolio of YouTube thumbnails you designed, ideally for commentary, news, true crime, drama or reaction channels.



- Strong Photoshop skills (or similar): cutouts, colour grading, text effects and rescuing blurry frames from phone video.



- An eye for what gets clicks. You study what's working in a niche and can explain why a thumbnail works.



- The ability to keep up volume without the quality dropping.



- Good written English, so the words on a thumbnail are short and correct.



- Comfort working with heated footage, some of it offensive.



- Reliable deadlines and clear communication.



- Bonus: experience with YouTube's Test & Compare or with AI upscaling tools.



Workload: To start, 3–5 videos a week, each with 2–3 thumbnail versions. This will grow as we add channels.



Turnaround: Within 24 hours of receiving the title and footage.



HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with the word "guava" and include:



1. Your
 address



2. Your portfolio link (Behance, Google Drive or similar, set so anyone with the link can view)



3. Links to 3–5 YouTube videos that use thumbnails you designed (link the videos, not image files), and the channel each one is for



4. The YouTube channels you've designed thumbnails for, when, and how many thumbnails a week you made for each (or "none yet")



5. Your current workload: how many thumbnails you design in a typical week, for how many clients, and how many more a week you could take on for us



6. A thumbnail idea for this story: a man in a new pickup truck sprays a 17-year-old car wash attendant with a pressure washer over $2, and his company fires him. Describe the frame you'd use and the text you'd put on it, in 2–3 sentences



7. The software you use, including anything for upscaling or cleaning up blurry video frames



8. Your expected rate (per thumbnail or per month)



9. How quickly you usually deliver a thumbnail after receiving a brief, and the hours you work (Philippine time)



10. Your 
 username



Applications that skip the code word or any of items 1–9 won't be reviewed.

title: Part-Time Appointment Setter / Inbound Sales - PHP27K + Uncapped Bonus | Long-Term WFH, Path to Full-Time | AU Maths
description:

We're a fast-growing Australian Maths tutoring company, and we're hiring ONE standout Appointment Setter to join our team long-term. It starts part-time, with a plan to go full-time as we grow. To apply, use the link under HOW TO APPLY at the bottom of this post. It takes about 10 minutes.



THE ROLE

You'll be the first voice parents hear when they enquire about tutoring for their kids. These are warm leads: parents who filled in a form and asked us to call. No cold calling. Your mission: call fast, have a warm, genuine conversation about how their child is going, book them into a complimentary Maths Strategy Session with one of our education consultants, and make sure they show up.



YOUR SHIFT (Philippine time, ~26 hours/week)

Monday: 12:00 PM - 7:00 PM

Tuesday: 12:00 PM - 7:00 PM

Saturday: 6:00 AM - 12:00 PM (yes, an early start)

Sunday: 1:00 PM - 7:00 PM

Wednesday to Friday OFF (for now)

These hours match peak enquiry times in Australia and follow Sydney time. When Australia's clocks change in April, your PH hours move one hour later.



PART-TIME NOW, FULL-TIME AS WE GROW

We plan to make this role full-time as we grow. Full-time adds Wednesday to Friday, 1:00 PM - 4:00 PM PHT (~35 hours/week) at PHP34,500/month base. There's no fixed date, so please only apply if you're free for those hours too.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

Call every new lead within 10 minutes of it arriving on your shift (plus SMS and
)

Have a real conversation: who the help is for, year level, what's been happening in maths

Book consultations into our calendar and confirm both parents can attend

Confirm sessions the day before so booked calls actually show up

Follow up unresponsive leads over several days; reschedule no-shows quickly

Work from one simple setter screen we built for the role: your call list, script and calendar in one place



WHAT WE PAY

PHP27,000/month base (part-time)

Uncapped performance bonus: PHP120 for every booked consult that shows up

PHP34,500/month base when the role moves to full-time

13th month pay + paid training period

Paid twice a month via Wise



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Excellent spoken & written English: clear, warm, and calm on the phone

Experience in inbound sales / appointment setting / call center / customer service (inbound setting is a big plus)

Can guide a conversation to a booking without being pushy

Organised, self-disciplined, and genuinely coachable

Quiet work space, reliable internet (with a backup), and a good headset

Can commit to EVERY shift above, including Saturday 6:00 AM, for the long term



WHY YOU'LL LOVE IT HERE

Permanent, long-term role, not a campaign that ends in 3 months

A clear path to full-time and to grow as we expand the team

Your results directly grow your income (uncapped)

Supportive management, full training, and consistent, predictable hours

Real impact: you're helping kids and families every single day



HOW TO APPLY (about 10 minutes, on a laptop with a microphone)

Apply here: 

1. Fill in your details, confirm your shifts and upload your CV

2. Record two short voice answers right on the page: a quick intro, and what you'd say to a mum who asks "Before I book anything, how much are your lessons?"

That's it. Please apply through the link; messages here aren't reviewed.



WHAT HAPPENS NEXT

1. We review every application within 48 hours.

2. Strong applicants are invited to a paid practice shift (about 1 hour, online, PHP500): a realistic simulation of the role on your own laptop.

3. Those who do well have a short chat with our team, then we make an offer.



Applications close Sunday 8 November. Excited to meet you!

## Architectural Estimator / Project Estimator



**AluGlobus Aluminum Systems** is a growing U.S.-based manufacturer and supplier of aluminum fencing, gates, patio covers, pergola systems, railings, and architectural aluminum products.



We are looking for a **skilled, organized, and detail-oriented Architectural Estimator** to join our team and prepare customer quotes on a daily basis.



This is not just a data-entry position. We need someone who can understand a project, review measurements, photos, drawings, and customer requests, determine what materials are needed, and build an accurate professional quote.



### Responsibilities



- Prepare detailed estimates and customer quotes every day

- Review architectural drawings, plans, measurements, photos, and project information

- Break down fence, gate, railing, patio cover, and pergola projects into the materials and components required

- Calculate quantities, dimensions, and project requirements accurately

- Use Photoshop or similar software to make basic photo edits, markups, and project visualizations

- Communicate with customers by phone when additional measurements, photos, or project information are needed

- Work with our sales team to clarify project requirements

- Keep quotes, drawings, customer information, and project files highly organized

- Double-check estimates before they are sent to customers

- Learn our aluminum systems, profiles, accessories, pricing, and installation requirements

- Handle multiple quotes and projects at the same time while meeting deadlines



### Who We Are Looking For



You should be **very detail-oriented and organized**. Small mistakes in dimensions or materials can affect an entire project, so accuracy is extremely important.



Preferred experience:



- Architecture, estimating, construction, engineering, drafting, or similar background

- Experience reading construction plans and architectural drawings

- Experience preparing material takeoffs or project estimates

- Good understanding of measurements and dimensions

- Photoshop skills

- AutoCAD, SketchUp, or similar design software is a strong advantage

- Strong written and spoken English

- Comfortable speaking with U.S. customers by phone

- Strong computer skills

- Ability to learn new products and systems quickly

- Ability to work independently and solve problems

- Excellent attention to detail



Experience with **fencing, gates, aluminum systems, patio covers, pergolas, railings, construction, or exterior architectural products** is a major advantage.



### What Success Looks Like



You can receive a project with photos, dimensions, drawings, or plans and understand what the customer is trying to build.



You know what information is missing and are comfortable contacting the customer to get it.



You can then break the project down, calculate the required materials, and prepare a **clean, accurate, professional quote** for our sales team and customer.



We are a fast-growing company with a high volume of projects, so we are looking for someone who wants a **long-term position and an opportunity to grow with the company.**

1. Your resume

- Experience managing multiple Shopify stores.

- Understanding of app conflicts and technical performance.



### 8. Analytics, Reporting & Profitability

- Analyze Shopify sales and conversion data.

- Track conversion rate, AOV, LTV, and revenue per visitor.

- Monitor gross profit and contribution margins.

- Analyze customer acquisition cost (CAC).

- Understand ROAS, MER, and blended performance.

- Analyze funnel drop-off rates.

- Identify underperforming products and pages.

- Evaluate product and offer profitability.

- Track upsell conversion rates.

- Monitor abandoned checkout recovery.

- Set up GA4 and Google Tag Manager tracking.

- Use heatmaps and session recordings.

- Build performance dashboards.

- Create weekly reports with actionable insights.

- Make data-driven decisions instead of guessing.



### 9. Funnel Building & Landing Pages

- Build high-converting Shopify sales funnels.

- Create dedicated product landing pages.

- Develop advertorial-style landing pages.

- Build product quiz funnels.

- Create bundle-focused landing pages.

- Optimize cold traffic and returning customer journeys.

- Improve landing page-to-checkout conversion.

- Develop direct-response sales pages.

- Test headlines, hooks, benefits, and calls to action.

- Create personalized landing page experiences.

- Understand traffic source-to-offer alignment.



### 10. Customer Psychology & Direct-Response Marketing

- Strong understanding of customer buying psychology.

- Conversion-focused copywriting.

- Offer positioning and differentiation.

- Benefit-driven messaging.

- Objection handling.

- Emotional triggers and purchase motivations.

- Understanding customer awareness levels.

- Social proof and credibility optimization.

- Price anchoring.

- Ethical urgency and scarcity strategies.

- Risk reversal and guarantee positioning.

- Understanding why customers buy or abandon purchases.



### 11. Testing & Continuous Growth

- Develop CRO testing roadmaps.

- Prioritize tests based on potential revenue impact.

- Run A/B and split tests.

- Test pricing, bundles, upsells, and offers.

- Test product page layouts.

- Test landing page variations.

- Experiment with checkout and cart experiences.

- Analyze test results and statistical significance.

- Document successful strategies.

- Scale winning experiments.

- Continuously identify new opportunities for growth.



### 12. Tools & Platforms



Experience with the following is highly preferred:



- **Shopify:** Shopify Admin, Shopify Flow, Shopify Analytics, Shopify Markets.

- *
 & SMS:** Klaviyo, Omnisend, Postscript, Attentive.

- **Upsells & Bundles:** Rebuy, AfterSell, ReConvert, Zipify OCU, Kaching Bundles, Selleasy.

- **Landing Pages:** Replo, PageFly, GemPages, Shogun.

- **CRO & Analytics:** GA4, Google Tag Manager, Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity, Lucky Orange, Triple Whale.

- **A/B Testing:** Intelligems, Shoplift, Convert.

- **Retention & Reviews:** Recharge, Skio, LoyaltyLion, Yotpo, 
, Loox.

- **Automation:** Shopify Flow, Zapier, Make.

- **Project Management:** ClickUp, Notion, Asana, Google Sheets.



You don't need experience with every single tool, but you must be highly capable of learning, implementing, and optimizing Shopify growth systems independently.



## What We Expect From You



We want someone who is **proactive, analytical, experienced, and obsessed with improving eCommerce performance.**



You should be able to:



- Audit a Shopify store and immediately identify potential revenue leaks.

- Create a clear action plan to increase revenue and profitability.

- Independently implement improvements without constant instructions.

- Understand which changes will have the biggest financial impact.

- Prioritize high-impact improvements over unnecessary tasks.

- Build and manage a complete abandoned cart recovery system.

- Create and optimize offers, bundles, and upsells.

- Continuously test new strategies.

- Monitor performance and report measurable results.

- Take full ownership of store conversion and revenue optimization.

- Work across multiple Shopify stores when needed.

- Think like an eCommerce growth manager, not just a Shopify assistant.



## Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)



Your performance will be evaluated based on improvements in:



- Conversion rate (CVR)

- Average order value (AOV)

- Revenue per visitor (RPV)

- Revenue and contribution profit

- Upsell and cross-sell revenue

- Abandoned checkout recovery rate

-
 and SMS attributed revenue

- Repeat customer purchase rate

- Customer lifetime value (LTV)

- Checkout completion rate

- Add-to-cart rate

- Overall store profitability



## Who We Are Looking For



**Required:**

- Proven experience scaling and optimizing Shopify stores.

- Strong experience with CRO, AOV optimization, and offer creation.

- Experience building abandoned cart and
 recovery automations.

- Ability to work independently and execute improvements.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

- Understanding of eCommerce profitability.

- Experience using Shopify apps and optimization tools.

- Excellent communication skills.

- Results-driven mindset.



**Big Plus:**

- Experience scaling 6-, 7-, or 8-figure eCommerce brands.

- Experience with direct-response eCommerce.

- Experience with paid traffic funnels (Meta Ads, Google Ads, TikTok Ads).

- Experience with subscription-based eCommerce.

- Experience managing multiple international Shopify stores.

- Experience with Shopify Liquid or development.

- Experience running advanced CRO experiments.



## How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



1. How many years of Shopify experience do you have?

2. Which Shopify stores have you personally optimized or scaled?

3. What is your biggest proven improvement in AOV or conversion rate?

4. Explain how you would increase the AOV of a Shopify store.

5. Explain your abandoned cart recovery strategy.

6. Which upsell, CRO, and
 marketing tools have you used?

7. If you were given a Shopify store today, what would be the first 5 things you would audit and optimize?

8. Share examples, screenshots, or case studies showing actual results.

9. What is your expected monthly salary?

10. Are you available for full-time work?



**Important:** We are NOT looking for a beginner, a general virtual assistant, or someone who only knows how to upload products.



We are looking for a **real Shopify growth expert who can identify opportunities, implement improvements, and consistently increase revenue and profit.**



**If you know how to turn Shopify traffic into more customers, larger orders, and repeat purchases, we want to hear from you.**

title: Social Media Operations Manager - (Remote, long-term)
description:
About us

STAIA is a fast-growing, top-rated AI astrology app. Our editors produce short-form videos every day. They are published by a growing network of “social media content posters,” freelancers who run their own Instagram and TikTok accounts and post the content we send them. Hiring new posters is going well. Now we need one person to own the whole posting operation as it scales.



The role

You’ll be the single point of ownership for our poster network. When something goes wrong, content creators and content posters come to you, and you fix it. Our goal is simple: every post goes out, every account stays healthy, and posters know exactly what to do next



What you’ll do



- Make sure all scheduled posts go out on time, every day, across all poster accounts 

- Monitor account health: shadowbans, problems with posting, reach drops

- Spot posters who aren’t performing or aren’t reliable, follow up with them, and report to HR if needed

- Troubleshoot day-to-day issues:
/Meta connection problems, wrong content sent, missed posts, account access

- Be the go-to contact for content posters' questions about posting, and follow up until issues are closed

- Keep the operation structured: clear processes, trackers and checklists so nothing slips as we grow

- Proactively suggest improvements if you see the possibility to do things better. 





Who you are



- High agency: you see a problem, d
 and act without waiting to be told

- Very organized and structured; you build systems instead of firefighting the same issue twice

- Responsible and reliable; when something is yours, it gets done

- A clear, proactive communicator in written English, comfortable following people up

- Able to manage and support others: give direction, unblock people, hold them accountable

- Calm under pressure when many small issues hit at once



This is a long-term project, and we estimate it will take approximately 30-40 hours/week of your time.

Opportunity to teach using globally respected Math and Science curricula.

Access to training and professional development.

Regular enrollment model (not a booking system), ensuring schedule stability and consistency

title: Operations Assistant
description:
Operations Assistant



Location: Remote – Philippines  

Hours: Full-time | 40 hours per week | 5pm–2am Philippines time (aligned with UK working hours)  

Salary: £500–£700 per month, depending on experience and skillset, plus performance bonus and paid UK bank holidays.



About Innermost:



At Innermost, we believe better health comes from finding the right balance between nature and science. Inspired by traditional ingredients and powered by modern, evidence-based research, we've developed a fresh approach to wellness. We combine natural ingredients with cutting-edge science to create products that are effective, transparent and rooted in quality. Our mission is simple: to make better health easy. Founded in London, Innermost has experienced significant growth since launch, and we have ambitious plans for the future. We're building a challenger brand with the ambition to change the way people think about health and wellness. If you'd like to be part of a growing international business and contribute to something ambitious, we'd love to hear from you. Learn more at 



The Role:



We're looking for a highly organised, proactive and detail-oriented Operations Assistant to join our growing team. This is a varied role covering multiple areas of the business, including finance, accounting, supply chain, inventory management, reporting and customer experience. You'll join our existing Operations team, working alongside four other team members who are based remotely in the Philippines and support the day-to-day running of our international business.



This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys taking ownership, solving problems and working across different areas of a business. You'll need to be comfortable managing multiple priorities, working independently and taking responsibility for ensuring tasks are completed accurately and on time.



Key Responsibilities:



Operations >>



- Executing daily, weekly and monthly operational tasks to ensure the smooth running of the business.

- Supporting the coordination and management of internal processes and workflows.

- Identifying opportunities to improve efficiency and streamline processes.



Finance & Accounting >>



- Bookkeeping and maintaining accurate financial records.

- Bank and account reconciliations.

- Managing accounts payable and receivable.

- Supporting financial administration and reporting.



Inventory & Supply Chain >>



- Monitoring inventory levels across products and warehouses.

- Coordinating stock replenishment orders and monitoring deliveries.

- Maintaining accurate inventory records and identifying potential stock shortages.

- Supporting supplier and logistics coordination.



Customer Experience >>



- Managing customer enquiries and providing timely, professional responses.

- Resolving customer issues and escalating matters where necessary.

- Supporting customer retention and customer success initiatives.

- Ensuring customers receive a consistently positive experience.



Reporting & Data Management >>



- Assisting with weekly and monthly management reporting.

- Maintaining spreadsheets, databases and operational records.

- Analysing data and helping identify trends, discrepancies and opportunities for improvement.



Skills & Experience:



- A degree in Business, Management, Finance, Accounting or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.

- Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

- Excellent numerical and analytical abilities.

- Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Excel, including Pivot Tables, lookup functions, SUMIFS and working with larger datasets.

- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.

- Strong organisational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities.

- Ability to work independently, take initiative and solve problems without constant supervision.

- A proactive approach to work, with a willingness to take ownership and responsibility.

- Comfortable working in a fast-paced, ambitious environment with high expectations.

- A positive attitude and willingness to support colleagues and contribute to a team.



Additional Information:



This is a full-time position requiring 40 working hours per week, spread across five days (eight working hours per day, plus a one-hour break). Salary of £500–£700 per month, depending on experience, qualifications and skillset. In addition, you will receive an end-of-year performance bonus and paid time off for eight UK bank holidays, despite not being required to work on those days. Innermost is based in London, United Kingdom, and our core working hours are 9am–6pm UK time. The corresponding Philippines working hours are generally 5pm–2am.



How to Apply:



We'd love to hear from candidates who believe they have the skills, experience and attitude to succeed in this role. Please submit your CV along with some additional information about your experience and skillset. We'd also like you to record a short 60-second video explaining why you believe you'd be a good fit for the position and what you could bring to the team.



Please also answer the following questions when applying:



1. Where do you currently live? Please specify whether you live in a city or a village.

2. What is your internet connection speed, and do you have reliable electricity in your area?

3. What IT equipment do you have available to support your work? For example, Macbook, laptop or desktop computer, additional monitor, headset and backup internet connection.



Please submit your application through the OnlineJobs.ph messaging platform and include a link to your video recording (Loom is preferred). Shortlisted candidates will be contacted regarding the next steps, which may include an interview over Zoom.



**Please follow the application instructions carefully. Applications that do not include the requested information and video may not be considered.**



Thank you, and we look forward to hearing from you.

title: Gaming Product Sourcing Specialist / Online Inventory Researcher
description:
Gaming Product Sourcing Specialist / Online Inventory Researcher



Company: Skylar Racing, Inc.  

Position: Gaming Product Sourcing Specialist / Online Researcher  

Location: Remote (Philippines)  

Job Type: Long-Term / Full-Time or Part-Time  

Compensation: Based on experience, research abilities, and performance



## About Us



Skylar Racing is a U.S.-based live-commerce business specializing in retro video games, modern gaming products, consoles, collectibles, electronics, and other merchandise.



We sell a large volume of products through live auctions on Whatnot and are constantly looking for new inventory to purchase and resell.



We are looking for an extremely internet-savvy, knowledgeable, and motivated individual who can research products, discover profitable inventory opportunities, and provide purchasing recommendations to our team on a daily basis.



This position is primarily focused on video games and gaming-related merchandise, but we are also interested in products that would appeal to gamers, collectors, and our live auction audience.



You must already have a strong understanding of video games, gaming consoles, accessories, gaming collectibles, and online shopping marketplaces.



We are NOT looking for someone who needs to learn what a Nintendo DS, PlayStation Vita, GameCube, or Game Boy Advance is.



We want someone who genuinely understands the gaming industry, enjoys researching products online, and knows how to find interesting merchandise at competitive prices.



## Primary Responsibilities



Your primary responsibility will be to search the internet every working day for products and inventory opportunities that Skylar Racing could purchase and resell through live auctions.



You will spend a significant portion of your day researching websites, comparing prices, identifying suppliers, and sending direct purchasing links to our team.



Responsibilities include:



- Search eBay daily for video game lots, consoles, handhelds, accessories, collectibles, and profitable inventory.

- Research liquidation websites for gaming-related inventory, overstock products, customer returns, and closeout merchandise.

- Search Alibaba for manufacturers, wholesalers, and products suitable for resale.

- Identify gaming accessories and products that could be purchased in bulk and sold individually.

- Discover interesting, unusual, or trending products that would appeal to gamers.

- Compare purchasing prices against realistic resale values.

- Research recent eBay sold listings and other relevant market data.

- Identify bulk deals, undervalued listings, and potential wholesale opportunities.

- Find suppliers offering large quantities of identical products at attractive prices.

- Research international and domestic sourcing opportunities.

- Identify products that could work particularly well in a fast-paced live auction environment.

- Send direct links to potential inventory purchases to our team every working day.

- Maintain an organized daily list of sourcing opportunities in Google Sheets.

- Monitor previously discovered products for price changes, restocks, and new availability.

- Immediately communicate particularly valuable or time-sensitive purchasing opportunities.

- Continuously discover new websites and suppliers rather than relying on the same few sources.



You will not be responsible for purchasing inventory without authorization. Your role is to research opportunities and provide accurate, organized recommendations.



## Daily Product Links & Purchasing Recommendations



This is one of the most important responsibilities of the position.



We expect you to actively search for new inventory opportunities and send links to products that our company could realistically purchase every single scheduled working day.



You should not wait for management to ask you to find products.



Your daily responsibilities will include:



- Continuously searching eBay, Alibaba, liquidation websites, wholesalers, and other marketplaces.

- Sending links to potential purchases throughout your working shift.

- Providing accurate purchase prices, quantities, condition details, and relevant information.

- Explaining why you believe each product is worth considering.

- Identifying opportunities where the purchase price is significantly below realistic resale value.

- Finding products that can be purchased in bulk at attractive prices.

- Locating merchandise that would appeal to our existing gaming and collector audience.

- Keeping an organized list of all potential purchases.

- Ensuring links are active and products are still available when submitted.

- Avoiding duplicate recommendations unless pricing or availability has materially changed.

- Providing a daily summary of the strongest purchasing opportunities discovered.



We expect a consistent flow of new purchasing opportunities.



Our initial target is approximately 10–20 qualified product leads per full working day, depending on the complexity of the research. Quality is more important than volume, and this target may be adjusted as we evaluate the usefulness of your recommendations.



We are not looking for someone who sends random eBay listings or overpriced retail products just to meet a daily quota.



Every submitted link should represent a genuine potential purchasing opportunity supported by research.



If you discover an unusually good deal that could sell out quickly, we expect you to communicate that opportunity immediately rather than waiting until the end of your shift.



At the end of each working day, our purchasing team should have a clear list of new products, suppliers, and potential purchases to review.



Consistently providing useful purchasing links is a core performance expectation for this role.



## Gaming Knowledge Is Required



We are specifically looking for someone who already understands video games and gaming-related merchandise.



You should be familiar with:



- Nintendo handhelds, including Game Boy, Game Boy Color, Game Boy Advance, Nintendo DS, Nintendo 3DS, and related models.

- Sony consoles and handhelds, including PlayStation, PSP, PS Vita, and related accessories.

- Nintendo consoles such as Nintendo 64, GameCube, Wii, Wii U, Nintendo Switch, and newer systems.

- Xbox consoles, controllers, and accessories.

- Retro and modern video game cartridges and discs.

- Console controllers, replacement accessories, adapters, cables, and peripherals.

- Special edition gaming consoles and collectible merchandise.

- Japanese video games, imported consoles, and gaming accessories.

- Console repair tools, replacement parts, and maintenance accessories.

- Gaming-related electronics, gadgets, and collectibles.



You do not need to know the value of every item, but you should have enough gaming knowledge to recognize interesting products, identify potential deals, and research unfamiliar items efficiently.



A strong understanding of Japanese gaming products and retro gaming is particularly valuable.



## Products We Want You to Find



Although gaming is our primary focus, we sell many different types of merchandise.



We are interested in sourcing:



- Retro video games, consoles, and handhelds

- Modern gaming consoles and accessories

- Gaming controllers and replacement parts

- Gaming repair tools and electronics accessories

- Gaming collectibles, figures, and novelty products

- Gaming-themed merchandise and desk accessories

- Gaming room decorations and display products

- Interesting technology products and gadgets

- Unique electronics and useful everyday accessories

- Bulk liquidation and closeout products

- Products that can be purchased cheaply in large quantities

- Unique merchandise that gamers and collectors would be excited to purchase



For example, finding a manufacturer offering an interesting gaming accessory for $2 per unit could be valuable if the product has realistic resale demand and attractive margins.



Finding a bulk lot of retro video games on eBay at a significantly lower price than their realistic resale value could also be valuable.



We are especially interested in unique products, good deals, large quantities, and merchandise that would create excitement during our live auctions.



## Websites & Marketplaces



You should already be comfortable navigating online marketplaces and conducting extensive internet research.



Websites you may regularly use include:



- eBay

- Alibaba

- AliExpress

- Major liquidation and closeout websites

- Wholesale inventory marketplaces

- Manufacturer and distributor websites

- Japanese gaming marketplaces

- International wholesale suppliers

- Specialty retro gaming websites

- Online auction websites

- Other product sourcing and wholesale platforms



You should be able to discover additional sourcing websites independently.



We do not want someone who only knows how to perform basic Google searches.



We want someone who knows how to use search filters, advanced search terms, sold listing history, image searches, marketplace categories, and other research tools to uncover opportunities that may not be immediately obvious.



## Understanding Live Auction Sales



Our company sells merchandise through live auctions, primarily on Whatnot.



Understanding this business model is extremely important.



The products we purchase are not necessarily the same products that traditional online retailers would prioritize.



You should understand that:



- Some products sell quickly because they are recognizable and desirable.

- Interesting products can perform well even if they are inexpensive.

- Bulk quantities can be more valuable to us than a single profitable item.

- A product's perceived value and actual demand both matter.

- Live auction prices may differ significantly from traditional eBay listing prices.

- Purchasing cost, shipping, platform fees, defects, and other expenses affect profitability.

- The ability to repeatedly source a successful product can be extremely valuable.



Experience buying or selling on Whatnot is highly preferred.



At a minimum, you should familiarize yourself with how Whatnot live auctions operate, including how streamers present products and how customers bid.



## Product Research & Profitability



We expect you to evaluate potential purchasing opportunities rather than simply forwarding links.



When recommending a product, you should be able to provide:



1. Product name and description.

2. Direct link to the listing or supplier.

3. Purchase price and currency.

4. Available quantity or minimum order quantity.

5. Estimated shipping costs when available.

6. Relevant product condition information.

7. Recent comparable sold prices or other supporting market data.

8. Estimated resale price or realistic resale range.

9. Potential profitability, accounting for known expenses.

10. A short explanation of why the product could sell well during our live auctions.



You are not expected to know every expense perfectly, but you should identify uncertainties and avoid presenting unsupported resale estimates as guaranteed profits.



We value accurate research far more than exaggerated profit projections.



## Alibaba & Wholesale Sourcing



Alibaba sourcing will also be an important part of this position.



You should be comfortable:



- Searching Alibaba for gaming accessories and unique products.

- Comparing multiple manufacturers offering similar products.

- Identifying suppliers with competitive pricing.

- Reviewing minimum order quantities.

- Understanding basic product customization and private-label opportunities.

- Comparing product quality, specifications, and supplier information.

- Identifying inexpensive products with strong potential resale demand.

- Researching products that could complement our existing merchandise.

- Finding accessories that we could eventually sell under our own brand.

- Understanding that sample costs, international shipping, duties, and product quality affect overall cost.



Previous experience with Alibaba or international product sourcing is highly preferred.



You must also be able to recognize potential counterfeit, trademark, copyright, safety, or compliance concerns and flag those products rather than recommending them for purchase without further review.



## Internet Research Skills



This position requires excellent internet research skills.



You should be capable of navigating websites quickly, opening and comparing multiple listings, using advanced search filters, and organizing large amounts of product information.



You should know how to:



- Search efficiently across many websites.

- Use advanced keywords and search operators.

- Find alternative suppliers for a specific product.

- Use Google Lens or reverse image searches to identify products.

- Compare listings for the same or similar merchandise.

- Identify suspicious or unreliable sellers.

- Find historical sold prices rather than relying solely on asking prices.

- Research products using Japanese or other international websites when necessary.

- Use translation tools to navigate foreign-language listings.

- Identify listings that are duplicates or no longer available.

- Organize research efficiently using Google Sheets.



We are looking for someone who is genuinely skilled at navigating the internet and discovering information independently.



## Speed, Productivity & Organization



Efficiency is extremely important.



We need someone who can research products quickly, identify worthwhile opportunities, and avoid spending excessive amounts of time on unpromising listings.



You should be able to:



- Work efficiently across multiple browser tabs and websites.

- Research multiple product categories during a working day.

- Send new potential purchasing links consistently throughout each shift.

- Maintain an organized record of potential purchases.

- Prioritize opportunities based on estimated profitability and availability.

- Immediately communicate unusually strong or time-sensitive deals.

- Avoid repeatedly submitting the same listings.

- Distinguish high-quality opportunities from ordinary retail listings.

- Consistently produce useful research without needing constant supervision.



Our priority is quality purchasing opportunities, not simply the number of links submitted.



Submitting 10 excellent opportunities is more valuable than submitting 100 random products that would not be profitable.



## Required Qualifications



- Strong existing knowledge of retro and modern video games.

- Excellent internet research and online marketplace navigation skills.

- Familiarity with eBay and online shopping platforms.

- Ability to identify gaming products, accessories, and collectibles.

- Understanding of product pricing and resale value research.

- Familiarity with wholesale and liquidation sourcing.

- Ability to compare listings and identify attractive purchasing opportunities.

- Ability to consistently research and submit potential purchasing links every working day.

- Strong attention to detail.

- Excellent organizational skills.

- Proficiency with Google Sheets.

- Strong written English communication skills.

- Ability to work independently and meet daily expectations.

- Reliable internet connection and computer.

- Willingness to learn new sourcing websites and research methods.

- Ability to accurately document product links, pricing, quantities, and other relevant information.



## Preferred Qualifications



- Experience using Whatnot as a buyer or seller.

- Previous experience sourcing products for e-commerce or resale businesses.

- Experience purchasing or researching video game lots on eBay.

- Experience sourcing products through Alibaba.

- Familiarity with Japanese gaming marketplaces.

- Knowledge of gaming merchandise resale values.

- Experience with liquidation or wholesale product sourcing.

- Understanding of profit margins and inventory purchasing.

- Experience finding clearance, closeout, or bulk inventory deals.

- Familiarity with Google Lens, reverse image searches, and advanced online research.



## What Success Looks Like



A successful employee will:



- Send a consistent stream of qualified purchasing links every scheduled working day.

- Consistently discover products we would realistically consider purchasing.

- Find inventory at prices that allow for attractive resale margins.

- Identify gaming products and accessories with strong customer appeal.

- Discover suppliers or products our team has not previously considered.

- Provide accurate and well-organized research.

- Find useful wholesale and bulk purchasing opportunities.

- Quickly communicate worthwhile deals before they disappear.

- Develop a strong understanding of the types of products that perform well in our live auctions.

- Improve the quality of their purchasing recommendations over time.

- Produce daily sourcing reports that give management actionable opportunities to review.



We are looking for someone who takes initiative and genuinely enjoys the process of hunting for profitable products online.



## How to Apply



Please answer the following questions in your application.



1. Gaming Knowledge



How familiar are you with retro and modern video games? Which gaming consoles, handhelds, accessories, and collectibles do you have the most knowledge about? Please be specific.



2. Previous Sourcing Experience



Have you previously sourced products for resale, researched wholesale inventory, or found deals on eBay, Alibaba, or liquidation websites? Explain your experience and which websites you have used.



3. Internet Research Skills



Describe your process for finding an underpriced product online. Which websites, search tools, browser extensions, or research methods would you use to determine whether it is a good deal?



4. Live Selling Knowledge



Are you familiar with Whatnot or other live auction platforms? Have you purchased or sold anything through live auctions? What do you think makes a product successful in this selling environment?



5. Alibaba Experience



Have you used Alibaba to research manufacturers or wholesale products? If so, describe your experience comparing suppliers, pricing, minimum order quantities, and product specifications.



6. Daily Research Productivity



This position requires sending potential purchasing links to our team every working day. How would you organize your daily research to consistently discover worthwhile opportunities? Approximately how many properly researched product recommendations do you believe you could provide during an 8-hour shift?



7. Practical Research Question



Imagine we want to purchase 100 inexpensive gaming-related accessories that could be sold individually during live auctions.



Where would you look for these products, how would you evaluate them, and what information would you provide before recommending a purchase?



8. Work Availability



What is your daily availability, Monday through Sunday? Are you looking for full-time or part-time employment, and how soon could you begin?



9. Compensation



What is your expected monthly salary in PHP for full-time employment, or your hourly rate for part-time employment?



## Application Test



To demonstrate your research ability, include 3 actual products you discovered online that you believe could be profitable for our business.



At least 2 products should be gaming-related.



For each product, include:



- Product name

- Direct purchasing link

- Current purchase price

- Available quantity, if shown

- Estimated resale price and supporting evidence

- Brief explanation of why you believe it would be a good product for our live auctions



Please do not submit random popular products without considering their potential profitability.



Qualified applicants may be invited to complete an additional paid research assignment.



## Selection Process



We will evaluate applicants based on:



- Gaming knowledge

- Familiarity with online marketplaces

- Research speed and efficiency

- Quality of product sourcing recommendations

- Ability to consistently provide useful daily purchasing links

- Understanding of resale value and profitability

- Ability to identify unique inventory opportunities

- Organizational and communication skills

- Independent problem-solving ability



Previous sourcing experience is valuable, but exceptional gaming knowledge and outstanding internet research skills are equally important.



IMPORTANT: To confirm you have read the full job description, begin your application with the words "SKYLAR SOURCING" before answering the questions above.



We are seeking a reliable, knowledgeable, and highly motivated individual interested in building a long-term working relationship with Skylar Racing.
