title: E-Commerce Customer Support & Order Resolution Specialist
description:
# E-Commerce Customer Support & Order Resolution Specialist



Company: Skylar Racing, Inc.  

Position: E-Commerce Customer Support Specialist  

Location: Remote (Philippines)  

Job Type: Long-Term / Full-Time or Part-Time  

Compensation: Based on experience and qualifications



## About Us



Skylar Racing is a U.S.-based live-commerce and e-commerce company specializing in video games, collectibles, electronics, and a wide variety of other merchandise.



We sell a large volume of products through live auctions on Whatnot and other online marketplaces, including eBay and Shopify.



With a large number of orders and customer interactions, providing excellent customer service is an extremely important part of our business.



We are looking for a highly organized, dependable, and experienced Customer Support Specialist who can manage customer inquiries, investigate order issues, resolve routine problems, and ensure customers receive timely, professional assistance.



This position requires someone who is comfortable working independently, communicating with customers in English, navigating e-commerce platforms, and managing multiple customer issues simultaneously.



We are NOT looking for someone who simply sends generic, copied responses to every customer.



We need someone who can understand an issue, investigate the situation, communicate professionally, and work toward a proper resolution.



## Primary Responsibilities



Your primary responsibility will be to manage customer support inquiries across our selling platforms and help resolve order-related issues efficiently.



You will be expected to monitor customer messages throughout your scheduled working hours and take ownership of assigned support cases until they are resolved or appropriately escalated.



Responsibilities include:



- Responding to customer messages on Whatnot, eBay, Shopify, and other company-approved channels.

- Answering questions regarding orders, shipping, delivery status, and product information.

- Investigating missing, delayed, damaged, or incorrect orders.

- Researching shipment tracking information through USPS, UPS, FedEx, and other carriers.

- Helping customers understand shipping timelines and tracking updates.

- Reviewing customer complaints and determining the appropriate next steps.

- Handling routine refund, return, cancellation, and replacement requests within company policies and assigned authority.

- Escalating refund approvals, disputes, or unusual cases to management when necessary.

- Communicating with our warehouse and shipping departments to investigate order issues.

- Maintaining detailed records of customer conversations and actions taken.

- Following up on unresolved customer complaints until a resolution is reached.

- Identifying recurring customer service problems and reporting them to management.

- Maintaining a professional, friendly, and helpful tone in all interactions.

- Protecting customer information and following company privacy and security procedures.



## Daily Customer Support Responsibilities



You will be expected to actively manage customer support responsibilities every scheduled working day.



We want someone who takes initiative and does not wait for management to remind them to check messages or follow up on existing cases.



Your daily responsibilities will include:



- Reviewing all new customer messages at the beginning of your shift.

- Responding promptly to customer inquiries during scheduled working hours.

- Reviewing outstanding cases from previous shifts.

- Checking tracking information for orders with reported delivery issues.

- Investigating customer complaints using available order details and records.

- Communicating with customers regarding the status of their inquiries.

- Following up with warehouse personnel when physical order verification is needed.

- Identifying urgent issues that require management attention.

- Maintaining an organized record of pending, escalated, and resolved support cases.

- Providing an end-of-shift summary of unresolved issues and any actions needed from management.



Our goal is to maintain an organized customer support process where messages are not overlooked and problems are addressed as efficiently as possible.



## Whatnot Customer Support



A significant portion of this position will involve supporting customers who purchase products during our Whatnot live auctions.



Experience with Whatnot is highly preferred.



You should be able to learn and understand:



- How Whatnot live auctions and purchases work.

- How buyers view their orders and tracking information.

- How to locate relevant order details.

- How to investigate shipping and fulfillment complaints.

- How to respond to product condition concerns.

- How to handle customers reporting missing or incorrect merchandise.

- How to recognize issues that require Whatnot platform support or management involvement.

- How to communicate with customers who purchased multiple products during a livestream.

- How to follow platform policies regarding orders, cancellations, refunds, and disputes.



Because customers purchase products during fast-paced live auctions, some inquiries may involve multiple items, order bundles, product condition disagreements, or confusion about what was purchased.



You must be able to investigate these situations carefully rather than making assumptions.



Accuracy is extremely important.



## Shipping, Tracking & Delivery Issues



A major part of this position will involve resolving shipping-related inquiries.



You should be comfortable reviewing shipment tracking records and explaining carrier updates to customers.



Examples of common situations include:



- A customer says their order has not arrived.

- Tracking has not updated for several days.

- A package is marked delivered, but the customer cannot locate it.

- A customer received the wrong item.

- One or more items are missing from a shipment.

- A package arrived damaged.

- An order has not shipped within the expected timeframe.

- A customer is confused about combined or multiple shipments.

- A shipment has been returned to sender.

- A buyer wants an update on an existing support case.



You should be able to investigate the available information, determine the appropriate next steps, and communicate clearly with the customer.



You must never guarantee a delivery date or promise a refund or replacement without supporting information and appropriate authorization.



## Refunds, Returns & Customer Complaints



You will help manage customer complaints related to refunds, returns, cancellations, and order discrepancies.



Your responsibilities will include:



- Reviewing customer complaints carefully.

- Locating the relevant order information.

- Requesting appropriate supporting details when necessary.

- Identifying whether a request falls within company and platform policies.

- Preparing cases for management approval when required.

- Responding to customers with accurate and professional information.

- Tracking unresolved refund or return cases.

- Following up on cases awaiting warehouse confirmation or management decisions.

- Documenting the final resolution.



You will not have independent authority to issue refunds, cancel orders, offer compensation, or make financial commitments unless explicitly authorized by management.



Our goal is to resolve legitimate customer problems fairly and efficiently while protecting the company from unnecessary losses and preventable mistakes.



## Customer Communication & English Skills



Excellent written English is a requirement for this position.



You will be representing our company when speaking directly with customers, so your messages must be clear, natural, professional, and easy to understand.



We are looking for someone who can:



- Write grammatically correct English.

- Understand customer concerns without requiring repeated explanations.

- Communicate naturally rather than relying entirely on templates.

- Remain polite and professional when customers are frustrated.

- Explain complicated situations using simple, understandable language.

- Recognize when a customer needs additional assistance.

- Ask relevant questions to gather missing information.

- Avoid argumentative, defensive, or disrespectful responses.

- Communicate with management when an issue requires escalation.



You must be comfortable communicating with U.S.-based customers and coworkers.



AI tools may be used when authorized to assist with drafting, but you must independently verify all information and ensure messages accurately address the customer's situation.



## Problem-Solving & Independent Work



We are looking for someone who can investigate problems and take appropriate action without requiring constant guidance.



For example, if a customer contacts us because their package is missing, we do not want someone who simply forwards the message to management without investigating.



We want someone who first reviews the tracking information, checks available order records, determines the likely issue, and identifies the next appropriate step.



Strong candidates will demonstrate:



- Independent problem-solving.

- Attention to detail.

- Good judgment.

- Strong organizational skills.

- Ability to prioritize urgent customer concerns.

- Accountability for assigned cases.

- Willingness to learn new platforms and procedures.

- Ability to recognize situations requiring management approval.



You should be able to handle routine issues independently while knowing when escalation is necessary.



## Customer Support Organization & Reporting



You will be responsible for keeping customer support information organized and accessible.



Depending on company procedures, this may involve Google Sheets, shared documents, platform messaging systems, or customer support software.



You should be comfortable maintaining information such as:



- Customer name or platform username.

- Order number.

- Selling platform.

- Date the issue was reported.

- Description of the problem.

- Actions already taken.

- Current case status.

- Required follow-up.

- Date of resolution.



We expect a daily report that summarizes:



- Number of new customer inquiries.

- Number of inquiries responded to.

- Number of cases resolved.

- Number of outstanding cases.

- Urgent issues needing management attention.

- Common customer complaints or recurring problems.



You should also be capable of identifying patterns that could help us improve shipping, order accuracy, product descriptions, or fulfillment procedures.



## Work Schedule & Availability



We are looking for someone who can maintain a reliable and consistent work schedule.



Because our business and customers are primarily located in the United States, the ability to work scheduled hours that overlap with U.S. business operations is highly desirable.



You should be comfortable:



- Maintaining a consistent schedule each week.

- Communicating with U.S.-based management.

- Responding to assigned customer inquiries during scheduled shifts.

- Attending occasional virtual meetings or training sessions.

- Providing advance notice of scheduling conflicts.

- Managing your responsibilities without constant supervision.



Please include your daily availability when applying.



## Required Qualifications



- Previous experience in customer service, preferably in an e-commerce environment.

- Excellent written English communication skills.

- Familiarity with online shopping platforms and customer order processes.

- Experience handling customer complaints and resolving problems.

- Strong internet research and computer navigation skills.

- Ability to investigate shipping and tracking issues.

- Excellent attention to detail.

- Strong organizational and time-management skills.

- Ability to manage several customer conversations and support cases simultaneously.

- Ability to work independently and follow company procedures.

- Professional and courteous communication style.

- Reliable internet connection and computer.

- Ability to maintain accurate records using Google Sheets or similar tools.

- Willingness to learn Whatnot, eBay, Shopify, and other company platforms.



## Preferred Qualifications



- Previous Whatnot customer support experience.

- Experience with eBay seller support or customer service.

- Shopify order management experience.

- Experience handling a high volume of e-commerce orders.

- Experience with shipping investigations and delivery disputes.

- Familiarity with USPS, UPS, and FedEx tracking systems.

- Experience handling returns, refunds, and damaged merchandise inquiries.

- Experience with customer support ticketing systems.

- Experience working with U.S.-based e-commerce companies.

- Familiarity with video games, collectibles, electronics, or similar merchandise.



Knowledge of video games is helpful but is not required for this position.



## Performance Expectations



A successful employee will consistently:



- Respond to customer messages promptly during scheduled working hours.

- Keep outstanding cases organized and updated.

- Resolve routine issues without unnecessary management involvement.

- Escalate urgent or complicated cases appropriately.

- Communicate professionally and accurately.

- Follow up on unresolved customer complaints.

- Maintain thorough and accurate documentation.

- Avoid making unauthorized promises or financial commitments.

- Help reduce the number of customer issues requiring direct management attention.

- Identify recurring problems and suggest improvements.

- Maintain consistent attendance and reliability.



Performance will be evaluated based on response times, case accuracy, quality of resolutions, customer communication, productivity, and adherence to company procedures.



We prioritize correct resolutions and customer satisfaction over simply closing cases as quickly as possible.



## How to Apply



Please answer all of the following questions.



1. Customer Service Experience



Describe your previous customer service experience. Which companies or industries have you worked in, what types of customer inquiries did you handle, and approximately how many customers or support cases did you manage per day?



2. E-Commerce Experience



Have you previously worked with Whatnot, eBay, Shopify, Amazon, or other online selling platforms? Explain which platforms you used and what responsibilities you handled.



3. Handling Difficult Customers



Describe a situation where you had to deal with an angry or frustrated customer. What was the problem, how did you respond, and what was the final outcome?



4. Missing Package Scenario



A customer contacts us saying their $150 order has not arrived. The tracking information shows the package was delivered two days ago. Explain exactly how you would investigate the situation and what you would communicate to the customer.



5. Customer Response Test



A customer sends the following message:



"I ordered three video games from your Whatnot stream and only received two. This is ridiculous. I've been waiting over a week and nobody is helping me. I want my money back."



Write the exact response you would send to this customer as a customer support representative.



6. Workload & Organization



Imagine you begin your shift with 40 unread customer messages, 15 unresolved cases from the previous day, and several customers requesting urgent updates. How would you prioritize and organize your workload?



7. Independent Problem-Solving



Describe a time you successfully resolved a complicated customer issue without requiring significant assistance from a supervisor. What steps did you take?



8. English Communication



How comfortable are you communicating with customers in written English? Have you previously provided written customer support for customers located in the United States?



9. Availability



What is your availability Monday through Sunday? Are you willing to work scheduled hours that overlap with U.S. Eastern Time? Are you looking for full-time or part-time employment?



10. Compensation



What is your expected monthly salary in PHP for full-time employment, or hourly rate for part-time employment?



## Selection Process



Qualified applicants may be invited to complete a short, paid customer support assessment.



The assessment may include:



- Responding to simulated customer complaints.

- Investigating a sample shipping issue.

- Organizing a small group of support cases.

- Identifying which situations require management approval.

- Drafting professional responses to difficult customer messages.



We will evaluate candidates based on written English, problem-solving ability, customer service experience, accuracy, professionalism, and efficiency.



IMPORTANT: To confirm you have read the entire job posting, begin your application with the words "SKYLAR SUPPORT" before answering the questions above.



We are looking for a reliable, organized, and experienced individual interested in building a long-term working relationship with Skylar Racing.

title: Amazon PPC Specialist
description:
About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Amazon PPC Specialist to manage and optimize advertising campaigns across multiple Amazon accounts.



This is a client-facing role, so the ideal candidate should be comfortable presenting performance updates, explaining strategy, answering client questions, and communicating recommendations clearly.



You will be responsible for day-to-day campaign management, performance analysis, keyword and targeting expansion, and identifying opportunities to improve sales and advertising efficiency. You will work closely with the Amazon Advertising Lead to execute account strategies and ensure campaigns are consistently optimized toward client goals.



Key Responsibilities

* Manage and optimize Amazon PPC campaigns across Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Brands Video, and Sponsored Display.

* Perform regular campaign audits and identify opportunities for optimization and expansion.

* Conduct keyword, search term, competitor, and ASIN targeting research.

* Build and manage brand, non-brand, product targeting, category targeting, and defensive campaigns.

* Monitor and optimize bids, budgets, placements, keywords, and product targets.

* Analyze performance across campaign, keyword, search term, and ASIN levels.

* Track key metrics including Spend, Sales, ACOS, ROAS, TACOS, CTR, CPC, CVR, and Orders.

* Identify high-performing search terms and opportunities for campaign expansion.

* Identify inefficient campaigns and targets and take appropriate optimization actions.

* Monitor budget utilization and ensure spend is aligned with account goals.

* Identify PPC opportunities that can support organic ranking and overall sales growth.

* Consider inventory, pricing, conversion rate, and other factors when analyzing advertising performance.

* Prepare and support weekly and monthly performance reporting.

* Join client calls and present campaign performance, insights, and next steps.

* Explain advertising strategy and performance in a clear and concise way.

* Respond to client questions and provide data-backed recommendations.

* Use AI tools and PPC management software to support analysis, reporting, campaign, optimization, research, and workflow efficiency.

* Clearly document optimizations, findings, tests, and recommended next steps.

title: YouTube Scriptwriter — Unexplained Events & Mysteries
description:
I’m looking for an excellent, independent writer to create engaging YouTube scripts about unusual encounters, strange sightings, and unexplained events.



For examples of the writing quality I’m looking for—simple language, conversational delivery, and storytelling that’s extremely easy to follow—see:



• Carolina Case Files: 

• Lighthouse Mysteries: 

• MrBallen: 



PAY & DETAILS



• $100 USD per script, including research.

• 3,000–3,600 words per script.

• Freelance position with potential for ongoing work.

• Topics and writing guidelines will be provided.



INDEPENDENT WORK



You must handle each script independently, including research, fact-checking, structure, writing, and proofreading.



Every script must be finished and ready for narration when you submit it. I should not need to rewrite sentences, simplify the language, correct factual errors, or restructure the story.



The purpose of this position is to take scriptwriting off my plate. If I have to revise your work, this arrangement does not make sense for me. You need to understand the guidelines and consistently deliver finished scripts independently.



TOPICS



Strange sightings, unexplained events, and unusual encounters. No true crime. Choose stories with safe outcomes for everyone involved.



THE WRITING



Scripts must be extremely easy to follow, engaging, and natural when read aloud. Think of someone telling you a fascinating story in everyday language.



Absolutely no flowery language. None. No poetic descriptions, elaborate metaphors, or sentences dressed up to sound impressive.



For example:



• Don’t write: “An eerie silence draped itself over the sleepy town.”

Write: “The town was quiet.”



• Don’t write: “The moon cast its silver veil across the lonely stretch of asphalt.”

Write: “The moon lit the road.”



• Don’t write: “An icy wave of terror gripped him as he gazed upon the mysterious figure.”

Write: “He was frightened when he saw the figure.”



The writing must not sound AI-generated at all. No robotic phrasing, generic suspense lines, awkward transitions, or repeated points.



I want a strong opening, events presented in a clear order, and interesting details that hold the listener’s attention. Let the events make the story interesting.



Research each topic carefully, provide source links, and distinguish documented facts from witness accounts or speculation. Do not invent details or dialogue. Include pronunciation guides in parentheses for unfamiliar names and places.



TO APPLY



Use Ghost as the subject line of your application and include:



1. Why you would be a good fit, including any relevant writing experience.

2. At least one existing writing sample. Multiple samples are preferred.

3. Links to published videos using your writing, if available, and your role in creating them.

4. Your usual turnaround time for a 3,000–3,600-word script.



I’d like to find a dependable writer for a long-term working relationship.

title: Senior FFull-Stack Developer / Technical Lead – AI Platform Takeover
description:
We are a UK-based company developing a technology platform combining education, e-commerce, user accounts and an AI-powered assessment service.



The platform has already had development work completed by separate web and AI developers. We are now looking for an experienced senior developer to take technical ownership of the project, audit the existing work, consolidate the development environment and continue the platform through to production.



This is not a new build from scratch. Your first responsibility will be to understand, document and safely take over the existing development.



Current technology includes:



 WordPress



 WooCommerce



 TutorLMS



 Cloudways



 GitHub



 Python



 FastAPI



 REST APIs



 AI/LLM integrations



 databases and third-party services



The AI component has been developed separately as a FastAPI-based service and needs to be reviewed and integrated into the wider platform.

Your first assignment



Your first task will be a technical takeover and audit.



You will be required to review all GitHub repositories provided by the existing developers, independently back up the code, assess what is complete or incomplete, review the current web platform and AI service, identify missing dependencies, understand the current architecture, and confirm what is required to bring the system together.

I Development Responsibility



The platform includes an existing AI-powered skin assessment service that has been developed separately using Python/FastAPI. The successful developer will be expected to audit the current AI codebase, assess its quality and completeness, and determine whether it should be continued, refactored or partially rebuilt.



You may also be responsible for ongoing development of the AI functionality, including the assessment pipeline, API logic, prompts/model integrations, testing, optimisation, deployment and integration with the main platform.



We are therefore particularly interested in developers who are comfortable not only integrating AI services, but also taking technical ownership of an existing AI application and continuing its development where required.



You will also need to:



 review Git history and branches;



 assess the Python/FastAPI AI service;



 review the WordPress platform;



 review databases, APIs and integrations;



 review Cloudways/deployment setup;



 identify missing environment variables or credentials;



 identify security issues and technical debt;



 determine what is required to integrate the AI service with the web platform;



 confirm whether the project can be rebuilt and deployed without relying on the previous developers;



 produce a technical audit report;



 provide a clear roadmap for completion.



Once the takeover is completed, the role may continue into ongoing development.

Ongoing responsibilities



The successful developer may take responsibility for frontend and backend development, Python/FastAPI development, API integrations, AI service integration, WordPress customisation, WooCommerce and TutorLMS integration, database development, user authentication, deployment, testing, bug fixing, GitHub management, staging and production environments, documentation, security and backups.

Essential experience



We are looking for someone with strong experience in Python, FastAPI, REST APIs, JavaScript, PHP, WordPress, WooCommerce, MySQL/databases, Git/GitHub, cloud/server deployment, API integrations, debugging existing codebases and taking over projects from previous developers.



Experience with AI/LLM integrations, OpenAI or similar APIs, embeddings, vector databases, machine-learning pipelines or AI deployments would be highly desirable.

Important



We need somebody who is comfortable inheriting somebody else’s code.



Please do not apply if your normal approach is to automatically rebuild a project from scratch before properly reviewing the existing system.



Our priority is to preserve the work already completed and determine what can be reused before making any rebuild decisions.

Please answer these questions when applying



 Tell us about a project where you took over an existing codebase from another developer.



 How would you audit a GitHub repository before maintaining it?



 How would you confirm that a transferred repository contains everything needed to run the application?



 What experience do you have with Python and FastAPI?



 Have you connected an AI or LLM backend to a web application?



 What experience do you have with WordPress, WooCommerce or TutorLMS?



 Have you deployed applications to Cloudways, AWS, DigitalOcean or similar platforms?



 If you were given one web application repository and a separate FastAPI AI repository, how would you approach integrating them?



 How would you identify missing API keys, environment variables or external dependencies?



 What would you aim to achieve within your first five working days?



Please begin your application with:



TECHNICAL TAKEOVER



Applications that do not include this will not be reviewed.

title: YouTube Script Writer and Researcher - 10-15 Minute Breakdowns of Viral Public Incidents
description:
We're hiring a writer who is also a strong researcher to script long-form YouTube videos about viral public i
. These are the "Karen" confrontations you see on TikTok and Instagram: road rage, parking lots, flights, restaurants and stores. Each video tells one story from start to finish: what happened on camera, who the person turned out to be, how they explained themselves, and what it cost them, from losing a job to criminal charges. Videos run 8–15 minutes. We're looking for someone to work with us on an ongoing basis.



The research matters as much as the writing. Every fact in a script must come from a source you can link, and anything that is only one person's claim has to be presented as a claim.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



- Find stories. Each week, pitch 3–5 viral i
 where the person has been publicly identified and has faced consequences, with links. Sources include TikTok, Instagram, X, Reddit, local news and commentary channels.



- Research each approved story into a timeline: the original clip and who posted it, how the person was identified, their apology or excuse, employer statements, police reports, court records and charges, and any updates since.



- Check everything. Confirm identities through news reports or the person's own response, never a guess from the comments. Tell proven facts apart from claims, and say what is still unknown.



- Write the script to be read aloud, in the order below. Mark every point where a clip plays, with the clip's link and timestamps.



- Include a source list with every script: a link for each fact.



- Track stories you've written about and flag new developments for follow-up videos, such as court dates, lawsuits and new statements.



HOW EACH SCRIPT IS BUILT



1. Cold open: the most shocking few seconds of the clip.

2. Hook: one or two sentences that sum up the i
 and tease the consequences.

3. Context: the exact date, time, place and business, who filmed it and what happened before the recording started.

4. The clip, then a short explanation of what we just watched.

5. Who they are: name, age and job as reported, and who identified them.

6. Their side: the apology, statement or excuse, checked against the evidence.

7. The consequences: firing, charges, bail and court dates, business reviews.

8. Closing line: a sharp callback to something earlier in the story.



EXAMPLE OPENING (an imaginary story, to show the style)



[CLIP 0:04–0:09: "It's two dollars! Two!"]

So, you're working the Saturday shift at a self-serve car wash, and a man in a brand-new pickup d
 the token machine has robbed him. Of two dollars. By the end of the afternoon he's hit a 17-year-old attendant with a pressure washer, and by Monday his own company has put out a statement about him. It's March 8th, at a car wash in Mesa, Arizona. The attendant, Jordan, is restocking towels when the man waves him over. Take a look.

[CLIP 0:00–0:52]

According to the police report, the attendant asked him to step back from the machine twice before the hose came up.



The tone is conversational and dry, never shouty, and always on the side of the person being harassed. The humour comes from specific details, not insults.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



- Excellent written English that sounds natural to an American audience when read aloud.



- Real research skills. You can find and read news reports, court record searches, police statements and company announcements, and you know a primary source from a repost.



- Accuracy and care. You attribute claims ("she says", "according to police"), call charges charges and not convictions, and never state a guess as fact.



- Storytelling. You can turn a messy timeline into a script that keeps people watching to the end.



- A dry sense of humour that comes from details, not name-calling.



- Comfort with heated footage, including swearing and racial slurs. Scripts describe slurs and never repeat them.



- Good judgement about privacy. Scripts never include home addresses, phone numbers or details about family members or children.



- Reliable deadlines.



- Bonus: experience writing or researching for YouTube commentary, true crime or news channels, or you already watch channels like That Danesh Guy.



Workload: To start, 2 scripts a week, each about 1,200–2,000 words, plus weekly story pitches.



Turnaround: Each script is due within 3 days of its story being approved.



HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with the word "papaya" and include:



1. Your
 address



2. Links to 1–3 scripts or long-form pieces you've written (Google Docs set so anyone with the link can view)



3. Links to any YouTube channels or videos you've written or researched for, what you did and when (or "none yet")



4. A short research sample: pick a viral public i
 from the last 6 months where the person was identified and faced consequences, and give its timeline in 5–8 bullet points with a source link for each point



5. A sample opening for that same i
 (60–100 words), written to be read aloud



6. Your expected rate (per script of about 1,500 words, or per month)



7. How many scripts a week you can take on, and your usual working hours (Philippine time)



8. Your 
 username



Applications that skip the code word or any of items 1–7 won't be reviewed.

title: Head of Marketing – Meta Ads Specialist (Messenger Campaigns + GoHighLevel)

Up to now I've run every ad account myself. We're growing and I no longer have the time, so I'm hiring someone to take my place. This is not a side gig. You'll be our Head of Marketing, own the marketing side of the business, and build a team under you as we grow together.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Launch, manage, and scale Meta Messenger campaigns for our mobile detailing clients

- Own the GoHighLevel side: pipelines, automations, follow-up, and booking

WHAT YOU NEED

- Proven results running Meta ads for local, service-based businesses

- Hands-on experience with Messenger / click-to-message campaigns

- Expert-level GoHighLevel skills

- Looking for a full-time, long-term role (40 hrs/week). No part-time or side gigs.

- Some overlap with US Mountain Time working hours

- Self-driven. You don't need me to tell you what to do next.



SHOW ME, DON'T TELL ME

I'm not hiring based on a resume. I want to see what you can do.



Final step before hiring: you'll run a fresh Messenger campaign for one of our detailing clients for 7 days (we cover the ad spend, and the trial is paid). If you book 5 appointments in that week, you qualify for the role.



WHAT YOU GET

- A full-time, long-term position with a clear path to leading a team

- Pay that reflects what you're worth, plus performance bonuses as we grow

- Direct work with the founder. Your ideas will shape the company.



HOW TO APPLY

Start your message with the word "BOOKINGS" so I know you read this. Then include:

1. 2–3 case studies from local service businesses, with Ads Manager screenshots (spend, cost per result, ROAS)

2. A short Loom video (under 5 min) walking through one campaign you ran and why it worked

Applications without proof of results will not be reviewed.

We're looking for an experienced, proactive and detail-oriented SEO Specialist to join our growing digital marketing team.

We're particularly interested in someone who understands how SEO is evolving, enjoys problem-solving, and is comfortable using technology and automation to improve efficiency and campaign outcomes.



If you're someone who takes pride in your work, communicates well and doesn't need to be micromanaged, we'd love to hear from you.



Key Responsibilities

3. Content & Blogging

- Identify topical authority and content cluster opportunities.

- Ensure content is well-structured, engaging and optimised for search.

- Review and edit content to maintain high editorial and grammatical standards.



IMPORTANT – Application Instructions



Before applying, make sure you include "Cool jellybeans" at the very top of your application. It's a little way for me to make sure you've taken the time to read the full job description!



4. GEO & AEO (AI Search)



- Understand Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO) and Answer Engine Optimisation (AEO).

- Identify opportunities to improve brand visibility across AI-powered search platforms, including ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Perplexity and other emerging platforms.

- Understand how structured content, topical authority, entity optimisation and credible sources influence AI search visibility.

- Keep up to date with developments in AI search and the changing search landscape.



5. Automation & Technology



- Identify opportunities to automate repetitive SEO tasks and improve workflow efficiency.

- Have a working understanding of automation platforms and tools such as Make, Zapier or n8n.

- Understand how AI tools and automation can be incorporated into SEO workflows.

- Be comfortable working with HTML and understanding how websites function.

- Demonstrate an interest in emerging SEO tools, technologies and processes.



6. Reporting & Communication



- Monitor keyword rankings, organic traffic and other key SEO performance metrics.

- Interpret SEO data and identify actionable opportunities.

- Prepare clear, accurate and meaningful client reports.

- Communicate campaign progress, challenges and recommendations to the wider team.

- Collaborate with other team members to deliver client outcomes.



Skills & Experience



Essential Requirements



- Minimum 2 years of practical SEO experience.

- Previous experience working within a digital marketing agency is highly regarded.

- Strong understanding of technical SEO and on-page optimisation.

- Good knowledge of keyword research, search intent and content strategy.

- Experience with SEO content writing, optimisation and blogging.

- Working knowledge of HTML and basic website code.

- Understanding of SEO automation and workflow efficiencies.

- Familiarity with Google Search Console and Google Analytics 4.

- Strong written and spoken English.

- Excellent attention to detail.

- Strong communication and problem-solving skills.

- Ability to work independently and as part of a team.



Highly Regarded



- Experience with GEO and AEO.

- Experience with WordPress and other CMS platforms.

- Knowledge of schema markup and structured data.

- Experience with Make, Zapier, n8n or similar automation platforms.

- Familiarity with tools such as Ahrefs, SEMrush, Screaming Frog, Ubersuggest or similar.

- Understanding of Google algorithm updates and emerging SEO trends.

- Experience managing multiple SEO campaigns simultaneously.



The Person We're Looking For



Technical skills are important, but attitude and approach matter just as much.



We're looking for someone who is:



- A problem solver: You don't just identify problems; you look for solutions and take initiative.

- A strong communicator: You can explain technical concepts clearly and communicate effectively with colleagues and clients.

- Detail-oriented: You take pride in producing accurate, high-quality work.

- Proactive: You stay informed about SEO developments and actively look for ways to improve.

- A team player: You collaborate, share knowledge and contribute positively to the team.

- Curious: You're interested in technology, automation and how AI is changing the search landscape.

What We Offer

How to Apply

In your video, please cover the following:

title: Clip Editor – Stream Clips to Vertical Shorts for TikTok, Reels & YouTube Shorts (50-100+ clips/week, ongoing, remote)
description:
I send you clips from a streamer’s channel, and you turn them into polished vertical shorts for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and other platforms. The clips are already picked. Your job is to trim, frame, caption, and export. This is ongoing weekly work for the right person.



THE JOB



You’ll get a sheet of clip links from the streamer’s clips page, with IN/OUT points within each clip and the line being clipped

50+ clips per week, delivered in batches of 10–15

One export per clip works across TikTok, Reels, and Shorts

Expected pace: about 10 clips per hour once you’re set up. If a clip takes you 20 minutes, this isn’t the right fit.



OUTPUT SPECS



9:16 vertical, exported at 1080×1920

Always crop to fill, never letterbox. Scaling the crop up to 1080×1920 is expected.

Layout: [facecam only / facecam stacked over gameplay]. A reference clip is provided.

Length: 15–50 seconds

Captions: burned in, 2–4 words per line, high contrast, [font / color / position]. A template is provided.

Keep captions and faces inside platform safe zones, clear of the TikTok/Reels buttons and caption area

Audio normalized to [-14 LUFS]

Export: MP4, H.264, [30/60] fps



QUALITY BAR



Cuts land within 0.5s of the IN/OUT points. Use that window to start and end on a clean word. Mid-word openings are the most common rejection.

The hook is visible in the first 1.5 seconds. If the clip doesn’t allow that, flag it in your batch notes instead of guessing.

Framing is head-and-chest, centered in the upper part of the frame, never cropped at the eyes. Any exceptions will be noted in the sheet.

Captions match the audio exactly. Fix auto-caption errors on names, slang, game terms, and crosstalk. A glossary of names and terms is provided.

Flag any clip that’s missing its setup, has muted audio, or is too low quality to use.



WHAT TO CUT AROUND



Ads, sponsor reads, or brand promo segments

BRB screens, countdowns, intro stings, or raid shoutouts

Dead air. Five seconds of silence in a clip means it’s wrong.



If any of these fall inside a clip, remove them with a clean jump cut, or flag the clip if removing them breaks it.



PAY AND TERMS



Paid test batch: 10 clips (about 1 hour) at $3.35/hour

Ongoing: $3.25–4.50/hour, about 10-15 hours per week for 50-100+ clips (roughly $150–250/month)

Hours tracked per batch [time tracker / reported hours]

Paid every Friday via PayPal, crypto or others.

One revision round per clip.

24-hour turnaround per batch



REQUIREMENTS



Video editing experience, with a portfolio of short-form vertical work (TikTok, Reels, or Shorts)

A computer that can smoothly edit and export 1080p footage

Editing software that supports reframing, burned-in captions, and audio normalization (Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, CapCut desktop, or similar)

A reliable internet connection for downloading clips and uploading batches on time

Familiarity with platform safe zones and short-form caption styles

Clear, responsive communication

title: Software User Tester (US Real Estate App) - Full-Time, 40 hrs/week, $3.50/hr
description:
THE JOB IN ONE SENTENCE



Use Lot Decoder all day, in every US state, the way real agents, investors and builders do, and find every wrong answer, broken screen and confusing word before our users do.



- Hours: full time, 40 hours a week, Monday to Friday

- Pay: $3.50/hr, as an independent contractor

- Where: remote, Philippines-based

- Team: you find the problems. A Zoning Reviewer fixes zoning numbers and a Price Accuracy Checker fixes prices. Everything else goes to the owner.



WHAT IS LOT DECODER?



Agents, investors and builders type in an address. Lot Decoder tells them what they can build on that lot and what it might cost and earn, in any US city. Deal Finder searches a whole city for empty lots that could make money. If any of that is wrong, someone could lose real money on a bad deal. Your job is to find it first.



WHAT WE EXPECT FROM YOU



This is a high-output role. These are the numbers you'll be measured on every week.



- Deal Finder searches: Weeks 1–2: 60 a week; Weeks 3–4: 80 a week; Week 5 on: 100 a week

- Full reports opened and checked: Weeks 1–2: 20 a week; Weeks 3–4: 35 a week; Week 5 on: 50 a week

- Different US states covered: Weeks 1–2: 3 a week; Weeks 3–4: 4 a week; Week 5 on: 5 a week (all 50 states in about 10 weeks)

- Confirmed defects filed: Weeks 1–2: 15 a week; Weeks 3–4: 25 a week; Week 5 on: 30 a week

- Defects the owner can repeat from your steps: 90%

- Fixed defects re-tested: within 1 business day

- Stop-ship defects reported: within 1 hour



What counts as a confirmed defect: a real problem that someone else can see by following your steps. Duplicates, guesses and "I think this might be wrong" without proof don't count. One real wrong-money defect is worth more than ten typos.



As the app gets better, defects get harder to find. The defect target will be reset with you every month so it stays tough but fair.



Missing the weekly targets two weeks in a row means we talk about whether the role is a fit.



YOUR DAILY ROUTINE



Step 1: Start of day (15 minutes)



1. Open the Team page (
/#/team), pick "Test plan" and tap Clock in. Your hours count automatically from here.

2. Open the Defects card. Re-test every report marked Fixed (see "How to re-test a fix" below).

3. Read "Test plan for today" on the Team page: today's new city, the repeat city and the focus. Tap Next to open Deal Finder already set to that city.



Step 2: Run Deal Finder searches (about 3 hours)



Run 20 searches a day: 1 or 2 in today's new city, and the rest as repeats in cities already searched (try a different ZIP code, lot size or development type). Repeats cost us much less and still test the app. If you see "today's budget reached", move on to Step 4. For each search:



1. Open Deal Finder in Lot Decoder and type the place from your test plan.

2. Time it. Write down how long until the first lots show, and how long until the search finishes.

3. Check the top 5 cards and 2 random cards from lower down. For each card, check:

   - Is it a real, empty lot? Open the map or aerial photo. A house, building or parking lot on it is a defect.

   - Is it in the place you searched? A lot from another city or ZIP code is a defect.

   - Is it really for sale (for-sale cards)? Open the listing link. Sold, pending or a dead link is a defect.

   - Is it government land? Owner names like "City of...", "County of...", "State of..." or "Housing Authority" are defects.

   - Does the zoning label make sense? Compare the card's zone with the county's official zoning map. A different zone is a Zoning defect.

   - Do the owner and mailing details make sense (off-market cards)?

   - Does every link and button work?

   - Can a first-time user understand every word? Anything confusing is a Wording defect.



Step 3: Open full reports (about 3 hours)



Open 10 reports a day, all from lots in that day's Deal Finder results: 5 by clicking the card, and 5 by typing that lot's address into the home page.



For each report:



1. Check the lot: is the outline on the map the right lot? Is the address right?

2. Check the zoning numbers (lot size, height, setbacks) against the county zoning map and the city code. File any that look wrong as Zoning defects with the code link.

3. Check the sales the report used: are they real sales nearby, of the same property type the report plans to build (house, townhome, condo, apartments, retail or industrial)? Any that are far away or a different type go in as Price defects. If the finished sale price looks far above or below similar sold properties nearby, file it as a Price defect too. Don't do the full price check yourself; the Price Checker does that.

4. Read every sentence. Anything that contradicts another part of the report, or that a beginner wouldn't understand, is a defect.

5. Try every button: save, share, presentations, offer letter and contact owner. Don't send anything to a real owner, agent or customer.



Step 4: Try to break it (about 1 hour)



Every day, try 5 things a real user might do by mistake:



- type an address with a typo, no city, or a unit number

- search a tiny town, a rural county, or a place with no empty lots

- use your phone in portrait and landscape

- go back, refresh or switch tabs in the middle of a search

- run two searches at once in two tabs



Step 5: File every defect the same day



Every defect gets one report: tap "Something look wrong? Report a problem" at the bottom of the page, on the page where you found it. See "How to file a defect" below. File Stop-ship defects within 1 hour, and also message Debbie in Skool right away.



Step 6: End of day (5 minutes)



1. On the Team page, tap Clock out. Your hours, searches, reports and defects are counted automatically and show in the Team feed.

2. Message Debbie in Skool with 2 lines: the worst thing you found today, and anything blocking you.



HOW TO FILE A DEFECT



One report per problem. Write these in the report box, one per line, and tap "Add a screenshot".



- Date: Today's date

- Type: Zoning, Price, Wrong lot, Not empty, Not for sale, Government land, Slow, Broken, Wording, Other

- Severity: Stop-ship: wrong money, wrong lot, a crash, or something a user could lose money on. Major: wrong information that a careful user might catch. Minor: wording, layout or a small glitch.

- Where: The full address or place searched, and the page link

- Steps: Numbered steps someone else can follow to see it

- Expected: What should have happened

- What happened: What actually happened, with the exact numbers or words

- Proof: A screenshot, plus a link to the official source (zoning map, code, sold listing)

- Device: Phone or computer, and the browser



Where it goes: Zoning defects go to the Zoning Reviewer, Price defects go to the Price Accuracy Checker, and everything else goes to the owner. The Type you write routes it. You don't need to message anyone except for Stop-ship defects.



Before filing: check the Defects card for the same address or problem. If it's already there, don't file it twice.



HOW TO RE-TEST A FIX



1. Follow the report's Steps exactly.

2. If the problem is gone, mark it Passed in the Defects card.

3. If it's still there, mark it Failed and file a new report with a new screenshot that mentions the first one.

4. Also check one other place with the same kind of problem (another city, another lot). If it shows up there, file a new report and mention the first one. Fixes must work everywhere, not just on one address.



RULES



1. Never contact a real owner, seller, agent or customer. Contact tools are tested only up to the final send button.

2. Use only the test account the owner gives you, and stay under the daily search limit. Searches cost real money.

3. Proof beats opinion. Every Zoning or Price defect needs an official link or a real sold listing.

4. Report what you see, not what you guess the cause is.

5. Keep everything confidential: the app, its numbers, and every defect report.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



- You've done software testing (QA), or you've worked in US real estate support and are relentlessly detail-minded.

- You know how to read a US county parcel map or a listing, or can learn it in your first week.

- You write steps so clearly that someone else can repeat them the first time.

- You stay sharp doing the same kind of check 100 times a week.

- A plus: experience with US zoning maps, US real estate, or testing mobile apps.



TRAINING IN YOUR FIRST 30 DAYS (PAID)



1. Finish all 8 Lot Decoder courses and their quizzes in our Skool community within your first 30 days.

2. Be active in the community: introduce yourself, then make at least 3 helpful posts or replies a week.

3. Course time is paid at your normal hourly rate once your access is on. On the Team page, pick "Training" when you clock in. Studying before your access is on is optional and unpaid.

4. In the community, label yourself as "Lot Decoder Team". Never pose as a customer.



HOW IT STARTS



1. Paid trial: 4 hours on the live app, paid at $3.50/hr. File as many confirmed defects as you can. We grade every one.

2. 90 days: we review your defect count, quality and weekly targets together.

3. Contract: independent contractor agreement with confidentiality and work-for-hire terms.



TO APPLY



Send:



1. A few lines about your testing or real estate experience.

2. Confirm that $3.50/hr for 40 hours a week works for you.

3. One defect you found in any website or app, written with Steps, Expected and What happened.

title: YouTube Scriptwriter — Mysteries & Unexplained Events
description:
I’m looking for a strong, independent writer to create engaging YouTube scripts about strange sightings, unexplained events, and unusual encounters.



For examples of the writing quality I’m looking for—simple language, conversational delivery, and storytelling that’s extremely easy to follow—see:



• Carolina Case Files: 

• Lighthouse Mysteries: 

• MrBallen: 



PAY & DETAILS



• $100 USD per script, including research.

• 3,000–3,600 words per script.

• Freelance position with potential for ongoing work.

• Topics and writing guidelines will be provided.



INDEPENDENT WORK



You must be able to handle the entire script yourself: research, fact-checking, structure, writing, and proofreading.



Scripts must be complete and ready to narrate when submitted. I should not need to rewrite sentences, simplify the language, correct factual errors, or restructure the story.



The purpose of this position is to take scriptwriting off my plate. If I have to revise your work, this arrangement does not make sense for me. You need to understand the guidelines and consistently deliver finished scripts independently.



TOPICS



Strange sightings, unexplained events, and unusual encounters. No true crime. Choose stories with safe outcomes for everyone involved.



THE WRITING



Scripts must be extremely easy to follow, engaging, and natural when read aloud. Think of someone telling you a fascinating story in everyday language.



Absolutely no flowery language. None. No poetic descriptions, elaborate metaphors, or sentences dressed up to sound impressive.



For example:



• Don’t write: “An eerie silence draped itself over the sleepy town.”

  Write: “The town was quiet.”



• Don’t write: “The moon cast its silver veil across the lonely stretch of asphalt.”

  Write: “The moon lit the road.”



• Don’t write: “An icy wave of terror gripped him as he gazed upon the mysterious figure.”

  Write: “He was frightened when he saw the figure.”



The writing must not sound AI-generated at all. No robotic phrasing, generic suspense lines, awkward transitions, or repeated points.



I’m looking for a strong opening, a clear sequence of events, and interesting details that keep people listening. Let the events make the story interesting.



Research each topic carefully, provide source links, and distinguish documented facts from witness accounts or speculation. Do not invent details or dialogue. Include pronunciation guides in parentheses for unfamiliar names and places.



TO APPLY



Use Ghost as the subject line of your application and include:



1. Why you would be a good fit, including any relevant writing experience.

2. At least one existing writing sample. Multiple samples are preferred.

3. Links to published videos using your writing, if available, and your role in creating them.

4. Your usual turnaround time for a 3,000–3,600-word script.



I’m hoping to find a reliable writer for a long-term working relationship.

title: Experienced YouTube Shorts & Instagram Reels Video Editor — FAST Turnaround
description:
Experienced YouTube Shorts & Instagram Reels Video Editor — FAST Turnaround



Company: Skylar Racing, Inc.  

Position: Senior Short-Form Video Editor & Content Creator  

Location: Remote (Philippines)  

Job Type: Long-Term / Full-Time or Part-Time  

Compensation: Based on experience, editing quality, and production speed



## About Us



Skylar Racing is a fast-growing U.S.-based live-commerce and e-commerce company specializing in retro video games, modern gaming products, collectibles, electronics, and other merchandise.



We are actively expanding our presence on Instagram, YouTube, and other social media platforms.



We are looking for a highly experienced, extremely efficient video editor who specializes in creating professional, engaging, high-retention YouTube Shorts and Instagram Reels.



We are NOT looking for a beginner. We need someone who already knows how to create excellent short-form content and can deliver high-quality edits quickly.



This is not strictly an editing position. We also need someone who can independently come up with creative, interesting, and potentially viral video ideas for our social media channels.



## What You'll Be Editing



Our content primarily consists of:



- Retro and modern video game videos

- Rare and expensive collectible showcases

- Interesting products and merchandise

- Behind-the-scenes business content

- Live auction and Whatnot highlights

- Product unboxings and demonstrations

- Educational and entertaining gaming content

- Viral-style Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts



Most videos will be approximately 15–90 seconds long.



We provide the original footage. Your responsibility is to transform that footage into engaging, polished, ready-to-post content.



You will also be responsible for recommending new video concepts that our team can film.



## Responsibilities



- Edit short-form videos specifically for Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts.

- Create strong hooks within the first 1–3 seconds to capture attention.

- Remove unnecessary pauses, filler words, awkward moments, and dead space.

- Add clean, engaging, professionally animated subtitles.

- Incorporate appropriate zooms, transitions, motion graphics, and visual effects.

- Add sound effects and music when appropriate.

- Find and insert relevant B-roll, product images, screenshots, and other supporting visuals.

- Improve audio quality, lighting, exposure, and color consistency when necessary.

- Understand pacing, storytelling, and viewer retention.

- Make editing decisions that increase watch time and keep viewers engaged.

- Follow branding guidelines while maintaining a clean, professional appearance.

- Create content that feels natural and premium, not overly edited or artificial.

- Deliver finalized videos in 1080 × 1920 vertical format.

- Organize project files and provide revisions when necessary.

- Communicate clearly and consistently about assignments and deadlines.

- Independently research and suggest new video ideas for our channels.

- Recommend hooks, video structures, filming techniques, and content angles that could improve performance.



## Video Ideas & Content Development



In addition to editing, you must be capable of consistently generating creative video ideas.



We do not want an editor who simply waits for footage and instructions every day.



We want someone who actively contributes to the growth of our social media presence by researching trends, studying successful content, and suggesting new videos for our team to create.



Your responsibilities will include:



- Regularly researching successful Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and other short-form content.

- Identifying trending video concepts that could be adapted to our gaming, collectibles, and e-commerce content.

- Developing original, interesting, and attention-grabbing video ideas.

- Providing clear concepts that explain what we should film and why viewers would find the video interesting.

- Suggesting strong opening hooks and titles for each idea.

- Recommending specific camera angles, shots, or footage needed to execute the idea.

- Identifying opportunities to turn existing footage into additional content.

- Studying competitors and successful creators to identify content opportunities.

- Recommending improvements to our existing videos based on performance and viewer engagement.

- Helping us establish a consistent pipeline of new content ideas.



We expect you to proactively contribute ideas on a regular basis rather than needing to be asked.



For example, if you notice a particular style of retro gaming video performing well on social media, you should be able to suggest how Skylar Racing could create its own original version.



Ideally, you should provide a brief description, suggested hook, filming requirements, and an explanation of why the concept could perform well.



The ability to generate strong video concepts is a requirement for this position, not an optional bonus.



## Speed Is Extremely Important



We are specifically looking for an editor who can work FAST without sacrificing quality.



Our goal is to publish content consistently, and we need someone who can keep up with a high-volume editing workflow.



You should be capable of:



- Completing straightforward short-form edits within 24 hours of receiving footage and instructions.

- Editing multiple videos per working day when footage and editing complexity allow.

- Working on multiple projects without losing organization or quality.

- Prioritizing urgent assignments and meeting agreed deadlines.

- Making requested revisions efficiently.

- Working independently without constant instructions or supervision.



We are not interested in waiting several days for a basic 30–60-second Reel.



Please be realistic about your editing speed. We will evaluate both the quality of your work and how efficiently you complete assignments.



## Required Qualifications



- At least 3 years of professional video editing experience, or an equivalent portfolio demonstrating advanced skills.

- Extensive experience editing YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, or TikTok videos.

- Advanced proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, CapCut, or comparable professional editing software.

- Strong understanding of viral short-form content, viewer retention, and social media trends.

- Excellent caption animation and motion graphics skills.

- Ability to create visually appealing videos without excessive effects or unnecessary distractions.

- Strong storytelling skills and attention to detail.

- Ability to independently develop and pitch creative video concepts.

- Ability to research content trends and identify opportunities for original videos.

- Strong understanding of what makes someone stop scrolling and watch a video.

- Ability to find and incorporate relevant supporting images and B-roll.

- Excellent understanding of music, sound effects, audio mixing, and timing.

- Ability to work quickly while maintaining consistently high standards.

- Reliable internet access and a computer capable of handling professional editing workloads.

- Strong English comprehension and communication skills.

- Ability to work independently and follow instructions precisely.



## Preferred Skills



- Experience editing gaming, technology, collectibles, or e-commerce content.

- Experience creating viral videos with significant organic views.

- Experience developing short-form content strategies and video concepts.

- Ability to analyze why certain videos perform better than others.

- Advanced masking, tracking, and motion graphics experience.

- Experience creating Instagram Reel and YouTube Shorts thumbnails.

- Understanding of YouTube and Instagram content formatting and safe zones.

- Ability to recommend better hooks, pacing, and video structure.

- Familiarity with trends without relying on repetitive editing templates.



## Editing Style We're Looking For



We want high-quality, engaging content that looks professionally edited.



Our preferred style includes:



- Fast-paced editing when appropriate

- Attention-grabbing opening hooks

- Clean, readable subtitles

- Smooth transitions and natural visual movement

- Relevant product close-ups and B-roll

- High-quality audio and sound design

- Strong storytelling and intentional pacing

- Natural-looking colors and realistic visuals

- Professional presentation without excessive effects



We do NOT want overly flashy, chaotic, cartoonish, or obviously AI-generated-looking videos.



Every effect should serve a purpose. We value strong editing decisions over unnecessary visual clutter.



## What Success Looks Like



A successful editor will consistently:



- Deliver content on time.

- Produce professional videos with minimal revisions.

- Understand the intended style without needing repeated explanations.

- Identify and remove boring or unnecessary footage.

- Make thoughtful decisions about hooks and storytelling.

- Maintain consistent quality across multiple videos.

- Proactively supply creative and actionable video ideas.

- Research trends and identify potential content opportunities.

- Suggest improvements based on actual video performance.

- Help us increase our output of high-quality short-form content.



## How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



1. Portfolio



Provide links to at least 3–5 short-form videos you personally edited. We strongly prefer YouTube Shorts and Instagram Reels rather than traditional long-form videos.



2. Experience



How many years have you been professionally editing videos? Which editing programs do you use most frequently?



3. Editing Speed



Approximately how long does it take you to complete a polished 30–60-second Instagram Reel when provided with raw talking-head footage?



4. Daily Production Capacity



How many professional-quality Shorts or Reels could you realistically complete during an 8-hour working day?



5. Previous Results



Have any videos you edited achieved 100,000, 500,000, or 1,000,000+ views? If so, provide examples and explain your specific role in editing them.



6. Video Ideas & Creativity



In addition to editing, you will be expected to regularly come up with new video ideas. Describe your experience developing content concepts, researching trends, and suggesting videos for social media channels.



7. Creative Test



Provide 3 original YouTube Shorts or Instagram Reels ideas that you believe would perform well for a company that sells retro video games, modern gaming products, and rare collectibles.



For each idea, briefly explain the concept, the opening hook, and what footage we would need to film.



8. Compensation



What is your expected monthly salary for full-time work, or your hourly/project rate for part-time work?



9. Availability



What hours are you typically available to work, and how soon could you begin?



## Selection Process



Qualified applicants may be asked to complete a short, paid editing test using footage provided by our company.



The purpose is to evaluate:



- Editing quality

- Creative decisions

- Hook development

- Caption quality

- Sound design

- Attention to detail

- Turnaround time

- Ability to follow instructions

- Ability to generate original and engaging video ideas



Applicants who demonstrate exceptional editing quality, speed, and creativity will receive priority consideration.



IMPORTANT: To confirm you have read this entire job posting, begin your application with the words "SKYLAR EDITOR" before answering the questions above.



We are seeking a reliable, talented, and creative editor interested in developing a long-term working relationship with our company.

title: WordPress SEO Specialist
description:
I own two established WordPress content sites, 
 (fishing) and 
 (recipes), and I’m hiring an intermediate SEO specialist to find what is holding back their Google rankings, fix the technical problems, and write clear SOPs. My full-time VA will handle the repetitive article updates using your SOPs, so I need someone who can diagnose problems, fix them, and explain them simply. You will report directly to me.



About the sites




: about 400 expert-written fishing articles with a solid backlink profile. Organic traffic is low, and about half its pages show as “crawled, currently not indexed” in Search Console.

Technical SEO audit covering crawl, indexing, sitemaps, redirects, site speed and schema

Replace internal links that still point to an old redirected domain

Write a step-by-step SOP (Google Doc, Loom video welcome) so my VA can refresh the remaining articles

Technical and on-page SEO audit

A prioritized list of fixes

Fully optimize 3 sample recipe articles as examples

An SOP for my VA to follow on the remaining recipes

No URL changes, no deleting or merging posts, and no changes to Mediavine ad settings without my written approval



After 3 months (if it is a good fit)



Continue at fewer hours: reviewing my VA’s work, checking Search Console, and setting next priorities



Requirements



At least 1 to 2 years of hands-on WordPress SEO experience, ideally on blogs or content sites

Comfortable with Rank Math, Google Search Console, GA4 and Screaming Frog (or similar)

Familiar with Google’s helpful content and core update guidelines

No AI-generated content, no link buying, no black-hat SEO

Keep a written log of every redirect, no index and deletion

Good written English and a short weekly update



How to apply

In 3 to 5 sentences, explain how you would fix a site where about half the pages are “crawled, currently not indexed.”



Shortlisted applicants will complete a short paid test task ($20): reviewing 5 URLs and recommending changes.

title: AI, 2D and 3D Video Editor
description:
## Job overview



We are looking for a genuinely high-level senior video editor and motion designer for a premium, cinematic mini-series in the personal-development space.



This is not standard social media editing. The series needs to feel like a high-end documentary meets a cinematic masterclass: visually bold, emotionally engaging, modern, and highly bingeable.



Depending on your skill set, your work may include AI scene generation, 2D and 3D animation,  building high-end motion graphics and kinetic typography, creating the visual effects to explain discussed concepts, designing transitions, or compositing/VFX. 



## What we’re looking for



- Experience in generating clones and re-creating entire scenes using AI

- Expert-level Adobe Premiere Pro skills: long-form editing, story pacing, colour/audio fundamentals, and excellent project organisation.

- Strong After Effects skills: motion graphics, kinetic typography, compositing, visual effects, and custom transitions.

- A portfolio showing cinematic long-form storytelling, premium branded content, documentaries, music videos, narrative YouTube, or similarly high-production work.

- Excellent taste in visual storytelling, pacing, music, sound design, typography, and contemporary design.

- Strong creative judgment: knowing when to use big visual moments and when to let an emotional moment breathe.

- Clear English communication, reliability, and the ability to take direction while bringing strong creative ideas to the table.



Big advantage: 3D, animation, or advanced VFX/compositing experience in Blender, Cinema 4D, Unreal Engine, DaVinci Resolve, or similar. This is not essential if you are exceptional in editing and motion design, but please tell us about it if it is part of your skill set.



## This role is not for you if



Your work relies mainly on repetitive templates, generic social-media edits, auto-captions, or random stock footage. We are not looking for generic visuals, cheesy effects, PowerPoint-style explainers, or fast cutting for the sake of fast cutting.



We want a premium, intentional visual world with editorial taste, strong rhythm, and original ideas.



## What we offer



- A creatively ambitious project with a clear visual direction and strong existing footage library.

- The chance to work on a flagship cinematic series rather than high-volume, templated content.

- Potential for continued full-time long-form YouTube editing work after the project for the right person.



## How to apply



Please send:



1. Your portfolio or showreel, with your 2–3 most relevant examples first.

2. A short note explaining your specific role in each example (editor, motion designer, VFX/compositor, etc.).

3. Your rate expectations or preferred project-pricing structure.

4. Your availability, time zone, and expected AEST overlap.

title: Experienced Life Insurance Appointment Setter | Outbound Calling & Aged Leads | U.S. Agency
description:
We're Looking for an Experienced Life Insurance Appointment Setter



Overflow Life & Legacy is a growing U.S.-based independent life insurance agency affiliated with Symmetry Financial Group.



We help individuals and families protect what matters most through mortgage protection and life insurance solutions.



We're looking for an experienced, results driven appointment setter who has worked specifically with U.S. life insurance leads and knows how to turn outbound conversations into qualified appointments.



THIS IS NOT AN ENTRY-LEVEL VIRTUAL ASSISTANT POSITION.



We're looking for someone who already understands the life insurance appointment-setting process, is confident on the phone, and knows how to follow up consistently without needing constant supervision.



If you've successfully booked appointments for U.S. life insurance agents, particularly using aged mortgage protection or final expense leads, we'd love to hear from you.

__________________





WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING



Your primary responsibility is to follow up with prospects who previously requested information about life insurance but haven't yet scheduled an appointment.



Many of these leads will be several weeks or months old, so you must be comfortable reconnecting with people who may not remember their initial inquiry.

__________________







YOUR DAILY RESPONSIBILITIES WILL INCLUDE



- Making consistent outbound calls to assigned mortgage protection and life insurance leads.

- Reengaging older leads and starting natural, professional conversations.

- Following up with digital leads through phone calls and approved text messaging.

- Building rapport, handling initial objections, and helping interested prospects schedule appointments.

- Booking qualified appointments directly onto our agents' calendars.

- Confirming appointments and following up to improve attendance.

- Keeping accurate CRM notes, lead statuses, and follow-up reminders.

- Managing your assigned leads proactively so opportunities don't fall through the cracks.

- Tracking daily activity and reporting appointment-setting results.

- Following our approved scripts, contact procedures, and compliance guidelines.



You won't be responsible for selling insurance, quoting premiums, or recommending policies. Your focus is connecting with prospects and scheduling quality appointments with licensed agents.

__________________







REQUIRED EXPERIENCE & QUALIFICATIONS



**You must have previous experience setting appointments for U.S. life insurance agents.**



We're especially interested in candidates with:



- Proven outbound calling experience in the U.S. life insurance industry.

- Experience working aged insurance leads and following up over multiple contact attempts.

- Familiarity with mortgage protection, final expense, or similar life insurance leads.

- A track record of booking appointments that prospects actually attend.

- Strong spoken English and a confident, natural phone presence.

- Experience using CRMs, dialers, and SMS follow-up systems.

- Good judgment, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently.



Experience with Symmetry Financial Group, or other independent life insurance agencies is a strong plus.



You must also have a reliable computer, stable high-speed internet, a quality headset, and a quiet working environment.

__________________







WHAT MAKES SOMEONE SUCCESSFUL IN THIS ROLE?



We're not looking for someone who just makes a high number of calls or fills a calendar with appointments.



We're looking for someone who:



- Knows how to start conversations without sounding robotic or overly scripted.

- Can reconnect with older leads without being pushy.

- Listens carefully and knows how to respond to hesitation or objections.

- Understands the importance of consistent, timely follow-up.

- Takes ownership of their assigned leads and works independently.

- Cares about the quality of appointments, not just the number booked.

- Is dependable, coachable, and committed to improving results.





**Our goal is simple: More meaningful conversations, more qualified appointments, and fewer missed opportunities.

__________________







SCHEDULE & COMPENSATION



- 15-20 hours per week initially.

- Work during agreed-upon U.S. Eastern Time calling hours, including some afternoon/evening availability.

- $4–$7 USD per hour, based on relevant experience and proven results.

- Opportunity for additional hours and long-term growth based on performance.

- Paid training on our agency's specific scripts, CRM, and processes.

- An established supply of leads and clear expectations.



We're building for the long term and want someone who can grow with our agency.

__________________





HOW TO APPLY



If you have experience setting appointments for U.S. life insurance agents, we'd love to hear from you!



To apply, please include:



1. Your Experience: Briefly describe your life insurance appointment-setting experience, including the types of leads you've worked with and any results you're proud of.

2. Voice or video Introduction: Include a short 60-second audio or video recording introducing yourself and sharing why you'd be a good fit for this role. *APPLICATIONS THAT DON'T INCLUDE THIS WILL NOT BE CONSIDERED.

3. Availability: Let us know your availability to work during U.S. Eastern Time hours.



Please begin your application with "Overflow Appointments" so we know you've read the posting. 





We look forward to hearing from you!



Overflow Life & Legacy

- Protect what matters. Build what lasts.
