title: Financial Research & Organic Growth Analyst
description:
Job Title: Financial Research & Organic Growth Analyst



Type: Full-time · Remote · ~35-40 hours/week



Compensation: $605 –$735 USD/month (based on experience and skills)



About PyQuant

PyQuant is a financial research platform that helps individual investors evaluate public companies through fundamental financial analysis and financial statement breakdown. We focus on reported financials, long-term trends, and clear, explainable metric. No market hype or pricing involved.



We're looking for a detail-oriented researcher who understands company financials and can turn that research into useful, engaging content for retail investors, organically growing our audience.



The Role

This is a finance-first research and content role - not a social media scheduling or marketing analytics position. You will:



- Investigate public companies and verify financial claims against primary sources (yahoo finance, reuters, morning star, google finance, bloomberg, etc.)

- Turn your findings into accessible content for retail investors

- Help identify investor communities, creators, and organic channels to reach people interested in fundamental investing



What We're Looking For

1. Financial Statement Analysis:

- Comfortable reading income statements, balance sheets, and cash flow statements

- Able to interpret revenue growth, profit margins, earnings, debt, liquidity, cash generation, and valuation metrics

- Has identified financial statement trends YoY and QoQ using Compound Annual Growth Rate (CAGR)

- Can identify meaningful multi-year financial trends and explain why a metric matters (and its limitations)



2. SEC Filing Research

- Experience researching companies via 10-Ks, 10-Qs, earnings releases, and investor relations materials

- Able to locate and verify figures against original sources

- Understands reporting periods, accounting terminology, and accurate citations



3. Financial Writing & Content Development

- Strong written English; can explain complex financial concepts clearly to a retail audience

- Can turn research into company breakdowns, metric explainers, comparisons, social posts, and article outlines

- Distinguishes reported facts from interpretation and opinion



4. Organic Marketing & Audience Research

- Interested in value/fundamental investing and the retail investor community

- Can research relevant forums, newsletters, creators, and content platforms (Reddit, LinkedIn, Instagram, Threads)

- Able to track engagement, referral traffic, and signups where measurable



Preferred Background

Especially value candidates with education/experience in:

- Finance, accounting, equity research, or investment research

- Financial journalism or writing about public companies

- Financial modeling, spreadsheet analysis, or company valuation

- SEO, content strategy, or social media marketing

- Experience with SEC EDGAR, spreadsheets, Canva, and scheduling tools is a plus, but financial research ability and writing quality matter more than any specific tool.



How to Apply

Please include:

- A brief introduction with your relevant experience and resume

- Your background in finance, accounting, research, or writing

- A writing sample (and an example of financial analysis, if available)

- A short explanation of how you'd research a public company using its latest annual report



Shortlisted candidates may be asked to complete a paid financial research and writing exercise.

You’re the person who keeps the fleet picture accurate, coordinates trailer repair concerns, and flags problems before they cost us time and money.

title: Luxury vacation rental logo design
description:
Project Overview



Oklahoma Shores is an upscale hospitality brand managing a curated portfolio of 7 distinct waterfront properties across Eastern Oklahoma. Our collection ranges from luxury tiny cabins and a premium geodesic glamping dome tent on a 100-acre riverfront ranch to high-capacity lakefront retreat estates.

We are launching a premium direct-booking network and need a specialized Brand Identity Artist / VA to create our master logo and visual asset suite.



Visual Vibe & Guardrails



• The Aesthetic: Rustic Luxury, High-End Heritage Estate, Upscale Lodge.

• What to Avoid: Please do NOT submit concepts that are cold, sterile, hyper-modern, or abstract minimal. We want the brand to feel warm, deeply established, and rich with regional history. Avoid generic clip-art houses or basic wavy lines.



Detailed Design Brief



1. The Emblem (The Waterfront Heritage Crest):

We require a classic, elegant framed estate crest or heraldic badge using fine, whisper-thin vector line art. The crest must seamlessly weave together three specific motifs:

 • A classic rustic windmill (honoring our 100-acre Oklahoma ranch heritage).

 • Subtle rolling landscape/bluff curves (representing our position high on the Grand River bluffs).

 • Clean horizontal shoreline/water reflections at the base of the emblem.

2. Typography & Font Styling:

 • Primary Text ("OKLAHOMA"): A stately, high-character serif typeface that carries weight and history, preferably with subtle, clean chiseled edges.

 • Secondary Text ("SHORES"): A clean, sophisticated, modern sans-serif typeface with wide tracking (letter-spacing) sitting perfectly aligned beneath the primary text.

3. Color Palette: Organic, muted landscape tones. Iron charcoal/black, warm sand, and soft matte gold accents, with a brand accent of muted sage/moss green.



Required Deliverables



• Master Logo Lockup: Full brand mark containing the text layout and the crest together.

• Standalone Sub-Mark: The isolated line-art crest badge on its own (for watermarks, digital welcome books, and property merchandise like robes and signage).

• Complete Vector Source Files: Fully scalable, transparent formats including .SVG, .EPS, and high-resolution .PNG.

title: Backend developer
description:
Part-Time Backend Developer – AI SaaS, Authentication & Security



Company: FYAM  

Hours: 4–5 hours per week initially  

Contract: Freelance, part-time, with potential for ongoing work



 About the Project



FYAM is developing an AI-powered application designed to help registered managers and care providers automate administrative tasks, including care-plan creation, service-user feedback analysis and staff compliance tracking.



We have already built the initial user interface and five interconnected automation workflows. We have also documented our data structures and the intended functionality of each workflow.



Our next priority is to develop the backend infrastructure required to turn the existing application into a secure, multi-user SaaS product.



I am looking for a backend-focused developer to help implement the underlying infrastructure, connect the existing workflows and prepare the application for a controlled customer pilot.



Your Responsibilities



 1. Backend Development

- Review the existing codebase and understand the current application architecture.

- Implement and improve backend functionality using the existing technology stack.

- Connect the frontend to the database and backend APIs.

- Help integrate our existing automated workflows into a reliable application.

- Support PDF uploads, text extraction and processing for AI-assisted care-plan generation.



2. Authentication and User Management

- Implement secure user registration, login, logout and password reset.

- Support multiple care-provider organisations using the same application.

- Implement appropriate user roles and permissions.

- Ensure users can only access information belonging to their organisation and permitted role.



3. Database and Data Security

- Configure and maintain a suitable database.

- Implement appropriate database access policies and server-side authorisation.

- Apply encryption in transit and at rest using suitable managed services and configurations.

- Protect API keys, credentials and environment variables.

- Implement secure file storage, access restrictions and appropriate retention and deletion processes.

- Help establish backups and recovery procedures.



4. Testing and Deployment

- Test authentication, permissions and organisation-level data isolation.

- Test the complete workflow from PDF upload to generated care-plan draft.

- Identify and resolve backend bugs and integration issues.

- Assist with production deployment, logging and error monitoring.

- Document the setup so the application can be maintained and extended.



Required Skills



We are particularly interested in candidates with practical experience in:



- Backend web development and REST APIs.

- JavaScript or TypeScript, or the backend language used by our existing project.

- PostgreSQL, Supabase or a comparable database platform.

- Authentication, authorisation and role-based access control.

- Multi-tenant SaaS architecture.

- Secure file uploads and document processing.

- GitHub, debugging, testing and deployment.

- API integration and AI-powered applications.



Experience with Supabase Auth, PostgreSQL row-level security, cloud storage and managed hosting would be beneficial if compatible with the existing architecture.



The Ideal Candidate



- Can work with an existing Codex-generated codebase rather than starting from scratch.

- Understands the difference between frontend visibility and genuine backend security.

- Can explain technical decisions in straightforward language.

- Is comfortable working independently on small, clearly defined tasks.

- Takes confidentiality and sensitive care-sector information seriously.

- Is willing to document their work and communicate progress each week.



We do not expect one person to be an expert in every area. However, practical backend experience is essential, and experience with multi-user applications is particularly valuable.



Working Arrangement and Budget



This is a strictly part-time freelance engagement, not a full-time position.



- Approximately 4–5 hours per week.

- Flexible working arrangements with agreed weekly milestones.

- A small paid trial task before committing to ongoing work.



The initial milestone will be to review the existing application, identify the most important backend and security gaps, and provide a prioritised implementation plan.



Further work will focus on the highest-priority tasks within the agreed budget.



How to Apply



Please include:



1. Your relevant backend development experience.

2. Your GitHub profile or portfolio.

3. An example of an application where you implemented authentication and database access controls.

4. Your experience with multi-tenant SaaS applications and file uploads.

5. Your hourly rate and availability for 4–5 hours per week.

6. Confirmation that you are comfortable working within our monthly budget.



Please begin your application with **SMART SUMMARISE** so we know you have read the full description.



We are looking for a dependable developer who can help us build on our existing work and move Smart Summarise towards a secure customer pilot.

title: Online Business Manager (OBM) – Operations & Growth | U.S. Life Insurance Agency
description:
Full-Time | Remote — Philippines | $1,200–$1,500 USD/month (depending on experience and demonstrated capabilities)





Are you the kind of person who sees what needs to be done—and makes it happen?



We're looking for an experienced, proactive, and highly resourceful Online Business Manager (OBM) to become the right hand to the founder of a growing U.S.-based life insurance agency.



This is NOT a traditional Virtual Assistant position.



We're not looking for someone who simply waits for instructions, checks tasks off a list, or needs to be told what to do next.



We're looking for someone who thinks like a business owner, takes initiative, solves problems, builds systems, and knows how to turn ideas into completed projects.



Someone who doesn't just identify problems but comes prepared with solutions.



Someone who genuinely wants to understand the business, become invested in its success, and play an important role in helping it grow.



If you're someone who enjoys creating order out of chaos, building processes, improving operations, and making life easier for a busy entrepreneur, we'd love to hear from you.

__________________







*ABOUT US*



Overflow Life & Legacy is a growing U.S.-based independent life insurance agency affiliated with Symmetry Financial Group.



We help families protect what matters most while building an expanding organization of insurance professionals and agency leaders.



Our agency is entering an important season of growth. We're expanding our recruiting efforts, developing new agents, strengthening our systems, and putting the infrastructure in place to support a much larger organization.



We've reached a point where the founder needs more than administrative assistance.



We need an experienced operational partner who can help turn vision into execution.



You'll work directly with the agency owner, helping manage the day-to-day operations while building systems that allow the business to grow more efficiently.



This is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact—not simply maintain existing processes.

__________________





*WHAT YOU'LL OWN*



1. Business Operations & Executive Support



Become the founder's right hand in keeping the business organized, efficient, and moving forward.



You'll manage
 inboxes, coordinate communications and follow-ups, organize priorities, oversee administrative workflows, and make sure important responsibilities don't fall through the cracks.



Your job is to help the founder stay focused on the highest-value activities while ensuring day-to-day operations run smoothly.





2. Project Management & Implementation



This is one of the most important parts of the role.



The founder frequently develops new ideas, strategies, and initiatives to improve and grow the agency.



We need someone who can take those ideas, ask the right questions, develop an implementation plan, and drive projects through completion.



You'll establish timelines, organize tasks, manage deadlines, coordinate resources, and take responsibility for execution.



We don't want someone who simply tracks projects. We want someone who makes sure projects get finished.





3. Systems, Processes & Automation



You'll identify inefficiencies, streamline workflows, create SOPs, organize business systems, and implement improvements that help us operate more effectively.



We're looking for someone who enjoys evaluating how things currently work and finding ways to make them better.



You'll work with tools such as Notion, Google Workspace, CRM platforms, spreadsheets, and automation tools.



You don't need to know every platform we use, but you should be highly comfortable learning new systems and figuring out how to make them work together.





4. Recruiting & Agent Onboarding Operations



Recruiting and developing insurance agents is a major part of our growth strategy.



You'll help oversee the operational side of our recruiting pipeline, including candidate tracking, interview coordination, follow-up systems, licensing progress, onboarding, and new agent activation.



You'll also identify bottlenecks, improve processes, coordinate with recruiting partners, and help create systems that support a growing team.



You won't be responsible for personally conducting every interview or training agents to sell insurance. Your responsibility is to help ensure the operational systems supporting those activities are effective.





5. Business Reporting & Performance Dashboards



You'll create and maintain dashboards that give us visibility into recruiting, onboarding, agency performance, and other important business metrics.



But we don't just want someone who enters numbers into spreadsheets.



We want someone who can look at the information, recognize patterns, identify problems, and recommend improvements.





6. Marketing & Growth Coordination



You'll help coordinate marketing initiatives, content schedules, recruiting campaigns, and other growth-related projects.



This includes organizing deliverables, managing timelines, coordinating resources, and ensuring initiatives move from planning to execution.



You don't need to be a graphic designer, video editor, or marketing specialist. You do need to know how to organize and manage marketing projects successfully.

__________________







*WHAT OWNERSHIP LOOKS LIKE*



Let's say the founder shares an idea:



"We need a better onboarding process so new agents can get started faster and begin producing sooner."



A traditional assistant might wait for instructions on exactly what to do.



You would approach it differently.



You'd review the existing process, identify where agents are getting stuck, research potential improvements, and develop a proposed solution.



After discussing the plan with the founder, you'd take ownership of implementation, establish the necessary workflows, coordinate the moving parts, and monitor the results.



And once the project is completed, you'd look for ways to make it even better.



That's the mindset we're looking for.



You'll have the freedom to recommend improvements and make appropriate day-to-day operational decisions within agreed guidelines. Major strategic, financial, and business decisions will remain with the founder.

__________________







*WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR*



We're looking for someone with proven experience managing business operations and independently executing projects, ideally while working directly with an entrepreneur or business owner.



Required Qualifications:



-> 3–5+ years of relevant experience in online business management, operations management, or project management.



-> Demonstrated success taking projects from concept through implementation.



-> Strong critical-thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities.



-> Experience developing systems, workflows, and SOPs.



-> Excellent organizational and project management skills.



-> Strong written and spoken English communication.



-> Experience managing competing priorities without constant supervision.



-> Confidence working with spreadsheets, CRMs, project management systems, and other online business tools.



-> The ability to understand how different parts of a business work together.



-> Comfort working in a growing business where not every process has already been documented.



-> Bonus Qualifications:



-> Experience working directly with U.S.-based business owners.



-> Experience managing operations in sales, recruiting, or service-based businesses.



-> Familiarity with Notion, GoHighLevel, Google Workspace, and automation platforms.



-> Experience coordinating marketing initiatives or remote team members.



-> Experience creating and improving business reporting dashboards.



Previous life insurance experience is not required. We're far more interested in your operational capabilities, business judgment, and willingness to learn.

__________________







*THE KIND O PERSON WHO WILL THRIVE HERE*



You're naturally curious about how businesses work.



You don't just complete assignments—you understand why they matter.



You ask thoughtful questions, but you're also resourceful enough to research solutions independently.



You're comfortable respectfully challenging an idea when you see a better way to accomplish the objective.



You communicate proactively, take accountability seriously, and follow through on commitments.



You can distinguish between what's urgent and what's important, and you know how to prioritize when several things need attention.



Most importantly, you take pride in making the business better because you were part of it.



If you prefer a role where every task is clearly outlined and someone else makes all the decisions, this probably isn't the best fit.



But if you enjoy taking ownership, solving problems, and contributing to the growth of a business, this could be an excellent opportunity.

__________________







*WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE YOUR FIRST 90 DAYS*



First 30 Days — Learn & Take Ownership

Understand our business, tools, people, and priorities. Take ownership of recurring operational responsibilities, organize existing projects, and identify the most important areas for improvement.



Days 31–60 — Build & Implement

Begin implementing improved workflows, establish reliable reporting, strengthen recruiting and onboarding systems, and independently manage agreed projects.



Days 61–90 — Lead & Improve

Demonstrate consistent ownership of day-to-day operations, proactively identify opportunities for improvement, deliver projects with minimal oversight, and provide actionable recommendations that support our continued growth.



Our goal is to develop a relationship where the founder can confidently delegate an operational objective and trust that it will be thoughtfully managed through completion.

__________________







*COMPENSATION & OPPORTUNITY*



Salary: $1,200–$1,500 USD per month, based on qualifications and experience.



Position: Full-time, 40 hours per week.



Location: Remote, Philippines.



Schedule: Consistent daily availability overlapping with U.S. Eastern Time is required.



Evaluation: Initial 90-day performance review.



Growth: Long-term opportunity to grow into a key operational leadership role within the agency.



We're looking for someone interested in a long-term relationship with a growing company where their work, ideas, and contributions genuinely matter.

__________________







*HOW TO APPLY*



We're excited to learn more about you! We've intentionally kept our application process simple because we respect your time.



Please include the following:



1. Your résumé and cover letter



Share your relevant experience, including any operations management, project management, or business systems work.



2. A brief video introduction (2–3 minutes)



Using Loom, Google Drive, or a similar platform, share a link to a short video introducing yourself and answering these two questions:



What interests you most about this opportunity, and why do you believe you'd be a great fit?



Tell us about a project or process improvement you personally took ownership of. What did you do, and what was the outcome?



No special editing or professional production is necessary. We're simply interested in getting to know you and hearing about your experience.

IMPORTANT: APPLICATIONS WITHOUT A VIDEO WILL NOT BE CONSIDERED.



3. Please confirm your availability for full-time work, your ability to overlap with U.S. Eastern Time, and your expected monthly compensation.



Selected candidates will be invited to an interview, with finalists potentially completing a short, paid practical assessment.



We value genuine experience, independent thinking, and a desire to contribute. We're looking forward to learning what makes you uniquely qualified for this opportunity.

__________________







*WHY JOIN US*



This is more than an opportunity to manage administrative tasks.



It's an opportunity to work closely with an entrepreneur, contribute your ideas, help shape business operations, and play a meaningful role in growing an organization.



We're looking for someone who wants to become a trusted partner in execution—someone who takes ownership, embraces challenges, and enjoys seeing the results of their work.



If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.



We look forward to learning more about you and what you can bring to Overflow Life & Legacy.

title: Video Ad Editor, Meta and TikTok (AI Video via API, Start Immediately)
description:
Type of Work: Part Time, 30 to 40 hours a week



Wage/Salary: $5 to $7 USD per hour, based on experience and test results (about $650 to $910 a month at 30 hours a week, more at 40). Invoiced monthly, paid via Wise.



Skills: Video Ads, Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, Short-Form Video, Sound Design, AI Video Generation (Kling, Seedance, Flux, GPT Image), API workflows, Premiere Pro, CapCut, After Effects



Job Description:



HeartStamp is a US brand that helps people create personalized greeting cards and invitations. Customers can have them printed and mailed, or send them digitally. Our assistant Stampy gives people creative designer superpowers, so anyone can send a card that looks like they tried harder, cared more, and nailed it. It is Christmas, our busiest season, and we need a video ad editor who can start right away and ship ads that sell, every working day.



This is an ads job. You make short 9:16 video ads for Meta and TikTok, built to drive purchases, working directly with our paid ads lead. It is not long-form YouTube, not sponsored influencer posts, and not a role where we teach you the tools. You need to be productive in week one.



What you'll make:



-2 to 3 finished ads per working day during peak season, 15 to 30 seconds each, 9:16 for Meta and TikTok.

-Story ads with real emotion: Christmas moments, family far away, the last-minute card panic, the card that makes someone tear up.

-Product ads built from real screen recordings of our card maker, showing the real steps and the finished card.

-Hook variations and cut-downs of winning ads so we can test fast.

-Sound design, music and voiceover on every ad: a clear sound in the first second, effects on the key moments, music that lifts at the payoff.



How we work (please read this twice):



1. Brief first. You build what the brief asks for. Have a better idea? Pitch it in writing and we may test it, but nothing outside the brief gets produced without sign-off.

2. Storyboard before you render. Every ad starts as a short storyboard with the script, shot list and the source of every shot (our footage, screen recordings or AI shots). We approve it, then you build.

3. Show work daily. Post a written standup every weekday morning and share drafts in progress. We would rather see a rough cut on day one than a finished ad on day four.

4. Flag blockers the same day. If a tool, file or login isn't working, tell us within a couple of hours. Silence is the one thing we can't work with.

5. Spend like it's your own money. AI renders are tested at low resolution first, costed before the final take, and logged.



The AI part:



We are an AI-first creative shop. You will generate shots and keyframes through APIs on company keys, using models such as Kling, Seedance, Flux and GPT Image on platforms such as fal, Replicate and OpenAI, and you will run our in-house Claude skills in the Claude desktop app. You must already be comfortable setting up API keys, keeping them secure, and estimating what a render will cost before you run it. If you have only used AI tools through app subscriptions and never through an API, this role is not the right fit.



Must have:



-A portfolio of paid social video ads you edited for Meta, TikTok or YouTube, not just reels or vlogs. A real portfolio site or ad reel. Bare Google Drive folders will not be reviewed.

-2+ years editing short-form ads for consumer, ecommerce or DTC brands.

-Fluency in Premiere Pro, CapCut or DaVinci Resolve, plus After Effects or similar for motion text.

-Hands-on AI video and image generation through APIs (fal, Replicate, OpenAI or similar).

-A real feel for hooks, pacing and sound. You know the first second d
 whether anyone keeps watching.

-Strong American pop-culture fluency and C1 English, written and spoken.

-Availability for our daily overlap: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM US Eastern (10:00 PM to 2:00 AM Philippine time). The remaining hours are flexible.

-A computer that renders 1080p without struggling, stable internet, and a backup plan for brownouts.



Nice to have:



-Results you can point to: an ad you cut that scaled, or a hook test you won.

-Experience with Christmas, gifting, family or ecommerce brands.

-AI voiceover (ElevenLabs or similar) and music tools.



Who you work with: Our paid ads lead directs your day-to-day work and our founder gives final approval. Everything runs on written briefs in Slack.



How we start: Every hire starts with a short paid test at your hourly rate, with a time cap. You get a real brief, send back a storyboard and script for approval, then deliver one finished 15 to 20 second 9:16 ad that uses at least one AI shot generated through an API, with the render cost logged. Top candidates move to a paid trial. We hire on the work.



How to apply:



-Put the words STAMPY CUT at the top of your application. We skip applications without them.

-Your ad portfolio or reel link, plus 3 ads you edited, with the brand, the platform and what you did on each.

-The AI video and image models you have run through an API, which platform you ran them on, and roughly what a 5 second clip cost.

-Two or three sentences: you get a brief for three ads at 9:00 AM ET. What do you send us by 1:00 PM ET?

-Your hourly rate in USD and your earliest start date.

title: GoHighLevel Expert & Trainer – Long-Term Growth Opportunity
description:
GoHighLevel Expert & Trainer — Long-Term Career Opportunity With Growing U.S. Company



Company: Blue Carrot Solutions

Location: Remote — Philippines



Employment: Initial paid trial → Part-time collaboration → Potential full-time leadership opportunity

Starting Pay: $8–$12/hour, negotiable based on experience



Initial Hours: Approximately 10–15 hours per week, with flexibility as the project develops



We're Looking for Someone Special



Blue Carrot Solutions is an established U.S.-based digital marketing company entering an exciting new chapter.



We're building a done-for-you automation service using GoHighLevel to help small business owners spend less time managing missed calls, following up with leads, scheduling appointments, and handling repetitive administrative tasks.



Our philosophy is simple:



Your Business. Your Voice. Less Busywork.



Our initial focus is on home service businesses, including roofers, HVAC contractors, plumbers, electricians, cleaning companies, and similar businesses. Eventually, we want to offer our service to all kinds of local businesses.



We have ambitious goals. We hope to build a company serving hundreds, and eventually thousands, of customers.



But we know that building something great starts with finding the right people.



We're not simply looking for a freelancer to build a few automations. We're hoping to find someone who wants to grow with Blue Carrot for years to come.



For the right person, this opportunity could eventually develop into a full-time position with significant responsibility and leadership opportunities.



The Opportunity



We already have two trusted team members in the Philippines who have been working with Blue Carrot for years. They're dependable, hardworking, and eager to learn.



We're now looking for an experienced GoHighLevel specialist who can work alongside them to build the technical foundation of our new automation service.



Your initial responsibilities will include designing our systems, building automations, testing everything thoroughly, documenting processes, and teaching our team how to confidently manage the technology.



We want someone who genuinely enjoys sharing their knowledge and helping teammates succeed.



As our company grows, we'd love for this person to potentially become our lead GHL specialist, help manage client onboarding, communicate directly with customers, and eventually train additional team members.



We're looking for someone who sees the bigger picture and wants to help build something meaningful.



What We're Building



We're developing a standardized automation service that helps local businesses with:



Missed-call text-back and lead response.



Lead capture, follow-up, and nurturing.



Appointment scheduling and automated reminders.



Customer review requests.



CRM pipelines and customer communication.



Other practical automations that save business owners time.



Our goal is to build a system that's approximately 80% standardized and 20% customizable, allowing us to efficiently serve different types of businesses without rebuilding everything for each new client.



We want a reliable, repeatable system that can eventually support hundreds of customers.



Your Initial Responsibilities



You'll help us:



Design a scalable GoHighLevel agency structure.



Build reusable snapshots and standardized workflows.



Configure phone systems, SMS, calendars, pipelines, and integrations.



Set up and troubleshoot missed-call text-back, lead follow-up, scheduling, and review automations.



Handle or guide A2P registration and SMS compliance.



Develop a repeatable client onboarding process.



Create clear SOPs, documentation, and training videos.



Train our two existing team members through hands-on collaboration.



Help implement and test our first pilot customers.



We want someone who can build the systems correctly and teach others how to manage them.



Who We're Looking For



Technical Expertise



Strong hands-on GoHighLevel experience, preferably with agencies managing multiple client accounts.



Experience building reusable snapshots and scalable automation systems.



Advanced knowledge of workflows, triggers, pipelines, calendars, and integrations.



Experience with phone systems, SMS, A2P registration, and troubleshooting.



Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.



Communication & Personality



Excellent spoken and written English.



Comfortable communicating directly with American business owners over Zoom, phone,
, and messaging.



Patient, friendly, professional, and approachable.



Enjoys teaching, mentoring, and sharing knowledge.



Dependable, organized, proactive, and honest.



Comfortable working collaboratively with an existing team.



Excited about the opportunity to grow with a company over the long term.



Experience working with home service businesses is a plus.



Personality and teamwork matter just as much to us as technical ability.



We want someone our existing team genuinely enjoys working with, learning from, and collaborating with.



The Long-Term Opportunity



This is what makes this position different.



We'll begin with a paid trial project to make sure we're a great fit for each other.



If things go well, we'd like to continue working together as we build and launch our new service.



As Blue Carrot grows, there may be opportunities to:



Transition into consistent part-time work.



Become a full-time member of Blue Carrot Solutions.



Lead our GoHighLevel technical operations.



Manage client onboarding and technical implementations.



Serve as a primary point of contact for customers.



Train and mentor future team members.



Help shape how our company operates as we scale.



We can't guarantee how quickly our new service will grow or when a full-time position will become available.



But our genuine intention is to find someone who can prove themselves, earn our trust, and become an important part of Blue Carrot for many years.



We're not looking to constantly hire and replace freelancers.



We're looking to build a great team.



How to Apply



We care much more about your actual experience, communication skills, and ability to solve problems than a polished résumé.



Please complete the following:



1. Start your application with the words "Blue Carrot GHL."



2. Tell us about your GoHighLevel experience.



How long have you used GHL? Have you built reusable snapshots or managed multiple client accounts? Have you trained other team members?



3. Record a short introduction video (2–3 minutes).



Please introduce yourself and show us a GHL automation you've personally built, using a demo account or hiding private client information.



Explain what the automation does, why you built it that way, and one potential issue you'd watch out for.



We'd also love to hear why this long-term opportunity interests you.



4. Answer this technical question:



A roofing contractor misses a phone call while working. We want the caller to automatically receive a friendly text message, but only if the contractor didn't answer the call.



How would you configure and test this in GoHighLevel? What potential issues or limitations would you consider?



5. Answer this systems question:



If you were helping Blue Carrot prepare to onboard 100 local businesses, including roofing contractors, window tinting companies, and appointment-based businesses, how would you structure the GHL system to make onboarding fast, reliable, and mostly standardized?



6. Share your hourly rate and availability.



How many hours per week could you initially commit? Would you be interested in transitioning into a long-term, potentially full-time role as the opportunity develops?



A Personal Note From the Owner



I've been running Blue Carrot Solutions for years, and I'm excited about where we're headed.



I've learned a lot about business along the way, and one of the biggest lessons is how important it is to surround yourself with good people.



I don't want to build a company where everyone is simply completing tasks.



I want to build a company where people take pride in their work, care about our customers, support one another, and feel like they're part of something meaningful.



I have big ambitions for Blue Carrot, but I also believe in growing responsibly, treating people well, and building a company that lasts.



For the right person, I hope this is the beginning of a working relationship that lasts many years.



If you're an excellent GoHighLevel specialist who enjoys teaching, wants to take on responsibility, and is excited about helping build something from the ground up, I'd genuinely love to hear from you.



Let's build something great together.

Your responsibility is to understand their situation, establish trust quickly, explain how we can help, recommend the appropriate service, and confidently guide qualified clients toward becoming customers.

This is a full-time, long-term position. Team members are expected to work exclusively with us during their employment. A second full-time or part-time job is not permitted.



What You’ll Do: You will be one of the first people clients speak with when they contact.



Your responsibilities include:

- Collecting accurate case information for the operations team

- Coordinating a smooth handoff after onboarding

- Keeping client and CRM records accurate and updated

- Taking ownership of conversations from first contact through conversion or resolution



This Is an Inbound Sales Role. You will not spend your day cold-calling random prospects. But if needed, we will inform you in advance.



Most people contacting with us because they already have a problem and are actively searching for a solution. However, this is still a performance-driven commercial role.



You must be comfortable:

- Discussing money

- Recommending paid services

- Asking for the sale

- Following up with und
 prospects

- Handling objections

- Moving conversations toward a clear decision



We are not looking for aggressive salespeople. We are looking for people who can combine empathy, confidence, commercial judgment, and strong closing ability.



You may be a strong fit if you:

- Have excellent spoken and written English

- Sound natural and confident when speaking with international clients

- Are comfortable having frequent phone conversations

- Can build trust quickly

- Remain calm when someone is stressed, emotional, angry, or scared

- Listen carefully instead of relying on scripts

- Have strong persuasion and objection-handling skills

- Can confidently ask clients to move forward

- Have good judgment and problem-solving ability

- Take ownership instead of waiting to be told what to do

- Are highly reliable and punctual

- Can work independently in a remote environment

- Can handle sensitive and confidential information professionally

- Are comfortable being measured against performance and conversion expectations

- Previous experience in any of the following areas can be an advantage:

- We place significant weight on your English communication, emotional maturity, judgment, sales ability, reliability, and ability to learn quickly.



The compensation package includes:

- $800 USD monthly base salary

- 3%–10% performance-based commission

- $10 bonus for eligible verified client reviews

- $300 retention bonus every 3 months, subject to eligibility and performance requirements

- 13th-month pay equivalent to one monthly base salary, subject to company policy and eligibility

- 7 days paid leave

- 3 paid sick days

- 2× pay for applicable Philippine regular holidays

- Performance-based earning potential above the base salary

- Your overall earnings can increase meaningfully with strong conversion and performance results.



This is a fully remote position. You must have:

- A reliable computer

- Stable and fast internet connection

- A professional headset

- A quiet working environment

- Reliable backup arrangements for foreseeable internet or power interruptions 



Please inform us about your facilities when you apply for this role.



The ability to consistently work your assigned Manila-time shift. Because clients may be dealing with urgent situations, attendance, responsiveness, and punctuality are critical requirements of this role.



Selected candidates will complete structured onboarding before independently handling clients. Training includes:

Strong performers consistently demonstrate five things:

- Judgment — Identifying what matters and recommending the right next step.

We are looking for people who can combine all five.



Please submit:

title: Bookeeper / billing specialist
description:
Job Title

Staff Accountant (QuickBooks)



Employment Type

Full-Time (40 hours per week)



Location

Remote – Philippines



Compensation

USD $4–$6 per hour (approximately $800–$1,100 per month, depending on experience)



Role Overview

We are seeking a detail-oriented Staff Accountant with hands-on experience using QuickBooks to support day-to-day accounting operations. This role is responsible for transactional accounting, reconciliations, invoice review, and maintaining accurate financial records. The position includes auditing vendor invoices—primarily from hospitals—to ensure accuracy and compliance before billing sponsors.



This is a long-term, full-time role within a growing finance team, offering stability and process-driven work.



Key Responsibilities

Vendor Invoice Review & Audit (Critical Function)

Review and audit vendor invoices (primarily hospitals) for accuracy, completeness, and compliance with contractual or sponsor requirements



Verify billed amounts against supporting documentation, rates, and services rendered



Identify discrepancies, duplicates, or errors and escalate issues for resolution



Prepare and organize approved vendor invoices for sponsor billing



Accounts Receivable (AR)

Prepare and issue sponsor and client invoices in QuickBooks



Bill sponsors based on approved and audited vendor invoices



Apply customer payments accurately and timely



Track client deposits, prepayments, and retainers



Monitor outstanding AR balances and flag past-due accounts



Accounts Payable (AP)

Enter vendor bills and expenses into QuickBooks



Track approval status of vendor invoices



Prepare payment schedules and record vendor payments



Ensure proper expense coding and documentation



Reconciliations

ABOUT US

Accurate Insurance Consulting, a Cóir Risk Advisory company, is a licensed public adjusting firm. We represent homeowners and businesses in property insurance claims against their insurance companies in Virginia, Maryland, DC, Delaware, New Jersey and West Virginia. We're a small, tight team, and this role will be the voice of our office.



THE ROLE

Phones come first. You'll handle our calls with insurance carriers, clients and contractors, and between calls you'll support our claims team. Some carrier calls take five minutes and some sit on hold for an hour, so patience and persistence matter more than speed.

REQUIREMENTS

- Excellent spoken English with clear pronunciation. US callers must understand you easily.

title: Doctor Virtual Assistant
description:
Job Description



We are seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented Virtual Physician to help manage patient charts, review medical records, and ensure patients are fully prepared for their upcoming procedures.



The ideal candidate will have a strong medical background, excellent attention to detail, and experience reviewing medical records, laboratory results, and diagnostic imaging reports.

Your primary responsibility will be to review every patient's chart to ensure all required documentation, testing, and pre-procedure requirements are completed and accurate.



Key Responsibilities



1. Patient Chart Review & Quality Assurance



Review patient charts thoroughly to ensure all required information is present and accurate.

Verify that patients have completed the appropriate laboratory testing and X-rays for their scheduled procedures.

Review lab results, including CBC, BMP, PT/INR, and kidney function tests, according to established protocols.

Verify that X-rays and other diagnostic imaging reports are available and within the required timeframes.

Identify missing, outdated, or incomplete medical records.

Review medical histories, medications, allergies, and relevant clinical documentation.

Flag abnormal results or potential concerns for review by the physician or licensed clinical team.

Ensure every patient chart is complete and ready for physician review before the scheduled procedure.



2. Patient Communication & Follow-Up



Contact patients to confirm that required laboratory testing and imaging have been completed.

Notify patients when their pre-procedure requirements have been completed and reviewed by the appropriate clinical team.

Follow up with patients who have missing laboratory results, X-rays, or medical documentation.

Assist patients with obtaining outstanding records and completing required testing.

Answer general questions about appointment preparation and scheduling.

Escalate medical questions or concerns to the appropriate licensed healthcare professional.



3. Procedure Readiness & Scheduling Support



Review upcoming procedure schedules to ensure patients are prepared.

Maintain an organized tracking system for patients with completed versus outstanding requirements.

Coordinate with physicians, nurse practitioners, nurses, and scheduling staff.

Identify potential issues that could delay or cancel a procedure.

Provide daily updates on patient readiness and outstanding tasks.



Qualifications

Previous experience as a Medical Assistant, Virtual Medical Assistant, Medical Scribe, or Clinical Coordinator.

Strong understanding of medical terminology, laboratory testing, and medical documentation.

Experience reviewing patient charts and working with electronic medical records (EMRs).

Ability to identify missing documentation and recognize results that require clinical escalation.

Excellent communication skills and professional phone etiquette.

Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail.

Ability to work independently and manage a high volume of patient charts.

Experience in interventional radiology, vascular medicine, or outpatient procedures is a plus.

Familiarity with HIPAA and patient confidentiality requirements.

What We're Looking For

We want someone who is extremely detail-oriented, proactive, and dependable. This person should take ownership of ensuring that every patient's chart is thoroughly reviewed and that nothing important is overlooked before a procedure.



Our goal is to minimize cancellations, improve patient safety, and ensure every patient is fully prepared before arriving at our facilities.



Important: This is a non-licensed administrative and clinical support role. Final medical clearance, interpretation of clinical findings, and decisions about whether a patient can proceed with a procedure must be made by the appropriate licensed medical professional.

title: Part-Time Accounting & Finance Manager | QuickBooks Online | U.S. Service Businesses
description:
Part-Time Accounting & Finance Manager

| QuickBooks Online | U.S. Service Businesses



We are looking for a long-term accounting and finance partner—not simply someone to enter transactions.

We operate multiple small U.S.-based consulting and marketing service businesses, each with separate QuickBooks Online books. Our transaction volume is relatively low, but we need an experienced person who can take ownership of the accounting function, keep the books accurate, manage routine financial operations, and proactively tell the owner what he needs to know.

If your approach is primarily categorizing bank-feed transactions and waiting for instructions, this is probably not the right role. If you naturally ask why an expense changed, notice an overdue invoice, question an unusual transaction, document recurring accounting rules, and can explain the financial picture to a busy business owner in a few minutes, we would like to hear from you.

WHAT YOU WILL OWN

• QuickBooks Online bookkeeping quality, account reconciliation, and proper coding across multiple entities

• Monthly close and accurate, tax-ready books

• Client invoicing and maintenance of the billing calendar

• Accounts receivable tracking and professional initial payment reminders

• Selected accounts payable and bill payment within agreed approval controls

• Weekly review of cash, receivables, upcoming bills, unusual expenses, and recurring subscriptions

• Identification of unused, duplicate, unnecessary, or unexpectedly increasing subscriptions and expenses

• Monthly management reporting with a concise explanation of what the owner actually needs to know

• Practical revenue and profitability reporting by client and service line

• Short-term cash forecasting

• Year-end preparation and coordination with our U.S. CPA/tax preparer

• Documentation and improvement of recurring finance processes

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

• Strong hands-on QuickBooks Online experience

• Experience independently managing reconciliations and month-end close

• Experience with U.S.-based businesses

• Consulting, marketing agency, professional-services, or similar client-based business experience strongly preferred

• Comfort working with multiple separate business entities

• Ability to build practical client-profitability reporting even when owner/partner time is not perfectly tracked

• Excellent written and spoken English

• Proactive judgment: raise your hand when something does not make sense

• Strong documentation habits so recurring instructions do not have to be repeatedly explained

• High integrity and respect for financial access and payment controls

WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT

This is not a CFO position. It is also not a basic transaction-entry bookkeeping position. We are looking for someone between those levels: an experienced accounting professional who can run the books and financial operations while also providing useful management information. Our U.S. CPA will continue to handle tax preparation. Your responsibility includes making sure the books and supporting information are ready for them.

TIME COMMITMENT

This is intended to be a long-term relationship. We currently estimate the steady-state workload at approximately 30–35 hours per month. The first 90 days may require a different amount of time while you learn the businesses, review the existing books, complete any required cleanup, and establish the reporting processes. We care more about ownership and results than maximizing billable hours.

THE FIRST 90 DAYS

• Existing QuickBooks files reviewed, reconciled, and cleaned up where necessary

• Material historical accounting issues identified and resolved or documented

• Client billing calendar operating reliably

• AR tracking and initial reminder process operating

• Routine approved bill-payment process operating

• Weekly owner financial summary established

• Monthly close and management reporting established

• Subscription and recurring-expense audit completed

• Short-term cash outlook established

• Initial client/service profitability reporting established

• Year-end CPA-readiness process documented

• Recurring accounting procedures and rules documented

The ultimate measure of success is simple: the owner should learn about important financial issues from you before he has to discover them himself.



IMPORTANT:

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS

- Must be available for a camera-on interview.

- Must attend weekly Zoom meetings with the camera on.

- Must be available to log in from 8:00 AM ET to 10:00 AM ET, Monday through Friday.

- Must actively monitor and clean inboxes, keeping
s organized and properly addressed.

- Must create and maintain a transaction tracker covering all financial transactions across the businesses.

- Submit a Video Introduction.

title: Client Delivery Manager – B2B Consultancy, Part-Time Ongoing
description:
Our company helps founder-led B2B technology and technology-enabled services companies build repeatable revenue systems. We are hiring a Client Delivery Manager to own everything that happens after our CEO closes a sale, so that clients get an organized, accurate, on-time experience and the CEO stays out of routine delivery.



This is ongoing part-time work, 15-20 hours per week, expanding with client volume and demonstrated ownership.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN



Ownership transfers the moment the CEO reaches agreement with a client. From there you run:



• Contract to onboarding. Revise the agreement or statement of work to match what was actually agreed, confirm material changes with the CEO, follow through to signature, file the executed document, coordinate billing setup with accounting, and schedule onboarding.

• Day-to-day client contact. Answer questions on deliverables, schedules and revisions. Request overdue client inputs firmly and tactfully. Protect the agreed scope. Escalate anything commercial, legal or relationship-threatening.

• Calendar and meetings. Own the client-facing calendar, prepare agendas and pre-reads, capture decisions and action items, send follow-ups, and update the project the same day.

• AI workflow execution. Run our documented prompts and agents in ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini using the correct source documents and process version. Compare outputs across tools and select or combine the strongest material.

• Quality assurance. Validate claims against transcripts and source documents. Catch hallucinations, unsupported claims, omissions and generic language. Correct grammar, structure, tone and formatting. Strip every placeholder, prompt fragment and AI artifact before anything reaches the CEO or the client.

• Revisions, project visibility, billing coordination, closeout and testimonial capture.



DELIVERABLES YOU PRODUCE OR FINALIZE



• Client-ready strategy documents: buyer and ICP research, buying-committee analysis, positioning and messaging, target-account intelligence, outreach plans, revenue-process design, playbooks and operating procedures.

• Engagement documents: agreements and statements of work that correctly reflect scope, fees, timing, client responsibilities and exclusions.

• One project dashboard showing phase, deliverable, owner, status, next action, due date and risk for every active engagement.

• Meeting agendas, follow-up summaries and status updates.

• Written and video testimonials at closeout.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



We care about evidence, not previous job titles. Strong candidates have come from client services, account coordination, customer success, logistics, executive support, agency operations and consulting operations, including experienced professionals working part-time by choice.



Show us:



• Managing several customer relationships or service commitments at once without losing details.

• Coordinating delivery logistics and deadlines independently.

• Excellent business writing and proofreading in English.

• Current, hands-on weekly use of generative AI tools.

• Setting expectations or boundaries with customers.

• Follow-through and sound judgment about what to solve yourself and what to escalate.



TOOLS YOU WILL USE



ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini (working proficiency required). Microsoft Word and Outlook (strong proficiency required). A transcript platform such as Krisp. Zoho Projects preferred but not required.



PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING



We will train you on our delivery process and our specific client workflows. We will not train you on how to use generative AI, run prompts, use Word, write professional
 or manage a calendar. If you need that training, this is not the right fit.



We also do not move forward with anyone who submits raw or lightly edited AI output as finished work. Every deliverable is checked against source material.



TERMS



• Ongoing hourly contract, 15-20 hours per week.

• This role is expected to expand and can grow into leading our delivery function.



IN YOUR PROPOSAL/VIDEO INTRODUCTION



Answer the screening questions, then add one short paragraph on the most clients or projects you have managed at one time and how you kept control of the details.



1. What is the largest number of clients or projects you have managed at one time, and how did you keep control of the details?

2. Which generative AI tools do you use weekly, and what kind of outputs do you produce with them?

3. How do you d
 whether AI-generated content is accurate enough to send to a client?

4. Describe a time a client failed to give you something you needed. What did you say, and what happened?

5. What weekly schedule and U.S. Eastern business-hour coverage can you reliably commit to?





NOTE:

- Must be available for a camera-on interview.

- Must attend weekly Zoom meetings with the camera on.

- Must be available to log in from 8:00 AM ET to 5PM ET, Monday through Friday.

- Ongoing hourly contract, 15-20 hours per week.

- Must actively monitor and clean inboxes, keeping
s organized and properly addressed.

title: eClinical Works onboarding specialists Experience Required
description:
Job Posting: eClinicalWorks (eCW) Onboarding & Training Specialist



Position Title: eClinicalWorks (eCW) Onboarding and Training Specialist

Department: Healthcare Operations / Clinical Information Systems

Employment Type: Full-Time Remote with offsite support.



Position Overview



We are seeking an experienced eClinicalWorks (eCW) Onboarding and Training Specialist to support the implementation, configuration, onboarding, and ongoing training of clinical and administrative personnel across a growing network of physician practices and outpatient healthcare facilities.



The ideal candidate will possess extensive hands-on experience with the eClinicalWorks Electronic Health Record (EHR) and Practice Management (PM) platforms, including provider onboarding, clinical workflow development, staff training, system optimization, and troubleshooting.



This position requires an individual who can independently manage onboarding activities, train physicians and staff, identify workflow inefficiencies, and ensure consistent and effective utilization of eClinicalWorks across multiple locations.



Key Responsibilities



1. Provider and Staff Onboarding



* Coordinate and manage eClinicalWorks onboarding for newly hired physicians, advanced practice providers, nurses, medical assistants, and administrative staff.

* Configure user accounts, role-based permissions, provider profiles, and appropriate system access in coordination with authorized system administrators.

* Assist with provider scheduling templates, appointment types, clinical documentation templates, and practice-specific workflows.

* Ensure new employees receive appropriate training before independently using the EHR.

* Develop standardized onboarding checklists and training completion requirements.

* Support onboarding of newly acquired or established practices transitioning to eClinicalWorks.



2. eClinicalWorks Training and Education



* Conduct individual and group training sessions for physicians, clinical staff, and administrative personnel.

* Provide comprehensive instruction on eClinicalWorks functionality, including:

    * Patient registration and demographics

    * Appointment scheduling and provider calendars

    * Clinical documentation and progress notes

    * Electronic prescribing (eRx)

    * Medication reconciliation

    * Laboratory and diagnostic imaging orders

    * Referral management

    * Clinical templates and order sets

    * Patient portal and communication workflows

    * Billing, charge capture, and practice management

    * Task management, telephone encounters, and clinical messaging

* Develop training manuals, quick-reference guides, instructional videos, and competency assessments.

* Provide refresher training following software updates, workflow changes, or identified performance deficiencies.



3. Workflow Development and Optimization



* Evaluate existing clinical and administrative workflows to identify inefficiencies and opportunities for improvement.

* Collaborate with physicians, clinical leadership, and operations teams to standardize workflows across multiple practice locations.

* Assist in developing and optimizing documentation templates, clinical protocols, order sets, and specialty-specific workflows.

* Support improvements in documentation accuracy, charge capture, and revenue cycle processes.

* Recommend system configuration changes to improve operational efficiency and user experience.

* Ensure eClinicalWorks workflows support regulatory requirements and organizational policies.



4. Implementation and System Support



* Participate in new practice implementations, EHR deployments, and system upgrades.

* Assist with practice setup, testing, workflow validation, and go-live readiness.

* Provide hands-on support during implementation and post-go-live stabilization.

* Troubleshoot common user issues involving documentation, scheduling, prescriptions, orders, and other EHR functions.

* Escalate technical problems to eClinicalWorks support or internal IT personnel when appropriate.

* Track reported issues, corrective actions, and resolution status.

* Maintain standardized system configuration and training documentation.



5. Compliance and Quality Assurance



* Train personnel on accurate clinical documentation and proper use of electronic health records.

* Promote compliance with HIPAA, patient confidentiality, and organizational information security requirements.

* Support appropriate documentation, coding, and billing workflows.

* Monitor completion of required onboarding and system competency assessments.

* Identify recurring user errors and implement corrective education.

* Collaborate with clinical leadership to support documentation quality and operational performance.



Required Qualifications



* Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience using eClinicalWorks, preferably in implementation, onboarding, training, or EHR administration.

* Demonstrated experience training physicians, clinical staff, and administrative teams.

* Strong understanding of eClinicalWorks EHR and Practice Management functionality.

* Experience configuring clinical workflows, scheduling templates, provider profiles, and user permissions.

* Knowledge of medical office operations, patient registration, clinical documentation, and billing workflows.

* Ability to troubleshoot application-related issues and communicate effectively with technical support teams.

* Strong organizational, presentation, and interpersonal communication skills.

* Ability to manage multiple projects and onboarding schedules simultaneously.

* Proficiency in developing training materials, standard operating procedures, and competency assessments.

* Ability to work independently in a remote or multisite healthcare environment.



Preferred Qualifications



* Previous experience as an eClinicalWorks Trainer, Implementation Specialist, Application Specialist, or EHR Administrator.

* Formal eClinicalWorks training or certification, if available and applicable.

* Experience supporting multiple medical practices or multispecialty healthcare organizations.

* Familiarity with specialty-specific clinical workflows, including orthopedics, pain management, spine, physical medicine, and outpatient surgery.

* Experience with eClinicalWorks reporting, population health tools, and operational dashboards.

* Knowledge of revenue cycle management, charge capture, and claims workflows.

* Experience supporting EHR conversions, practice acquisitions, or multisite implementations.

* Clinical background as a Registered Nurse, Licensed Vocational Nurse, Medical Assistant, or other healthcare professional is beneficial but not required.



Performance Expectations



The successful candidate will be expected to:



1. Independently coordinate and complete provider and employee EHR onboarding.

2. Deliver effective training that prepares employees to perform assigned responsibilities within eClinicalWorks.

3. Maintain accurate training records and onboarding documentation.

4. Reduce recurring system-related errors through targeted education.

5. Support consistent EHR workflows across all assigned locations.

6. Respond promptly to training requests and application support issues.

7. Identify opportunities to improve provider productivity, clinical documentation, and operational efficiency.

8. Provide regular progress reports regarding onboarding completion, training activities, and outstanding issues.



Ideal Candidate



We are looking for a hands-on eClinicalWorks expert, not simply an individual who has used the software in a clinical or administrative role.



The successful candidate must understand how eClinicalWorks is configured, how physicians and staff use the platform, and how to train personnel to use the system accurately and efficiently.



This role requires exceptional troubleshooting skills, independent problem-solving, and the ability to translate complex EHR functions into clear, practical instructions for healthcare professionals.



Application Requirements



Applicants should submit a current resume highlighting their direct eClinicalWorks experience, including:



* Number of years working with eClinicalWorks.

* Specific eClinicalWorks modules and functionality supported.

Experience selling to trades, construction or commercial services.

The script, the lead list and the offer details.

You will start with approximately 1 hour of work per day. As the store continues to grow and the number of orders increases, the workload and number of hours will also increase. Starting rate: $3 per hour.



🧠 Who Are We Looking For?

We are looking for someone who:

• Has experience with supply chain, logistics, or order management within e-commerce or dropshipping

• Preferably has experience within fashion e-commerce or fashion dropshipping

• Has experience with ParcelPanel

• Understands fulfilment, tracking, and international shipping

• Has experience communicating directly with suppliers

• Works very accurately and is highly organised

• Can independently identify and solve problems

• Preferably identifies problems before they become bigger issues

• Takes responsibility for their work

• Speaks and writes English well

• Is reliable and consistently available

• Learns quickly

• Thinks proactively about how processes can be improved

• Is looking for a long-term position

Experience within fashion dropshipping is strongly preferred.



📦 Your Main Responsibilities

You will be responsible for the daily monitoring and follow-up of the supply chain of our fashion store. Your responsibilities include:

• Checking ParcelPanel daily

• Checking whether orders have correct tracking information

• Checking whether orders have actually been shipped

• Monitoring tracking statuses

• Checking whether shipments continue to move normally

• Making sure customers ultimately receive their orders

• Following up on open and delayed shipments

• Identifying unshipped orders and discussing them with the supplier

• Investigating missing tracking information

• Identifying incorrect or incomplete addresses

• Following up on missing house numbers and other address issues

• Checking and following up on Pick Up orders

• Identifying and following up on Return to Sender orders

• Identifying and following up on Lost in Transit orders

• Identifying and following up on Out of Stock orders

• Monitoring Shipment Delays daily

• Checking whether tracking statuses have changed

• Communicating directly with the supplier when there is an issue with an order or shipment

• Keeping Supply Chain Management Sheets accurate and up to date

• Recording issues in the correct tab

• Closing resolved issues correctly

• Identifying recurring shipping or fulfilment problems

• Reporting clearly each day which issues are still open and which have been resolved



🔍 Situations You Should Be Able to Recognise

You should be comfortable working with tracking and order statuses such as: Delivered, In Transit, Pick Up, Return to Sender, Bad Address, Address Error, Refused, Not Picked Up, Info Received, Unfulfilled, Out of Stock, Lost in Transit, Shipment Delay.



It is important that you understand which orders only need continued monitoring and which orders require action. We are not looking for someone who simply says: "This order has a problem." We want someone who immediately investigates: "Why did this happen, what is the current status, and what needs to be done to resolve it?"



🛠 Tools You Will Work With

Experience with the following tools is an advantage: ParcelPanel, Shopify, Supply Chain Management Sheets, 17Track, Yun Express, ParcelsApp, Slack, ReAmaze / Gorgias, Google Sheets.



🤝 Who Will You Work With?

You will work closely with:

• The store owner

• Our supplier

• Our Customer Support Representative

When Customer Support identifies a problem with an order, you should be able to investigate what is happening with the order or shipment. Likewise, it is important that you inform Customer Support in time when something is happening with an order and the customer needs to be updated. Good and fast communication between you, the supplier, and Customer Support is therefore very important.



📊 What Do We Expect From You?

We expect that:

• Orders are checked daily

• Problems do not remain unresolved for several days

• Shipping delays are identified

• Unshipped orders are followed up

• Tracking problems are investigated

• Suppliers are contacted in time

• Internal sheets remain up to date

• Open issues are followed up daily

• Resolved issues are closed correctly

• Important problems are reported immediately

• You work accurately and do not overlook orders

You are ultimately responsible for maintaining a clear overview of orders that have problems within the supply chain.



🚀 What Do We Offer?

• A long-term position

• Starting with approximately 1 hour of work per day

• As the store grows, the opportunity for more hours and more responsibility

• $3 per hour starting rate

• Communication through Slack

• Clear processes and SOPs

• The opportunity to grow with a growing fashion e-commerce business

We are specifically looking for someone who wants to become a long-term part of the team.



📋 Please Answer These Questions

When applying, please briefly answer the following questions:

1. How much experience do you have with supply chain, logistics, or order management within e-commerce?

2. Do you have specific experience with fashion e-commerce or fashion dropshipping?

3. What type of stores have you previously worked for?

4. Approximately how many orders per day did the largest store you worked for process?

5. How much experience do you have with ParcelPanel?

6. Which tracking tools have you used before?

7. Do you have experience communicating directly with suppliers?

8. Have you previously worked with Pick Up, RTS, Lost in Transit, OOS, and address issues?

9. What would you do if an order has had no new tracking update for several days?

10. How do you make sure you do not overlook problematic orders?

11. Briefly describe a supply chain problem you solved in a previous role.

12. What can you teach us about supply chain within fashion e-commerce?



Please also include the word pizza somewhere in your response to this job post.



We are looking for someone who does not simply complete a list of tasks, but genuinely takes responsibility for the daily operation of our supply chain and makes sure problems are identified and followed up quickly.

title: Property Management Virtual Assistant – Property Tree & Hostaway
description:
**Property Management Virtual Assistant – Part Time**



**Company: Gileo Property Management (Sydney, Australia)**



We are looking for a reliable, organised and detail-oriented Virtual Assistant to support our growing property management business in Sydney, Australia.



Our company manages both short-term rental properties (Airbnb) and long-term residential rental properties.



**Key Responsibilities**



**1. Short-Term Rental Management (Hostaway)**

- Monitor guest messages and respond promptly and professionally.

- Check booking calendars daily and identify vacant dates.

- Report upcoming vacancies and booking opportunities to management.

- Assist with guest enquiries and booking-related matters.

- Follow up on cleaning and maintenance issues when required.



**2. Long-Term Property Management (Property Tree)**

- Assist with tenant communication and rental enquiries.

- Update tenant and property records.

- Monitor rent payments and flag overdue accounts.

- Assist with lease renewals, maintenance requests and property management administration.

- Prepare basic reports and follow-up reminders.



**3. Property Advertising**

- Create and update rental advertisements on relevant websites.

- Monitor rental enquiries and follow up with prospective tenants.

- Keep property listings accurate and up to date.



**Requirements**

- Previous experience in Australian property management is highly preferred.

- Experience using Property Tree and/or Hostaway.

- Good written and spoken English.

- Strong attention to detail and organisational skills.

- Ability to work independently and meet deadlines.

- Reliable internet connection and computer.

- Responsive, honest and committed to completing daily tasks.



**Working Hours**

- Part-time position, approximately 14 hours per week.

- Approximately 2 hours per day.

- Must be able to check messages and booking calendars consistently.

- Some flexibility may be required for urgent guest enquiries.



**Salary**

- AUD $300 per month.

- Monthly payment.

- Initial two-month trial period, with performance reviewed regularly.



**How to Apply**



Please include the following information in your application:



1. Your previous experience in property management.

2. Have you used Property Tree? If yes, please describe your experience.

3. Have you used Hostaway or other short-term rental management software?

4. Have you managed Airbnb guest communications before?

5. Are you comfortable working approximately 2 hours per day?

6. What is your expected monthly salary?

7. Please start your application with the words **"GILEO PROPERTY VA"** so we know you have read the full job description.



We are looking for someone interested in a long-term working relationship who can grow with our company.



**Gileo Property Management**
