title: Accountant and Corporation Operations Assistant | Philippines | Remote
description:
Succeed Practice Management Corporation is looking for a Philippines-based accountant who enjoys accurate finance work and is willing to help with the broader administration of a growing business. We support Australian healthcare businesses, so clear communication, sound judgment and a practical approach matter.



The role

- Maintain the Corporation's books, reconciliations, accounts payable and receivable, and management reports.

- Prepare payroll and Philippine tax and statutory contribution information for review and filing, including BIR, SSS, PhilHealth and Pag-IBIG records.

- Keep a compliance calendar and organised supporting records for corporate, employment and regulatory requirements.

- Prepare bank and payment documents, investigate discrepancies and present them for approval. Final payment approval remains with the business owner.

- Assist with corporate records, minutes, filing preparation, process improvement and general virtual administration when needed.

- Work with external accountants or lawyers on matters needing specialist professional advice.



What we are looking for

- A completed bachelor's degree in Accountancy or a closely related field, with practical bookkeeping and accounting experience.

- Strong Excel or spreadsheet skills and experience with accounting and payroll software. Experience with Xero, Zoho or PayrollHero is useful.

- Familiarity with Philippine payroll, employer contributions, tax records and corporate compliance.

- Careful written English, reliable follow-through and the ability to explain issues clearly.

- Comfort with varied finance, compliance coordination and virtual administration duties in a small, growing team.

- CPA qualification is welcome. Relevant legal qualifications or experience with corporate secretarial work, contracts or regulatory filings are an advantage, but are not required.



This is a full-time, remote, 40-hour-per-week role based in the Philippines. Monthly salary: PHP 31,000, plus applicable statutory employment benefits. Working hours will be agreed with the successful applicant and coordinated with our Australian team.



To apply, please send your current CV, the title and completion date of your degree, and a short note describing the Philippine accounting and compliance work you have personally handled. If you have legal or corporate secretarial experience, tell us what you did and in what capacity. Please include the results of the platform's IQ and English assessments if available. We will contact shortlisted applicants about the next step.

title: Hiring: Content Creator Specialist (E-commerce / Dropshipping)
description:
**Full-Time | Remote | Long-Term | $900 Base + $200 Performance Bonus**



We are looking for a highly skilled **Creative Localization Specialist** to join our fast-paced e-commerce team.



We launch 5–6 product funnels daily across multiple international markets and need someone who can consistently deliver high-quality, fully localized video ads and static creatives.



**This is NOT a basic video editing, translation, or AI automation position.**



Your job is to take existing competitor creatives (UGC videos, video ads, static images, etc.) and professionally recreate and localize them for our target markets.



The final result should look and sound like it was originally created for that specific market.



## Responsibilities



- Localize UGC videos, video ads, and static image creatives into different target languages.

- Accurately translate and replace ALL on-screen text, subtitles, headlines, and CTAs.

- Replace foreign-language voiceovers with realistic, native-sounding AI voiceovers.

- Ensure perfect voiceover timing, pacing, synchronization, and natural delivery.

- Adapt translations to sound natural and persuasive while preserving the original marketing angle.

- Professionally remove and replace embedded text without damaging backgrounds or reducing visual quality.

- Maintain the original creative's structure, design, emotional impact, and conversion-focused messaging.

- Handle daily creative production for 5–6 product funnels.

- Independently review and quality-check every creative before submission.

- Deliver organized, launch-ready assets within strict deadlines.



## Requirements



- Proven experience with **direct-response e-commerce / dropshipping creatives**.

- Strong experience with AI dubbing, voiceovers, and localization tools.

- Ability to manually edit, mask, track, reconstruct, and replace elements when automated tools fail.

- Strong understanding of hooks, CTAs, marketing psychology, and conversion-focused advertising.

- Excellent attention to detail and ability to spot even minor mistakes.

- Ability to verify translations for accuracy, naturalness, and cultural relevance.

- Fast turnaround times without sacrificing quality.

- Excellent time management, communication, and reliability.

- Ability to work independently without constant supervision.



## IMPORTANT — We Are NOT Looking for AI Button Clickers



If your only skill is uploading a video into an AI tool, clicking "Translate," and exporting the result, **DO NOT APPLY.**



We actively use AI tools to improve speed and efficiency, but you must have the technical skills to manually fix anything AI gets wrong.



You must be capable of:



- Manually recreating embedded text while preserving the original design.

- Fixing inaccurate translations and unnatural voiceovers.

- Handling complex videos where automated AI editing fails.

- Correcting tracking, masking, timing, and synchronization issues.

- Identifying and solving problems independently.

- Delivering professional results without relying entirely on one-click AI solutions.



**We hire for real skills, precision, and problem-solving ability — not for knowing how to operate AI tools.**



## Strict Quality Standards



We expect professional, launch-ready work with:



- Zero spelling mistakes or incorrect translations.

- No robotic or unnatural voiceovers.

- No missing or untranslated foreign-language text.

- No visible editing mistakes or poorly replaced text.

- Accurate synchronization between audio, subtitles, and visuals.

- No unnecessary loss of video or image quality.

- Consistent delivery within agreed deadlines.



Every submitted creative is subject to quality control.



Repeated avoidable mistakes, failure to correct errors, or consistently poor performance will result in a formal performance review and may lead to termination.



We expect someone who takes full ownership of their work and checks everything carefully before submitting.



## Salary & Opportunity



**$900/month base salary + up to $100/month performance bonus.**



The monthly bonus is based on quality, accuracy, reliability, and delivery performance against agreed standards.



This is a full-time, long-term position with consistent daily work and the opportunity to grow with our e-commerce operation.



## How to Apply



Please provide ALL of the following:



1. Your portfolio with examples of localized video ads and static creatives.

2. At least **2 before-and-after examples** showing the original creative and your localized version.

3. A **30–60 second screen recording** demonstrating how you manually fix a difficult editing or localization issue that AI couldn't solve properly.

4. The editing software and AI tools you use.

5. Your average turnaround time for one UGC video and one static image.

6. Your experience working with direct-response e-commerce or dropshipping brands.

7. Your availability and confirmation that you accept the stated compensation structure.



### Mandatory Application Instructions



Start your application with the exact words "Manual Skills First".



Applications missing this phrase, the required portfolio examples, or the screen recording will not be considered.



Shortlisted candidates will complete a **paid practical test** involving video localization, static creative localization, and manual editing.



We are looking for a serious, highly skilled, detail-oriented specialist who can consistently deliver exceptional work at scale.



**If that's you, we'd love to see your work.**

title: E-COMMERCE OPERATIONS ASSISTANT
description:
IMPORTANT NOTICE TO APPLICANTS

Attention to detail and the ability to follow instructions are part of our screening process. Each step is clearly outlined, so please read carefully and complete all requirements.

Incomplete applications or those that fail to follow instructions will not be considered.





E-COMMERCE OPERATIONS ASSISTANT

MORALVE | JOB DESCRIPTION

Department: E-commerce Operations | Reports To: Operations & Supply Chain Manager

Employment Type: Full-Time | Work Arrangement: Remote



POSITION OVERVIEW

MORALVE is seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented, resourceful, and proactive E-commerce Operations Assistant to support the daily operations of our growing e-commerce business.



This versatile, hands-on role covers marketplace and account health monitoring, inventory tracking, customer service, logistics coordination, data entry, administrative support, and ongoing system and database maintenance.



The primary purpose is to ensure daily operations run smoothly, information remains accurate and current, and recurring tasks are monitored, documented, and completed. The assistant works closely with the Operations & Supply Chain Manager across Amazon and other e-commerce marketplaces.



We value reliability, initiative, follow-through, adaptability, and willingness to learn as much as previous technical experience. As familiarity develops, the role can progress from task execution toward independent ownership of routine workflows, exception identification, and project coordination.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Marketplace Account Monitoring & Maintenance

• Perform daily and recurring checks across Amazon and other assigned marketplaces.

• Monitor account health, notifications, alerts, warnings, and pending action items.



2. Inventory Monitoring & Maintenance

• Monitor inventory availability and stock health across marketplaces and inventory systems.

• Track replenishments, transfers, inbound activity, and receiving updates.

• Update inventory trackers and compare internal data against marketplace records.



3. Customer Service & Customer Experience Support

• Monitor and respond to routine customer inquiries using established guidelines and templates.

• Support order inquiries, delivery concerns, returns, refunds, and replacements within approved authority.

• Track unresolved cases, document actions, and follow up to closure.

• Identify recurring product or service issues and escalate sensitive or nonstandard cases.



4. Logistics, Shipment & Order Monitoring

• Monitor shipment and logistics updates, communications, and operational notifications.

• Maintain shipment trackers and milestones, including estimated arrival, delivery, and receiving.

• Assist with Amazon FBA, AWD, and other marketplace inbound monitoring.

• Record shipment references and organize supporting documents.

• Follow up on missing routine updates and flag delays or discrepancies.



5. Purchase Order & Supplier Coordination Support

• Maintain purchase order records, production updates, and related tracking systems.

• Monitor supplier communications, completion dates, inspection updates, and outstanding information.

• Collect quotations, documents, and routine supplier information.



6. Data Entry, Database & Tracker Maintenance

• Perform accurate recurring data entry and maintenance in spreadsheets, trackers, and databases.

• Update records using verified
s, reports, marketplace information, and supplier communications.

• Identify duplicate, missing, outdated, or inconsistent data.

• Assist with historical backtracking, cleanup, cross-checking, and reconciliation.

• Follow established data standards, formatting, and naming conventions.



7.
, Communication & Task Management

• Monitor assigned operational inboxes and channels; categorize and label communications.

• Identify and execute routine actions, follow-ups, documentation, and escalation.

• Track outstanding requests and pending responses.

• Communicate updates to internal and external stakeholders as appropriate.



8. Document & File Organization

• Download, rename, categorize, and store operational files according to company standards.

• Organize product, shipment, purchase order, inspection, supplier, and customer service documents.

• Support historical file cleanup and ensure records are traceable to their transactions.



9. Routine Operational & Administrative Support

• Complete assigned daily, weekly, and monthly checklists and maintenance tasks.

• Assist with account checks, reporting, data collection, research, and administrative activities.

• Support routine coordination across departments and evolving business needs.



10. Project Coordination & Process Improvement

• Maintain assigned project boards, task lists, deadlines, and documentation.

• Track deliverables, follow up on action items, and report blockers early.

• Assist with small operational projects and SOP documentation.

• Suggest practical improvements to accuracy, organization, and efficiency.



QUALIFICATIONS

Required

• Experience in at least 3 areas: : e-commerce operations, virtual assistance, administrative support, customer service, marketplace management, inventory/order management, logistics support, or data entry.

• Working knowledge of Google Sheets and/or Microsoft Excel, including basic formulas, sorting, filtering, and organizing data.

• Strong attention to detail, organization, written and verbal English communication.

• Ability to interpret
s, spreadsheets, reports, and operational systems and determine routine next steps.

title: Chargeback & Payment Dispute Specialist — E-Commerce — $6/hour
description:
We are a fast-growing international e-commerce company selling consumer products across multiple countries.



We are looking for a highly organized, reliable, and communicative Chargeback & Payment Dispute Specialist to take ownership of our payment disputes and chargebacks.



This role is especially suited for someone who is excellent at:



Following clear SOPs consistently every single day.

Staying organized even when handling many cases at once.

Keeping accurate records and documentation.

Communicating clearly with other team members.

Following up when something is missing.

Managing deadlines without needing reminders.

Paying attention to small details.

Taking responsibility for their work.



We already have clear systems and SOPs in place.



We are not looking for someone who ignores processes, skips steps, forgets to update cases, or waits until the last minute.



We want someone who can take a clear SOP, follow it accurately, communicate when something is unclear, and make sure every task is completed properly.



Your main responsibility will be to fight chargebacks, collect and submit strong evidence, communicate with our Customer Support team, track deadlines, and make sure no dispute is lost because of poor preparation, poor communication, or missed deadlines.



What Success Looks Like in This Role



A successful person in this role:



Checks every required platform every working day.

Follows our SOPs without skipping steps.

Keeps every chargeback properly documented.

Always knows which cases are urgent.

Communicates immediately when something is missing.

Follows up with Customer Support instead of waiting.

Updates statuses so the rest of the team knows what is happening.

Completes evidence before deadlines.

Double-checks their work before submitting.

Asks questions when something is unclear rather than guessing.

Takes ownership of problems until they are resolved.



Communication and organization are extremely important in this position.



If you notice a problem, we expect you to communicate it.



If you are waiting for information, we expect you to follow up.



If you cannot complete something, we expect you to explain why.



We never want issues to be ignored or left unresolved without communication.



1. Daily Chargeback Monitoring



You will monitor payment disputes across platforms such as:



Shopify Payments

PayPal

Airwallex

Mollie

Other payment providers we use



Your responsibilities include:



Check all payment platforms every working day.

Identify all new disputes.

Log every dispute immediately.

Record the dispute reason.

Record the dispute amount.

Record the evidence deadline.

Keep the status of every dispute updated.

Follow our chargeback SOP for every case.

Prioritize disputes based on deadlines.

Follow up on open disputes.

Track whether disputes are won or lost.

Communicate immediately if there is an issue you cannot solve.



No chargeback should ever be lost because someone forgot about it, skipped a step, failed to communicate, or missed a deadline.



2. Prepare & Submit Chargeback Evidence



You will prepare strong evidence for each dispute.



Depending on the dispute, evidence may include:



Order information

Customer information

Billing and shipping information

Tracking information

Proof of delivery

Shipping confirmation

Customer communication

Customer Support conversations

Refund history

Store policies

Refund policies

Shipping policies

Terms & Conditions

Screenshots

Product information

Other supporting evidence relevant to the case



You will be given clear SOPs explaining how different chargeback types should be handled.



We expect you to follow those SOPs carefully.



At the same time, you must understand the case you are working on.



Do not blindly copy and paste evidence.



Read the information.



Understand what the customer is claiming.



Make sure the evidence actually supports our case.



Double-check everything before submitting.



3. Communicate With the Customer Support Team



Communication with our Customer Support team is a very important part of this role.



You may need Customer Support to:



Contact a customer.

Send you missing information.

Explain what happened in a case.

Resolve a customer issue.

Ask a customer to collect their package.

Ask a customer to close a dispute after their issue has been resolved.

Provide screenshots or previous conversations.

Confirm whether a refund or reshipment was issued.



We expect you to communicate clearly and professionally.



Do not simply send a message and forget about it.



If you are waiting for information, follow up.



If something is urgent, make that clear.



If a deadline is approaching, communicate it.



If Customer Support has made a mistake that affects a chargeback, report it clearly so it can be corrected.



Good communication is one of the most important skills for this role.



4. Investigate Every Chargeback



Before submitting evidence, you should understand the full situation.



You should review:



The entire customer conversation.

Order history.

Tracking history.

Delivery status.

Previous refunds or reshipments.

Customer claims.

Internal notes.

Relevant company policies.



Do not make assumptions.



Do not skip information because you are in a hurry.



Follow the investigation process in our SOP and make sure you understand what happened before making a decision.



5. Deadline Management



You will often handle many disputes at the same time.



Being organized is therefore extremely important.



You will be responsible for:



Recording every deadline correctly.

Keeping an organized list of open cases.

Prioritizing urgent disputes.

Preparing evidence early.

Following up when information is missing.

Escalating problems before they become urgent.

Making sure nothing gets forgotten.



You should never need management to remind you that a chargeback deadline is approaching.



Managing your workload and deadlines is your responsibility.



6. Documentation & Organization



Every chargeback must be properly documented.



We expect you to keep clear records showing:



What happened.

What the customer claimed.

What evidence was collected.

What actions were taken.

Whether Customer Support was contacted.

What information is still missing.

When evidence was submitted.

The final dispute outcome.



Another team member should be able to open your documentation and immediately understand the status of the case.



If your work is not documented, it is considered incomplete.



7. Track Chargeback Results



You will track dispute outcomes and help us understand why we win or lose cases.



You should track things such as:



Chargeback reason.

Payment provider.

Amount.

Evidence submitted.

Outcome.

Win rate.

Reasons for losses when identifiable.



If you notice repeated problems, communicate them to management.



For example:



Customers frequently dispute delayed packages.

A specific shipping method creates many disputes.

Customer Support is handling a situation incorrectly.

Certain evidence is missing repeatedly.

We are repeatedly losing one specific type of dispute.



We want someone who notices patterns and communicates them clearly.



8. Improve Our Chargeback Process



Our SOPs are important, but they should also improve over time.



If you notice:



A repeated mistake.

An unclear SOP.

A missing step.

A better evidence structure.

A recurring communication problem.

A process that is causing unnecessary chargebacks.



You should report it.



We want someone who can follow systems extremely well while also helping us improve them.



Daily Responsibilities



Every working day you should:



Check all payment processors.

Identify new disputes.

Log all new chargebacks.

Review upcoming deadlines.

Work through active cases.

Follow the correct SOP for every dispute.

Collect missing evidence.

Communicate with Customer Support when necessary.

Follow up on unanswered requests.

Submit completed evidence.

Double-check submissions.

Update dispute statuses.

Track wins and losses.

Report urgent issues.

Make sure there are no forgotten cases.

IMPORTANT



To confirm that you have carefully read this entire job description, please start your application with the words:



CHARGEBACK SPECIALIST



Applications that do not begin with these words will not be reviewed.



What We Are Looking For



The most important qualities for this position are:



Extremely Organized



You should be comfortable handling many active cases without losing track of deadlines, follow-ups, or missing information.



Excellent at Following SOPs



We have clear processes for how work should be completed.



We need someone who can follow instructions consistently every day.



Not just during the first week.



Not only when someone is checking.



Every single day.



You should not skip steps because you believe they are unnecessary.



If an SOP is unclear, communicate with us instead of guessing.



Strong Communication



You will communicate regularly with Customer Support and management.



We expect you to:



Respond clearly.

Ask questions when necessary.

Follow up.

Communicate problems early.

Explain what you need from another team member.

Keep people updated on important cases.



Ignoring a problem is never acceptable.



Reliable



If you are responsible for something, we expect it to get done.



We should not need to repeatedly remind you about your responsibilities.



Detail-Oriented



Small mistakes in chargebacks can cost the company money.



You must be comfortable checking details carefully and reviewing your work before submission.



Proactive



If something is missing, investigate it.



If someone has not responded, follow up.



If a deadline is approaching, act early.



If you notice a repeated problem, report it.



Do not wait until someone tells you what to do.



Experience



Previous experience handling chargebacks or payment disputes is strongly preferred.



Experience with any of the following is a major advantage:



Shopify

Shopify Payments

PayPal

Airwallex

Mollie

Gorgias

Gmail

Slack

Google Sheets

Excel

WhatsApp

Performance Expectations



Your performance will be evaluated based on:



Following SOPs correctly.

No missed chargeback deadlines.

Accuracy of evidence submissions.

Quality of evidence.

Organization.

Documentation quality.

Communication with Customer Support.

Following up properly.

Reliability.

Attention to detail.

Ability to manage many cases at once.

Chargeback win rate.

Ability to identify and communicate repeated problems.



We care heavily about consistency.



Doing a good job one day and becoming disorganized the next week is not enough.



We are looking for someone who can maintain the same high standard every working day.



Salary



$6 USD/hour



Full-time position: approximately 40 hours per week.



There is potential for increased responsibility, performance bonuses, and salary growth for someone who consistently performs at a high level.



How to Apply



Please include:



Tell us about yourself.

Describe your previous chargeback or payment dispute experience.

Which payment processors have you handled disputes with?

Have you used Shopify before?

Have you worked with PayPal disputes?

Approximately how many chargebacks have you handled?

How do you organize multiple cases and deadlines?

Give an example of a job where you had to follow detailed SOPs every day.

What would you do if an SOP was unclear?

What would you do if you needed information from another employee and they did not respond?

What evidence would you use for a "Product Not Received" dispute?

What evidence would you use for a "Fraudulent Transaction" dispute?

Which software platforms have you used?

When can you start?



Please also record a 2–3 minute Loom video introducing yourself and explaining why you believe you would be a good fit for this position.



Interview Questions

Question 1



You have 30 active chargebacks across four different payment providers.



Five deadlines are within the next three days.



Explain exactly how you would organize your work.



Question 2



Our SOP says that before submitting a "Product Not Received" chargeback, you must review tracking, the entire customer conversation, and any previous refunds.



You are very busy and tracking already shows "Delivered."



Would you still complete the other steps?



Explain why.



Question 3



You need information from a Customer Support agent to complete evidence.



You message them, but they have not responded after several hours and the evidence deadline is tomorrow.



What would you do?



Question 4



A customer opens a chargeback claiming that they never received their order.



Tracking shows that the order was delivered.



Walk us through exactly what you would investigate and what evidence you would submit.



Question 5



You realize you made a mistake on a case.



What would you do?



Question 6



You notice the same type of mistake happening repeatedly between the Customer Support team and chargeback team.



How would you handle it?



Final Note



We are looking for someone who is organized, reliable, communicative, detail-oriented, and excellent at following clear SOPs.



This is extremely important to us.



You will receive clear instructions and processes, but we need someone who can follow them consistently without needing to be reminded every day.



We want someone who communicates when something is wrong, follows up when something is missing, keeps their work organized, documents everything properly, meets every deadline, and takes responsibility for their tasks.



If this describes the way you work, we would like to hear from you.

title: We're Hiring: Full-Time Video Editor!
description:
About Us

Alien Prints is a fast-growing custom apparel company based in Addison, Illinois. We produce 200+ orders per month of screen-printed, embroidered, and DTF-transferred custom apparel for construction companies, service businesses, and organizations across the US.



We're searching for a creative and detail-oriented Full-Time Video Editor who can turn ideas into engaging visual content. From social media clips to marketing campaigns, you'll play a key role in creating videos that captivate audiences and elevate our brand.



Job Requirements: Must have

• 2+ years of experience editing short-form video content (TikTok, Reels, Shorts)

• Portfolio/reel showing at least 10 short-form videos you’ve edited

• Proficient in CapCut Pro, Adobe Premiere Pro, or DaVinci Resolve

• Strong understanding of hooks, pacing, captions, and trending formats

• Ability to turn around 8–10 short clips per day consistently

• Understanding of what makes content perform on each platform (TikTok vs Reels vs Shorts)

• Clean, professional editing style — not over-edited, not under-edited



Nice to have

• Experience editing content for product-based or service-based businesses

• YouTube long-form editing experience (chapters, b-roll, pacing)

• Motion graphics or animation skills (After Effects, Motion)

• Thumbnail design skills (Photoshop or Canva)

• Basic color correction and audio cleanup skills

• Familiarity with royalty-free music libraries and sound design



Job Overview

The role

You are the person who takes raw footage and turns it into scroll-stopping content. Every day, you will receive raw video clips from our shop floor (printing presses running, orders being made, finished products) and talking-head recordings from the owner. Your job is to edit these into short-form and long-form videos optimized for each platform.



This is a high-volume role. You will produce 8–15 edited video pieces per day across different formats. Speed, consistency, and understanding of what makes content perform on social media are essential.



What you will do

Short-form video editing (primary focus — 70% of time)

• Edit raw clips into 15–60 second videos for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts

• Add captions/subtitles to all videos (burned-in, styled, readable)

• Write and add text hooks in the first 1–2 seconds of every video

• Add transitions, zoom effects, and pacing that match platform trends

• Select and sync trending audio/music where appropriate

• Create satisfying loop videos from production process footage (press pulls, ink shots, transfer peels)

• Edit before/after reveal videos with dramatic transitions

• Format and resize the same video for different platforms (9:16, 1:1, 16:9)



Long-form video editing (20% of time)

• Edit 1 long-form YouTube video per week (5–15 minutes)

• Full process walkthroughs: a single order from design to shipping

• Educational content: print method comparisons, branding guides, industry tips

• Add intro/outro, lower thirds, chapter markers, and b-roll where needed

• Create compelling thumbnails for YouTube videos



Ad creative (10% of time)

• Edit short video ads for Meta 
/Instagram) campaigns

• Create multiple variations of the same ad for A/B testing

• Follow direct creative briefs from the Content Manager



Daily output expectations

• 8–10 short-form videos (TikTok/Reels/Shorts format) per day

• 2–3 Stories-format clips per day

• 1 long-form YouTube video per week

• 1–2 ad creatives per week



Recruitment Process:

I. Initial Interview

II. Activity Video (Applicant must complete the activity video)

III. Final Interview



NOTE: Previous applicant need NOT TO APPLY.

title: Supply Chain & Operations Specialist
description:
IMPORTANT NOTICE TO APPLICANTS

Attention to detail and the ability to follow instructions are part of our screening process. Each step is clearly outlined, so please read carefully and complete all requirements.

Incomplete applications or those that fail to follow instructions will not be considered.





E-COMMERCE OPERATIONS ASSISTANT

MORALVE | JOB DESCRIPTION

Department: E-commerce Operations | Reports To: Operations & Supply Chain Manager

Employment Type: Full-Time | Work Arrangement: Remote



POSITION OVERVIEW

MORALVE is seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented, resourceful, and proactive E-commerce Operations Assistant to support the daily operations of our growing e-commerce business.



This versatile, hands-on role covers marketplace and account health monitoring, inventory tracking, customer service, logistics coordination, data entry, administrative support, and ongoing system and database maintenance.



The primary purpose is to ensure daily operations run smoothly, information remains accurate and current, and recurring tasks are monitored, documented, and completed. The assistant works closely with the Operations & Supply Chain Manager across Amazon and other e-commerce marketplaces.



We value reliability, initiative, follow-through, adaptability, and willingness to learn as much as previous technical experience. As familiarity develops, the role can progress from task execution toward independent ownership of routine workflows, exception identification, and project coordination.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Marketplace Account Monitoring & Maintenance

• Perform daily and recurring checks across Amazon and other assigned marketplaces.

• Monitor account health, notifications, alerts, warnings, and pending action items.



2. Inventory Monitoring & Maintenance

• Monitor inventory availability and stock health across marketplaces and inventory systems.

• Track replenishments, transfers, inbound activity, and receiving updates.

• Update inventory trackers and compare internal data against marketplace records.



3. Customer Service & Customer Experience Support

• Monitor and respond to routine customer inquiries using established guidelines and templates.

• Support order inquiries, delivery concerns, returns, refunds, and replacements within approved authority.

• Track unresolved cases, document actions, and follow up to closure.

• Identify recurring product or service issues and escalate sensitive or nonstandard cases.



4. Logistics, Shipment & Order Monitoring

• Monitor shipment and logistics updates, communications, and operational notifications.

• Maintain shipment trackers and milestones, including estimated arrival, delivery, and receiving.

• Assist with Amazon FBA, AWD, and other marketplace inbound monitoring.

• Record shipment references and organize supporting documents.

• Follow up on missing routine updates and flag delays or discrepancies.



5. Purchase Order & Supplier Coordination Support

• Maintain purchase order records, production updates, and related tracking systems.

• Monitor supplier communications, completion dates, inspection updates, and outstanding information.

• Collect quotations, documents, and routine supplier information.



6. Data Entry, Database & Tracker Maintenance

• Perform accurate recurring data entry and maintenance in spreadsheets, trackers, and databases.

• Update records using verified
s, reports, marketplace information, and supplier communications.

• Identify duplicate, missing, outdated, or inconsistent data.

• Assist with historical backtracking, cleanup, cross-checking, and reconciliation.

• Follow established data standards, formatting, and naming conventions.



7.
, Communication & Task Management

• Monitor assigned operational inboxes and channels; categorize and label communications.

• Identify and execute routine actions, follow-ups, documentation, and escalation.

• Track outstanding requests and pending responses.

• Communicate updates to internal and external stakeholders as appropriate.



8. Document & File Organization

• Download, rename, categorize, and store operational files according to company standards.

• Organize product, shipment, purchase order, inspection, supplier, and customer service documents.

• Support historical file cleanup and ensure records are traceable to their transactions.



9. Routine Operational & Administrative Support

• Complete assigned daily, weekly, and monthly checklists and maintenance tasks.

• Assist with account checks, reporting, data collection, research, and administrative activities.

• Support routine coordination across departments and evolving business needs.



10. Project Coordination & Process Improvement

• Maintain assigned project boards, task lists, deadlines, and documentation.

• Track deliverables, follow up on action items, and report blockers early.

• Assist with small operational projects and SOP documentation.

• Suggest practical improvements to accuracy, organization, and efficiency.



QUALIFICATIONS

Required

• Experience in at least 3 areas: : e-commerce operations, virtual assistance, administrative support, customer service, marketplace management, inventory/order management, logistics support, or data entry.

• Working knowledge of Google Sheets and/or Microsoft Excel, including basic formulas, sorting, filtering, and organizing data.

• Strong attention to detail, organization, written and verbal English communication.

• Ability to interpret
s, spreadsheets, reports, and operational systems and determine routine next steps.

• Ability to manage recurring responsibilities, follow SOPs, and work independently in a remote environment.

• Reliability, accountability, problem-solving ability, and willingness to learn.



Preferred

• Experience with Amazon Seller Central or similar platforms.

• Familiarity with marketplace account health, listings, inventory, orders, and e-commerce customer service.

• Experience with Google Workspace and project tools such as 
, ClickUp, Asana, or Notion.

• Basic familiarity with Amazon FBA/AWD, shipments, purchase orders, and replenishment.

• Experience working with suppliers or logistics providers and maintaining SOPs or operational trackers.



KEY COMPETENCIES

Attention to Detail - Maintains accurate records and recognizes inconsistencies.

Reliability & Consistency - Completes recurring responsibilities on time.

Ownership & Accountability - Takes responsibility and follows tasks to completion.

Proactiveness - Identifies missing information, pending actions, and potential issues.

Problem-Solving - Investigates and proposes possible solutions before escalation.

Learning Agility - Learns new tools and processes quickly.

Organization & Prioritization - Distinguishes urgent issues from routine tasks.

Communication & Follow-Through - Provides timely updates and closes loops.

Adaptability - Supports changing needs across operational functions.

Process Discipline & Judgment - Follows SOPs and recognizes when approval is required.



PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS

• Complete daily, weekly, and monthly responsibilities accurately and on time.

• Keep operational records complete, consistent, and up to date.

• Identify and report marketplace, inventory, customer service, and logistics issues promptly.

• Track open inquiries and action items through resolution.

• Communicate progress, challenges, and blockers proactively.

• Gradually manage assigned recurring workflows with less supervision.



WORK SCHEDULE & BENEFITS

Work Schedule: Full-time, 40 hours per week

Work Arrangement: Remote

13th Month Pay: Provided annually

Paid Holidays: Paid Philippine Regular and Special Non-Working Holidays

Paid Time Off (PTO): 5 paid leave days per year

Team Environment: Collaborative and supportive remote team

Professional Growth: Hands-on exposure to e-commerce tools and operations



GROWTH OPPORTUNITIES

Initially, the role focuses on learning MORALVE's systems, completing recurring tasks accurately, and maintaining reliable records. With demonstrated consistency, accountability, and judgment, the assistant may progress toward independent ownership of operational processes, advanced marketplace and inventory responsibilities, reporting and reconciliation, workflow improvement, and cross-functional project coordination.
